WITH s AS (SELECT year(order_date::date) yr, count(*) orders, count(quote_id) with_quote FROM erp_sales_orders GROUP BY 1),
q AS (SELECT year(sent_on::date) yr, count(*) quotes, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='won') won, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IS NULL) nostatus FROM erp_quotes GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT year(received_on::date) yr, count(*) rfqs, count(message_id) rfq_with_msg FROM erp_rfqs GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.yr, orders, with_quote, quotes, won, nostatus, rfqs, rfq_with_msg FROM s LEFT JOIN q USING(yr) LEFT JOIN r USING(yr) ORDER BY 1
SELECT q.status, q.kind, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT s.order_id) orders FROM erp_sales_orders s JOIN erp_quotes q USING(quote_id) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) won_quotes,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_sales_orders s WHERE s.quote_id=q.quote_id)) linked_by_key,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_quote_lines ql JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.part_id=ql.part_id JOIN erp_sales_orders s ON s.order_id=l.order_id WHERE ql.quote_id=q.quote_id AND s.customer_id=q.customer_id AND s.order_date>=q.sent_on)) linked_by_part_customer
FROM erp_quotes q WHERE status='won'
SELECT kind, status, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_sales_orders s WHERE s.quote_id=q.quote_id)) linked FROM erp_quotes q GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH p AS (SELECT invoice_id, count(*) np, sum(amount) paid, max(paid_on) last_paid FROM erp_payments GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) invoices, count(p.invoice_id) paid_invoices, max(np) max_payments_per_inv,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.invoice_id IS NULL AND i.invoiced_on < '2025-10-01') unpaid_before_oct25,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(p.paid - (i.amount + i.freight)) < 0.01) paid_eq_amt_plus_freight,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(p.paid - i.amount) < 0.01) paid_eq_amt,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.paid < i.amount + i.freight - 0.01) short_paid,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.freight > 0) inv_with_freight,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.due_on::date - i.invoiced_on::date <> c.terms_days) due_not_terms
FROM erp_invoices i LEFT JOIN p USING(invoice_id) JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id)

SELECT c.terms_days, count(*) n,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.due_on::date - i.invoiced_on::date = c.terms_days) cal_match,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE d2.day - d1.day = c.terms_days) workday_match,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.due_on = '2025-12-31') due_on_last_day,
 min(i.due_on::date - i.invoiced_on::date) min_cal, max(i.due_on::date - i.invoiced_on::date) max_cal
FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id)
LEFT JOIN dim_date d1 ON d1.date = i.invoiced_on::date LEFT JOIN dim_date d2 ON d2.date = i.due_on::date
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT c.terms_days, d2.day - d1.day wd, count(*) n FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id)
LEFT JOIN dim_date d1 ON d1.date = i.invoiced_on::date LEFT JOIN dim_date d2 ON d2.date = i.due_on::date
WHERE i.invoiced_on < '2025-06-01' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1, n DESC, 2 LIMIT 15

SELECT count(*) n,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(i.amount - sl.quantity*l.unit_price) < 0.01) amt_eq_qty_price,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.amount > sl.quantity*l.unit_price + 0.01) amt_above,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.amount < sl.quantity*l.unit_price - 0.01) amt_below,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(i.freight - s.freight) < 0.01) inv_freight_eq_ship_freight,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.customer_id <> s.customer_id) cust_mismatch_inv_ship,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE so.customer_id <> s.customer_id) cust_mismatch_so_ship,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE sl.line_id <> j.line_id) shipline_line_ne_job_line,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.invoiced_on < s.shipped_on) inv_before_ship,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE sl.partial=1) partial_lines
FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_shipment_lines sl USING(shipment_id)
JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=sl.line_id JOIN erp_sales_orders so ON so.order_id=l.order_id JOIN erp_jobs j ON j.job_id=sl.job_id

SELECT round(i.amount/(sl.quantity*l.unit_price),2) ratio, count(*) n FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_shipment_lines sl USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=sl.line_id
WHERE sl.quantity*l.unit_price>0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC, 1 LIMIT 15

SELECT count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.amount/(sl.quantity*l.unit_price) > 1.005) above_half_pct,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.amount/(sl.quantity*l.unit_price) < 0.995) below_half_pct,
 min(i.invoiced_on) FILTER (WHERE i.amount/(sl.quantity*l.unit_price) > 1.005) first_above,
 max(i.amount/(sl.quantity*l.unit_price)) max_ratio
FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_shipment_lines sl USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=sl.line_id WHERE sl.quantity*l.unit_price>0

SELECT year(i.invoiced_on::date) yr, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.amount/(sl.quantity*l.unit_price) > 1.005) above, round(avg(i.amount/(sl.quantity*l.unit_price)),4) avg_ratio
FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_shipment_lines sl USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=sl.line_id WHERE sl.quantity*l.unit_price>0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH cur AS (
 SELECT j.job_id, j.revision_issued, j.released_on,
  (SELECT r.revision FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.released_on <= j.released_on ORDER BY r.released_on DESC, r.rev_id DESC LIMIT 1) eng_rev_released,
  (SELECT r.revision FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on <= j.released_on ORDER BY r.received_on DESC, r.rev_id DESC LIMIT 1) eng_rev_received,
  p.revision part_rev
 FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_customer_parts p USING(part_id) WHERE j.released_on IS NOT NULL)
SELECT count(*) jobs, count(eng_rev_released) has_eng_rev,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE eng_rev_released IS NOT NULL AND revision_issued = eng_rev_released) eq_latest_released,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE eng_rev_received IS NOT NULL AND revision_issued <> eng_rev_received) ne_latest_received,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE eng_rev_released IS NULL AND revision_issued = part_rev) noeng_eq_partrev,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE eng_rev_released IS NULL AND revision_issued <> part_rev) noeng_ne_partrev
FROM cur

 (SELECT count(DISTINCT employee_id) FROM hr_timecards t WHERE year(t.week_of::date)=y.year) tc_emps,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT employee_id) FROM shop_labour_entries l WHERE year(l.work_date::date)=y.year) labour_emps,
 (SELECT round(sum(regular_hours+overtime_hours)) FROM hr_timecards t WHERE year(t.week_of::date)=y.year) tc_hours,
 (SELECT round(sum(overtime_hours)) FROM hr_timecards t WHERE year(t.week_of::date)=y.year) tc_ot,
 (SELECT round(sum(hours)) FROM shop_labour_entries l WHERE year(l.work_date::date)=y.year) labour_hours
FROM y ORDER BY 1

WITH y AS (SELECT DISTINCT year FROM dim_date)
SELECT y.year,
 (SELECT round(sum(hours)) FROM shop_labour_entries l WHERE overtime=1 AND year(l.work_date::date)=y.year) labour_ot_h,
 (SELECT round(sum(overtime_hours)) FROM hr_timecards t WHERE year(t.week_of::date)=y.year) tc_ot_h,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM shop_overtime_authorisations a WHERE year(a.week_of::date)=y.year) ot_auths,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_general_ledger g WHERE account='overtime hours (memo)' AND left(period,4)=y.year::varchar) gl_ot_months,
 (SELECT round(sum(amount)) FROM erp_general_ledger g WHERE account='overtime hours (memo)' AND left(period,4)=y.year::varchar) gl_ot_memo,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_general_ledger g WHERE account='rework labour (memo)' AND left(period,4)=y.year::varchar) gl_rework_months,
 (SELECT round(sum(hours)) FROM shop_labour_entries l WHERE rework=1 AND year(l.work_date::date)=y.year) labour_rework_h
FROM y ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.job_id<>o.job_id) job_mismatch,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.work_date > o.completed_on) after_op_completed,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.work_date < j.released_on) before_job_release,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.hours<=0) nonpos_hours, max(l.hours) max_hours,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.employee_id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM hr_employees WHERE terminated_on IS NOT NULL) AND l.work_date > (SELECT terminated_on FROM hr_employees h WHERE h.employee_id=l.employee_id)) after_termination,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.work_date < (SELECT hired_on FROM hr_employees h WHERE h.employee_id=l.employee_id)) before_hire
FROM shop_labour_entries l JOIN erp_job_operations o USING(op_id) JOIN erp_jobs j ON j.job_id=o.job_id

SELECT CASE WHEN hours<=0 THEN '<=0' WHEN hours<=12 THEN '0-12' WHEN hours<=24 THEN '12-24' WHEN hours<=60 THEN '24-60' ELSE '>60' END b, count(*) n, round(sum(hours)) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH a AS (SELECT op_id, sum(hours) act, sum(qty_good) good, sum(qty_scrap) scrap FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1)
SELECT o.work_centre, count(*) ops, count(a.op_id) ops_with_labour, round(sum(o.est_setup_hours+o.est_run_hours)) est_h, round(sum(a.act)) act_h, round(sum(a.act)/sum(o.est_setup_hours+o.est_run_hours) FILTER (WHERE a.op_id IS NOT NULL),3) act_over_est
FROM erp_job_operations o LEFT JOIN a USING(op_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) entries, count(DISTINCT (employee_id, op_id)) emp_op, count(DISTINCT op_id) ops, count(DISTINCT (employee_id, work_date)) emp_days,
 (SELECT max(c) FROM (SELECT count(*) c FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY employee_id, work_date)) max_entries_emp_day,
 (SELECT max(h) FROM (SELECT sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY employee_id, work_date)) max_hours_emp_day
FROM shop_labour_entries

WITH l AS (SELECT op_id, sum(qty_scrap) ls FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(qty_scrap)>0),
s AS (SELECT op_id, sum(quantity) sq, count(*) nrep FROM shop_scrap_reports GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) ops_any, count(l.op_id) ops_labour_scrap, count(s.op_id) ops_scrap_report, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.op_id IS NOT NULL AND s.op_id IS NOT NULL) both_,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.ls = s.sq) qty_equal, sum(l.ls) labour_scrap_qty, sum(s.sq) report_scrap_qty
FROM l FULL JOIN s USING(op_id)

SELECT year(reported_on::date) yr, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE reason_code='dimension out of tolerance') dim, count(*) FILTER (WHERE reason_code='operator error') op_err, count(*) FILTER (WHERE reason_code='material') mat, count(*) FILTER (WHERE reason_code='other') oth, count(*) FILTER (WHERE reason_code='wrong revision') wrong_rev, sum(quantity) qty FROM shop_scrap_reports GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (SELECT op_id, sum(qty_scrap) ls FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.reason_code, count(*) reports, count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(l.ls,0)=0) op_has_no_labour_scrap, sum(s.quantity) qty FROM shop_scrap_reports s LEFT JOIN l USING(op_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

SELECT o.work_centre, s.reason_code, count(*) n FROM shop_scrap_reports s JOIN erp_job_operations o USING(op_id) WHERE s.reason_code IN ('wrong revision','weld defect','paint or finish','first article') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2, 3 DESC, 1

WITH r AS (SELECT po_id, count(*) nr, sum(pounds) lbs, min(received_on) first_rcv FROM erp_receipts GROUP BY 1)
SELECT v.kind, count(*) pos, count(r.po_id) received, max(nr) max_receipts, round(sum(r.lbs)/sum(pl.pounds) FILTER (WHERE r.po_id IS NOT NULL),3) rcv_over_ordered_lbs,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.first_rcv > p.due_on) late_first_rcpt, count(DISTINCT pl.material) materials,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(pl.amount - pl.pounds*pl.price_per_lb) > 0.01) amt_ne
FROM erp_purchase_orders p JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) JOIN erp_vendors v USING(vendor_id) LEFT JOIN r USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT v.kind, pl.material, count(*) n, round(min(pl.price_per_lb),3) min_p, round(max(pl.price_per_lb),3) max_p, count(*) FILTER (WHERE pl.pounds IS NULL OR pl.pounds=0) zero_lbs FROM erp_po_lines pl JOIN erp_purchase_orders p USING(po_id) JOIN erp_vendors v USING(vendor_id) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT year(p.ordered_on::date) yr, count(*) material_pos, count(r.po_id) received, round(count(r.po_id)/count(*),3) share_received, round(max(abs(pl.amount - pl.pounds*pl.price_per_lb)),2) max_amt_diff
FROM erp_purchase_orders p JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT po_id FROM erp_receipts) r USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material<>'outside processing' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) jobs, count(p.job_id) jobs_with_po, max(np) max_pos_per_job,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE np_rcv>0) jobs_with_receipt
FROM erp_jobs j LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.job_id, count(*) np, count(r.po_id) np_rcv FROM erp_purchase_orders p LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT po_id FROM erp_receipts) r USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1) p USING(job_id)

WITH s AS (SELECT sl.line_id, max(sh.shipped_on) last_ship, min(sh.shipped_on) first_ship, count(*) nship, sum(sl.quantity) shipped_qty FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments sh USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT year(so.order_date::date) yr, count(*) lines, count(s.line_id) shipped,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.promised_date > l.requested_date) promised_after_req,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.promised_date < l.requested_date) promised_before_req,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.last_ship > l.promised_date) late_vs_promised,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.shipped_qty <> l.quantity) qty_ne, count(*) FILTER (WHERE nship>1) multi_ship
FROM erp_so_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders so USING(order_id) LEFT JOIN s USING(line_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH h AS (SELECT quote_line_id, sum(setup_hours+run_hours) hh, count(*) nwc FROM erp_quote_line_hours GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) qlines, count(h.quote_line_id) with_hours, count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(ql.est_hours - h.hh) < 0.01) est_eq_sum,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE ql.surcharge=1) surcharge_lines, count(DISTINCT ql.surcharge) surcharge_vals,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_quotes q JOIN erp_rfqs r USING(rfq_id) WHERE q.customer_id<>r.customer_id) quote_rfq_cust_mismatch,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_rfqs WHERE entered_on < received_on) entered_before_recv,
 (SELECT round(avg(entered_on::date - received_on::date),2) FROM erp_rfqs) avg_cal_days_to_enter,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_quotes q JOIN erp_rfqs r USING(rfq_id) WHERE q.sent_on < r.received_on) quote_before_rfq,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_rfqs r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_quotes q WHERE q.rfq_id=r.rfq_id)) rfqs_no_quote,
 (SELECT max(c) FROM (SELECT count(*) c FROM erp_quotes GROUP BY rfq_id)) max_quotes_per_rfq
FROM erp_quote_lines ql LEFT JOIN h USING(quote_line_id)

WITH h AS (SELECT quote_line_id, sum(setup_hours) s, sum(run_hours) r FROM erp_quote_line_hours GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(ql.est_hours - (h.s + h.r*ql.quantity)) < 0.05) eq_setup_plus_run_x_qty,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(ql.est_hours - (h.s + h.r)) < 0.05) eq_setup_plus_run,
 round(median(ql.est_hours/(h.s + h.r*ql.quantity)),3) med_ratio
FROM erp_quote_lines ql JOIN h USING(quote_line_id)

WITH a AS (SELECT job_id, sum(hours) act FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
e AS (SELECT job_id, sum(est_setup_hours) s, sum(est_run_hours) r FROM erp_job_operations GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) jobs, round(median(a.act/(e.s+e.r)),3) med_act_over_total, round(median(a.act/(e.s+e.r*j.quantity)),3) med_act_over_perpiece, round(median(j.quantity),0) med_qty
FROM erp_jobs j JOIN e USING(job_id) JOIN a USING(job_id) WHERE j.completed_on IS NOT NULL

SELECT count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(l.unit_price-ql.unit_price)<0.005) same_price, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.unit_price<ql.unit_price-0.005) po_below_quote, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.unit_price>ql.unit_price+0.005) po_above_quote
FROM erp_sales_orders so JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(order_id) JOIN erp_quote_lines ql ON ql.quote_id=so.quote_id AND ql.part_id=l.part_id

 (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_jobs j WHERE j.kind='remake' AND year(j.created_on::date)=year(c.issued_on::date)) remakes

WITH y AS (SELECT DISTINCT year FROM dim_date)
SELECT y.year,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM hr_employees WHERE year(hired_on::date)=y.year) hires,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM hr_employees WHERE year(terminated_on::date)=y.year) terms,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM hr_requisitions WHERE year(opened_on::date)=y.year) reqs_opened,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM hr_requisitions WHERE year(opened_on::date)=y.year AND filled_on IS NULL) reqs_unfilled,
 (SELECT round(avg(filled_on::date-opened_on::date),1) FROM hr_requisitions WHERE year(opened_on::date)=y.year) avg_days_to_fill,
 (SELECT round(avg(hourly),2) FROM hr_pay_rates WHERE year(effective_on::date)=y.year) avg_rate_set

SELECT min(hired_on) min_hire, count(*) FILTER (WHERE hired_on < '2016-01-04') hired_pre2016, (SELECT count(*) FROM hr_employees e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hr_pay_rates p WHERE p.employee_id=e.employee_id)) no_rate,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT e.role) FROM shop_inspections i JOIN hr_employees e ON e.employee_id=i.inspector_id) inspector_roles,
 (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT e.role, ',' ORDER BY e.role) FROM eng_cam_programs c JOIN hr_employees e ON e.employee_id=c.author_id) cam_author_roles,
 (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT e.role, ',' ORDER BY e.role) FROM erp_quotes q JOIN hr_employees e ON e.employee_id=q.estimator_id) estimator_roles,

FROM hr_employees

 (SELECT count(DISTINCT name) FROM erp_customers) distinct_names,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_customer_parts p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_jobs j WHERE j.part_id=p.part_id)) parts_never_made,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT (customer_id, part_number)) FROM erp_customer_parts) distinct_cust_partnum,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_cam_programs WHERE proved_out_on IS NULL) cam_not_proved,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT part_id) FROM eng_cam_programs) cam_parts,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT author_id) FROM eng_cam_programs) cam_authors

 (SELECT count(*) FROM shop_labour_entries WHERE hours>24) entries_over_24h,
 30606-29420 ops_report_no_labour_scrap,
 (SELECT round(1 - count(DISTINCT r.po_id)/count(DISTINCT p.po_id),3) FROM erp_purchase_orders p JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) LEFT JOIN erp_receipts r USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material<>'outside processing') share_material_pos_unreceived,
 (SELECT round(min(t.h - l.h)) FROM (SELECT year(week_of::date) y, sum(regular_hours+overtime_hours) h FROM hr_timecards GROUP BY 1) t JOIN (SELECT year(work_date::date) y, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1) l USING(y)) min_paid_minus_clocked,
 (SELECT round(max(t.h - l.h)) FROM (SELECT year(week_of::date) y, sum(regular_hours+overtime_hours) h FROM hr_timecards GROUP BY 1) t JOIN (SELECT year(work_date::date) y, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1) l USING(y)) max_paid_minus_clocked

SELECT account, substr(period,1,4) AS yr, round(sum(amount)) AS amt, count(*) AS months FROM erp_general_ledger GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH inv AS (
 SELECT i.invoice_id, substr(i.invoiced_on,1,4) yr, i.amount, sl.quantity*l.unit_price AS base
 FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_shipment_lines sl USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=sl.line_id)
SELECT yr, count(*) n_inv, round(sum(amount)) inv_amt, round(sum(base)) base_amt,
 round(sum(amount-base)) diff, sum(CASE WHEN amount>base*1.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_uplift,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN amount>base*1.005 THEN amount-base ELSE 0 END)) uplift_amt,
 sum(CASE WHEN amount<base*0.995 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_under,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN amount<base*0.995 THEN amount-base ELSE 0 END)) under_amt
FROM inv GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr

SELECT substr(p.ordered_on,1,4) yr, l.material, count(*) n, round(sum(l.amount)) amt, round(sum(l.amount)/sum(l.pounds),3) usd_lb,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.po_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_unrec, round(sum(CASE WHEN r.po_id IS NULL THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) unrec_amt
FROM erp_purchase_orders p JOIN erp_po_lines l USING(po_id)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT po_id FROM erp_receipts) r USING(po_id)
WHERE l.pounds>0 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

 FROM erp_so_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT a.yr, count(*) n_parts_both_years, round(median(a.p/b.p),4) med_price_ratio_vs_prior_yr,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN a.p=b.p THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),3) share_unchanged
FROM x a JOIN x b ON a.part_id=b.part_id AND CAST(a.yr AS INT)=CAST(b.yr AS INT)+1
GROUP BY a.yr ORDER BY a.yr

WITH act AS (SELECT op_id, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY op_id)
SELECT o.work_centre, count(*) n_ops, round(sum(o.est_setup_hours+o.est_run_hours)) est_h, round(sum(a.h)) act_h,
 round(sum(a.h)/sum(o.est_setup_hours+o.est_run_hours),3) ratio
FROM erp_job_operations o JOIN act a USING(op_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT substr(s.shipped_on,1,4) yr, count(*) n_ship,
 sum(CASE WHEN d.date > CAST(l.promised_date AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_late,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN d.date > CAST(l.promised_date AS DATE) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),4) late_rate,
 sum(CASE WHEN s.method='expedited LTL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_exp, round(sum(s.freight)) freight
FROM erp_shipments s JOIN erp_shipment_lines sl USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=sl.line_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.date=CAST(s.shipped_on AS DATE)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT substr(i.invoiced_on,1,4) yr, s.method, count(*) n, round(sum(s.freight)) ship_freight, round(sum(i.freight)) billed_freight,
 sum(CASE WHEN i.freight < s.freight - 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_underbilled
FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT substr(i.invoiced_on,1,4) yr, count(*) n_inv, count(p.payment_id) n_paid,
 round(sum(i.amount+i.freight)) billed, round(sum(p.amount)) paid,
 sum(CASE WHEN p.amount < i.amount+i.freight-0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_short,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN p.amount < i.amount+i.freight-0.01 THEN i.amount+i.freight-p.amount ELSE 0 END)) short_amt,
 sum(CASE WHEN p.paid_on > i.due_on THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_late,
 round(avg(datediff('day', CAST(i.invoiced_on AS DATE), CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE))),1) avg_days_to_pay
FROM erp_invoices i LEFT JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT q.estimator_id, count(*) n_new_quotes,
 sum(CASE WHEN status='won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won, round(avg(CASE WHEN status='won' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),3) hit,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN status='expired' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),3) expired_share, min(substr(sent_on,1,4)) first_yr, max(substr(sent_on,1,4)) last_yr
FROM erp_quotes q WHERE kind='new' AND status<>'' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH c AS (SELECT o.customer_id, CAST(substr(o.order_date,1,4) AS INT) yr, sum(l.quantity*l.unit_price) rev
 FROM erp_sales_orders o JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1,2),
last AS (SELECT customer_id, max(yr) last_yr, min(yr) first_yr FROM c GROUP BY 1)
SELECT last_yr, count(*) n_customers_last_ordering,
 round(sum((SELECT sum(rev) FROM c WHERE c.customer_id=last.customer_id AND c.yr BETWEEN last.last_yr-2 AND last.last_yr)/3)) avg_annual_rev_last3y
FROM last GROUP BY last_yr ORDER BY last_yr

SELECT substr(work_date,1,4) yr, round(sum(hours)) all_h, round(sum(CASE WHEN rework=1 THEN hours ELSE 0 END)) rework_h,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN overtime=1 THEN hours ELSE 0 END)) ot_h, sum(qty_scrap) scrap_qty, sum(qty_good) good_qty
FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT substr(effective_on,1,4) yr, round(median(hourly),2) med_rate, count(*) n FROM hr_pay_rates GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT q.status, count(DISTINCT q.quote_id) n_quotes, round(sum(ql.quantity*ql.unit_price)) value, round(sum(ql.quantity*ql.unit_price)/10) per_yr_10y,
 round(median(ql.unit_price*ql.quantity),0) med_line_value
FROM erp_quotes q JOIN erp_quote_lines ql USING(quote_id) WHERE q.kind='new' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH tc AS (SELECT substr(week_of,1,4) yr, sum(regular_hours+overtime_hours) paid_h FROM hr_timecards GROUP BY 1),
lb AS (SELECT substr(work_date,1,4) yr, sum(hours) clocked_h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1)
SELECT yr, round(paid_h) paid_h, round(clocked_h) clocked_h, round(paid_h-clocked_h) unclocked_h, round((paid_h-clocked_h)/paid_h,3) unclocked_share,
 round((paid_h-clocked_h)*25) unclocked_usd_at_25
FROM tc JOIN lb USING(yr) ORDER BY yr

WITH rev AS (SELECT j.job_id, o.customer_id, sl.quantity*l.unit_price rev FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=j.line_id JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN erp_shipment_lines sl ON sl.job_id=j.job_id),
mat AS (SELECT job_id, sum(amount) m FROM erp_purchase_orders JOIN erp_po_lines USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),
lab AS (SELECT job_id, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
cust AS (SELECT r.customer_id, sum(rev) rev, sum(coalesce(m,0)) mat, sum(coalesce(h,0)) h FROM rev r LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN lab USING(job_id) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT c.segment, count(*) n_cust, round(sum(rev)) rev, round(sum(mat)/sum(rev),3) mat_share, round(sum(rev-mat)/sum(h),1) va_per_clocked_h,
 sum(CASE WHEN (rev-mat)/nullif(h,0) < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_cust_va_lt60
FROM cust JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH g AS (SELECT substr(period,1,4) yr, sum(CASE WHEN account='revenue' THEN amount END) rev, -sum(CASE WHEN account='material' THEN amount END) mat FROM erp_general_ledger GROUP BY 1)
SELECT yr, round(rev) rev, round(mat) mat, round(mat/rev,3) mat_share, round(mat - rev*0.30) mat_above_30pct_share FROM g ORDER BY yr

WITH lr AS (SELECT p.job_id, max(CASE WHEN r.received_on > p.due_on THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late_rcpt
 FROM erp_purchase_orders p JOIN erp_receipts r USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),
sh AS (SELECT sl.job_id, substr(s.shipped_on,1,4) yr, CASE WHEN CAST(s.shipped_on AS DATE) > CAST(l.promised_date AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END late
 FROM erp_shipments s JOIN erp_shipment_lines sl USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=sl.line_id)
SELECT yr, late_rcpt, count(*) n, round(avg(late),4) late_ship_rate FROM sh JOIN lr USING(job_id)
WHERE yr IN ('2019','2020','2021','2022') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT r.reason, count(*) n_ra, round(sum(c.amount)) credit_amt, min(substr(r.opened_on,1,4)) first_yr, max(substr(r.opened_on,1,4)) last_yr
FROM erp_return_authorisations r JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN erp_invoices i ON i.shipment_id IN (SELECT shipment_id FROM erp_shipment_lines WHERE job_id=r.job_id)
LEFT JOIN erp_credit_memos c ON c.invoice_id=i.invoice_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1
SELECT reason_code, count(*) n_reports, sum(quantity) qty FROM shop_scrap_reports GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC, 1

WITH x AS (SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount+i.freight amt,
 datediff('day', CAST(i.due_on AS DATE), CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE)) days_late
 FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on < '2025-01-01'),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(amt) amt, sum(amt*greatest(days_late,0))/sum(amt) wdays FROM x GROUP BY 1)
SELECT round(sum(amt)/9) billed_per_yr, round(sum(amt*wdays)/sum(amt),1) wtd_days_past_due,
 round(sum(amt*wdays)/9/365) extra_ar_usd, round(sum(amt*wdays)/9/365*0.08) carry_cost_8pct,
 sum(CASE WHEN wdays>30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_cust_over30, round(sum(CASE WHEN wdays>30 THEN amt*wdays END)/sum(amt*wdays),3) share_of_overdue_dollar_days_from_over30, count(*) n_cust
FROM c

SELECT s.reason_code, count(*) n, sum(s.quantity) qty, round(sum(s.quantity*l.unit_price)) value_at_po_price, round(sum(s.quantity*l.unit_price)/10) per_yr
FROM shop_scrap_reports s JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=j.line_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC, 1

SELECT yr, uplift, mat_above_30, round(uplift/mat_above_30,3) coverage FROM (VALUES ('2021',256468.0,3058571.0),('2022',598596.0,2524386.0),('2023',68200.0,1153678.0)) t(yr,uplift,mat_above_30) ORDER BY yr

WITH u AS (SELECT substr(p.ordered_on,1,4) yr, sum(l.amount) amt FROM erp_purchase_orders p JOIN erp_po_lines l USING(po_id)
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT po_id FROM erp_receipts) r USING(po_id) WHERE l.pounds>0 AND r.po_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1)
SELECT round(min(amt)) min_unrec_yr, round(max(amt)) max_unrec_yr,
 (SELECT round(sum(amount)/10) FROM erp_credit_memos) credits_per_yr,
 (SELECT round(sum(ql.quantity*ql.unit_price)/10) FROM erp_quotes q JOIN erp_quote_lines ql USING(quote_id) WHERE q.kind='new' AND q.status<>'' AND q.estimator_id IN (113,115,118)) low_hit_est_value_per_yr
FROM u
SELECT account, count(*) n, min(period) p0, max(period) p1, round(sum(amount),0) total FROM erp_general_ledger GROUP BY account ORDER BY account
SELECT material, count(*) n, min(price_per_lb), max(price_per_lb), sum(amount) FROM erp_po_lines GROUP BY material ORDER BY material

SELECT (SELECT min(invoiced_on) FROM erp_invoices) i0, (SELECT max(invoiced_on) FROM erp_invoices) i1, (SELECT min(ordered_on) FROM erp_purchase_orders) p0, (SELECT min(work_date) FROM shop_labour_entries) w0, (SELECT count(DISTINCT kind) FROM erp_vendors) vk, (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT material, ',' ORDER BY material) FROM erp_po_lines) mats, (SELECT count(DISTINCT family) FROM erp_customer_parts) fams
SELECT * FROM erp_shipments ORDER BY shipment_id LIMIT 3

SELECT s.reason_code, count(*) n, sum(s.quantity) pcs, round(sum(s.quantity*l.unit_price),0) val, count(DISTINCT j.part_id) parts, sum(CASE WHEN l.line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_line
FROM shop_scrap_reports s JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=j.line_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY val DESC

SELECT i.invoice_id, i.customer_id, i.invoiced_on, i.due_on, i.amount, i.freight, p.paid_on, p.amount AS paid, c.terms_days FROM erp_invoices i LEFT JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) ORDER BY i.invoice_id LIMIT 5

WITH gl AS (SELECT substr(period,1,4)::INT yr, sum(CASE WHEN account='revenue' THEN amount END) rev, -sum(CASE WHEN account='material' THEN amount END) mat, -sum(CASE WHEN account IN ('direct labour','indirect labour','benefits and payroll taxes','shop overhead') THEN amount END) conv, -sum(CASE WHEN account IN ('outside processing','premium freight') THEN amount END) other FROM erp_general_ledger GROUP BY 1),
lab AS (SELECT year(work_date::DATE) yr, sum(hours) hrs FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1)
SELECT gl.yr, round(rev) rev, round(mat) mat, round(conv) conv, round(other) other, round(hrs) clocked_h, round((rev-mat)/hrs,1) va_per_h, round(conv/hrs,1) loaded_rate_per_h, round((rev-mat-conv-other)/rev,4) op_margin FROM gl JOIN lab USING(yr) ORDER BY yr

WITH mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat, sum(CASE WHEN r.po_id IS NOT NULL THEN pl.amount END) mat_recv, count(*) npo
  FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id)
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT po_id FROM erp_receipts) r USING(po_id)
  WHERE pl.material <> 'outside processing' GROUP BY po.job_id),
shp AS (SELECT sl.job_id, min(s.shipped_on) first_ship, sum(sl.quantity*l.unit_price) po_val, sum(i.amount) inv
  FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id)
  GROUP BY sl.job_id)
SELECT substr(first_ship,1,4) yr, count(*) jobs, round(sum(po_val)) po_val, round(sum(inv)) inv, round(sum(coalesce(mat,0))) mat, round(sum(coalesce(mat_recv,0))) mat_recv,
 round(sum(coalesce(mat,0))/sum(po_val),4) share_all, round(sum(coalesce(mat_recv,0))/sum(po_val),4) share_recv, round(sum(inv)/sum(po_val)-1,4) uplift_pct
FROM shp JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH rev AS (SELECT sl.job_id, sum(i.amount) rev FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material<>'outside processing' GROUP BY 1),
lab AS (SELECT job_id, sum(hours) hrs FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1)
SELECT j.kind, count(*) jobs, count(rev.job_id) with_rev, round(sum(rev)) rev, round(sum(mat)) mat, round(sum(hrs)) hrs, round((sum(rev)-sum(mat))/sum(hrs),1) va_h FROM erp_jobs j LEFT JOIN rev USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN lab USING(job_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH prod AS (
 SELECT j.part_id, sum(j.quantity) pcs, sum(j.quantity*l.unit_price) val
 FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=j.line_id WHERE j.kind='order' GROUP BY 1),
sc AS (
 SELECT j.part_id, sum(s.quantity) spcs, sum(s.quantity*l.unit_price) sval
 FROM shop_scrap_reports s JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=j.line_id
 WHERE s.reason_code IN ('dimension out of tolerance','operator error') GROUP BY 1),
a AS (SELECT p.part_id, p.pcs, p.val, coalesce(sc.spcs,0) spcs, coalesce(sc.sval,0) sval FROM prod p LEFT JOIN sc USING(part_id)),
r AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sval DESC, part_id) rs, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY val DESC, part_id) rv, count(*) OVER () n FROM a)
SELECT max(n) parts_with_jobs, sum(CASE WHEN sval>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) parts_with_scrap,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN rs<=n*0.1 THEN sval END)/sum(sval),4) top10_scrap_share_of_scrap,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN rs<=n*0.1 THEN val END)/sum(val),4) top10scrap_parts_share_of_prodval,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN rv<=n*0.1 THEN val END)/sum(val),4) top10_prodval_share_of_prodval,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN rv<=n*0.1 THEN sval END)/sum(sval),4) top10prod_parts_share_of_scrap,
 round(sum(sval),0) scrap_val, round(sum(val),0) prod_val
FROM r

WITH b AS (SELECT i.invoice_id, i.customer_id, CAST(i.invoiced_on AS DATE) inv, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, i.amount+i.freight AS billed, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid, p.amount paid_amt, c.terms_days FROM erp_invoices i LEFT JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on < '2025-01-01')
SELECT count(*) n, count(paid) n_paid, count(DISTINCT customer_id) cust, sum(billed) billed,
 avg(due - inv) avg_due_gap_cal, avg(due-inv - terms_days) avg_due_vs_terms,
 sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0))/sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE paid IS NOT NULL) w_days_late_due,
 sum(billed*greatest(paid-(inv+terms_days::INT),0))/sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE paid IS NOT NULL) w_days_late_terms,
 sum(billed*(paid-inv))/sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE paid IS NOT NULL) w_days_to_pay,
 sum(billed*terms_days)/sum(billed) w_terms,
 avg(CASE WHEN paid>due THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE paid IS NOT NULL) share_late_due,
 avg(CASE WHEN paid>inv+terms_days::INT THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE paid IS NOT NULL) share_late_terms,
 min(inv) mn, max(inv) mx
FROM b

WITH mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat, max(CASE WHEN pl.material='carbon' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) is_carbon
  FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material <> 'outside processing' GROUP BY po.job_id),
shp AS (SELECT sl.job_id, min(s.shipped_on) first_ship, sum(sl.quantity*l.unit_price) po_val, sum(i.amount) inv
  FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY sl.job_id),
lines AS (SELECT l.line_id, l.part_id, l.unit_price, o.order_date,
  lag(l.unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY l.part_id ORDER BY o.order_date, l.line_id) prev_price,
  first_value(l.unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY l.part_id ORDER BY o.order_date, l.line_id) first_price
  FROM erp_so_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id)),
base AS (SELECT substr(first_ship,1,4) yr, CASE WHEN prev_price IS NULL THEN 'first' WHEN abs(unit_price-prev_price)<0.005 THEN 'repeat_same' ELSE 'repeat_changed' END grp,
  is_carbon, po_val, inv, coalesce(mat,0) mat
  FROM shp JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN lines USING(line_id) LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order')
SELECT yr, grp, count(*) jobs, round(sum(po_val)) po_val, round(sum(mat)/sum(po_val),4) share, round(sum(inv-po_val)) uplift
FROM base WHERE is_carbon=1 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, i.amount+i.freight AS billed, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on < '2025-01-01'),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(billed) billed, sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) dd, count(*) n FROM b GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY dd DESC, customer_id) rk, sum(dd) OVER () tdd, sum(billed) OVER () tb, count(*) OVER () nc FROM c)
SELECT nc, sum(dd) FILTER (WHERE rk<=10)/max(tdd) top10_dd, sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE rk<=10)/max(tb) top10_billed,
 sum(dd) FILTER (WHERE rk<=27)/max(tdd) top27_dd, sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE rk<=27)/max(tb) top27_billed,
 sum(dd) FILTER (WHERE rk<=53)/max(tdd) top53_dd, sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE rk<=53)/max(tb) top53_billed,
 min(rk) FILTER (WHERE rk_cum>=0.5) n_for_half
FROM (SELECT *, sum(dd) OVER (ORDER BY rk)/tdd rk_cum FROM r) GROUP BY nc

WITH rev AS (SELECT sl.job_id, min(i.customer_id) cust, sum(i.amount) rev FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material<>'outside processing' GROUP BY 1),
lab AS (SELECT job_id, sum(hours) hrs FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
c AS (SELECT cust, sum(rev) rev, sum(coalesce(mat,0)) mat, sum(coalesce(hrs,0)) hrs FROM erp_jobs j JOIN rev USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN lab USING(job_id) GROUP BY 1),
loaded AS (SELECT -sum(amount)/(SELECT sum(hours) FROM shop_labour_entries) r FROM erp_general_ledger WHERE account IN ('direct labour','indirect labour','benefits and payroll taxes','shop overhead'))
SELECT count(*) customers, sum(CASE WHEN rev>=500000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cust_ge_500k, round((SELECT r FROM loaded),1) loaded_rate,
 round(min(CASE WHEN rev>=500000 THEN (rev-mat)/hrs END),1) min_va, round(quantile_cont(CASE WHEN rev>=500000 THEN (rev-mat)/hrs END,0.1),1) p10, round(quantile_cont(CASE WHEN rev>=500000 THEN (rev-mat)/hrs END,0.5),1) p50, round(quantile_cont(CASE WHEN rev>=500000 THEN (rev-mat)/hrs END,0.9),1) p90, round(max(CASE WHEN rev>=500000 THEN (rev-mat)/hrs END),1) max_va,
 sum(CASE WHEN rev>=500000 AND (rev-mat)/hrs < (SELECT r FROM loaded) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_below_loaded,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN rev>=500000 THEN rev END)/sum(rev),4) share_rev_ge500k
FROM c

WITH sc AS (
 SELECT s.job_id, sum(s.quantity) spcs FROM shop_scrap_reports s
 WHERE s.reason_code IN ('dimension out of tolerance','operator error') GROUP BY 1),
jb AS (
 SELECT j.part_id, j.job_id, j.quantity, coalesce(sc.spcs,0) spcs, d.year
 FROM erp_jobs j LEFT JOIN sc USING(job_id) JOIN dim_date d ON d.day=CAST(j.released_on AS BIGINT)
 WHERE j.kind='order'),
h AS (SELECT part_id, CASE WHEN year<=2020 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END half, sum(quantity) pcs, sum(spcs) s FROM jb GROUP BY 1,2),
w AS (SELECT a.part_id, a.pcs p1, a.s s1, b.pcs p2, b.s s2 FROM h a JOIN h b ON a.part_id=b.part_id AND a.half=1 AND b.half=2 WHERE a.pcs>=200 AND b.pcs>=200)
SELECT count(*) parts, round(corr(s1/p1, s2/p2),4) rate_corr_halves, round(sum(s1)/sum(p1),5) rate1, round(sum(s2)/sum(p2),5) rate2,
 (SELECT round(sum(spcs)/sum(quantity),5) FROM jb) overall_rate, (SELECT count(*) FROM jb) jobs
FROM w
