WITH mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat, max(CASE WHEN pl.material='carbon' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) is_carbon
  FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material <> 'outside processing' GROUP BY po.job_id),
shp AS (SELECT sl.job_id, min(s.shipped_on) first_ship, sum(sl.quantity*l.unit_price) po_val, sum(i.amount) inv
  FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY sl.job_id),
lines AS (SELECT l.line_id, l.unit_price, lag(l.unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY l.part_id ORDER BY o.order_date, l.line_id) prev_price
  FROM erp_so_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id)),
base AS (SELECT substr(first_ship,1,4)::int yr, CASE WHEN coalesce(is_carbon,0)=1 THEN 'carbon' ELSE 'other' END mat_grp,
  CASE WHEN prev_price IS NULL THEN 'first' WHEN abs(unit_price-prev_price)<0.005 THEN 'repeat_same' ELSE 'repeat_changed' END grp,
  po_val, inv, coalesce(mat,0) mat FROM shp JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN lines USING(line_id) LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order'),
bl AS (SELECT sum(mat)/sum(po_val) b FROM base WHERE yr BETWEEN 2016 AND 2020),
ex AS (SELECT yr, mat_grp, grp, sum(mat - b*po_val) excess, sum(inv-po_val) uplift, sum(po_val) po_val FROM base, bl GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT yr, round((SELECT b FROM bl),4) baseline, round(sum(excess)) excess_total,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN mat_grp='carbon' AND grp='repeat_same' THEN excess END)) excess_carbon_rep_same,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN mat_grp='carbon' AND grp='repeat_same' THEN excess END)/sum(excess),4) share_of_excess,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN mat_grp='other' THEN excess END)) excess_noncarbon,
 round(sum(uplift)) uplift, round(sum(uplift)/sum(excess),4) uplift_cover
FROM ex GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr

WITH rev AS (SELECT sl.job_id, sum(i.amount) rev FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material<>'outside processing' GROUP BY 1),
lab AS (SELECT job_id, sum(hours) hrs FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
jj AS (SELECT j.job_id, p.family, j.quantity, CASE WHEN j.quantity<=5 THEN 'a 1-5' WHEN j.quantity<=10 THEN 'b 6-10' WHEN j.quantity<=25 THEN 'c 11-25' WHEN j.quantity<=50 THEN 'd 26-50' WHEN j.quantity<=100 THEN 'e 51-100' ELSE 'f 100+' END qb, rev, coalesce(mat,0) mat, coalesce(hrs,0) hrs FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_customer_parts p USING(part_id) JOIN rev USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN lab USING(job_id))
SELECT 'family' dim, family::VARCHAR grp, count(*) jobs, round(sum(rev)) rev, round(sum(rev)/(SELECT sum(rev) FROM jj),4) rev_share, round(sum(hrs)) hrs, round(sum(mat)/sum(rev),3) mat_share, round((sum(rev)-sum(mat))/sum(hrs),1) va_h FROM jj GROUP BY family
UNION ALL
SELECT 'qty', qb, count(*), round(sum(rev)), round(sum(rev)/(SELECT sum(rev) FROM jj),4), round(sum(hrs)), round(sum(mat)/sum(rev),3), round((sum(rev)-sum(mat))/sum(hrs),1) FROM jj GROUP BY qb
ORDER BY dim, grp

WITH b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, year(CAST(i.invoiced_on AS DATE)) yr, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, i.amount+i.freight AS billed, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on < '2025-01-01')
SELECT yr, round(sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0))/sum(billed),2) all_w,
 round(sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE customer_id=7)/sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE customer_id=7),2) c7,
 round(sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE customer_id=6)/sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE customer_id=6),2) c6,
 round(sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE customer_id NOT IN (6,7))/sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE customer_id NOT IN (6,7)),2) rest,
 round(sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE customer_id IN (6,7))/sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)),4) share_dd_67,
 round(sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE customer_id IN (6,7))/sum(billed),4) share_billed_67,
 count(*) n
FROM b GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr

WITH b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, i.amount+i.freight AS billed, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on < '2025-01-01')
SELECT CASE WHEN paid-due<=0 THEN 'a: on time' WHEN paid-due<=7 THEN 'b: 1-7' WHEN paid-due<=15 THEN 'c: 8-15' WHEN paid-due<=30 THEN 'd: 16-30' WHEN paid-due<=60 THEN 'e: 31-60' ELSE 'f: >60' END bucket,
 count(*) n, round(sum(billed),0) billed, round(sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0))/sum(sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0))) OVER (),4) share_dd,
 round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE customer_id IN (6,7))*1.0/count(*),4) share_n_67
FROM b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH sc AS (
 SELECT s.job_id, sum(s.quantity) spcs FROM shop_scrap_reports s
 WHERE s.reason_code IN ('dimension out of tolerance','operator error') GROUP BY 1),
jb AS (
 SELECT j.part_id, j.job_id, j.quantity, coalesce(sc.spcs,0) spcs, l.unit_price, p.family, p.material,
  row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY j.part_id ORDER BY j.released_on, j.job_id) runno
 FROM erp_jobs j LEFT JOIN sc USING(job_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=j.line_id JOIN erp_customer_parts p ON p.part_id=j.part_id
 WHERE j.kind='order' AND j.released_on IS NOT NULL)
SELECT 'family' dim, CAST(family AS VARCHAR) k, count(*) jobs, sum(quantity) pcs, sum(spcs) s, round(sum(spcs)/sum(quantity),5) rate, round(sum(spcs*unit_price),0) sval FROM jb GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'material', material, count(*), sum(quantity), sum(spcs), round(sum(spcs)/sum(quantity),5), round(sum(spcs*unit_price),0) FROM jb GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'run', CASE WHEN runno=1 THEN '1 first' WHEN runno<=3 THEN '2 run2-3' ELSE '3 run4+' END, count(*), sum(quantity), sum(spcs), round(sum(spcs)/sum(quantity),5), round(sum(spcs*unit_price),0) FROM jb GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH rev AS (SELECT sl.job_id, sum(i.amount) rev, max(year(i.invoiced_on::DATE)) yr FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material<>'outside processing' GROUP BY 1),
lab AS (SELECT job_id, sum(hours) hrs FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
lr AS (SELECT g.yr, g.conv/l.h rate FROM (SELECT substr(period,1,4)::INT yr, -sum(amount) conv FROM erp_general_ledger WHERE account IN ('direct labour','indirect labour','benefits and payroll taxes','shop overhead') GROUP BY 1) g JOIN (SELECT year(work_date::DATE) yr, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1) l USING(yr)),
jj AS (SELECT rev.yr, p.family, CASE WHEN j.quantity<=5 THEN 'a 1-5' WHEN j.quantity<=10 THEN 'b 6-10' WHEN j.quantity<=25 THEN 'c 11-25' WHEN j.quantity<=50 THEN 'd 26-50' WHEN j.quantity<=100 THEN 'e 51-100' ELSE 'f 100+' END qb, rev, coalesce(mat,0) mat, coalesce(hrs,0) hrs FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_customer_parts p USING(part_id) JOIN rev USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN lab USING(job_id)),
cell AS (SELECT yr, family, qb, count(*) jobs, sum(rev) rev, sum(mat) mat, sum(hrs) hrs FROM jj GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT cell.yr, round(lr.rate,1) loaded, count(*) cells, sum(CASE WHEN (rev-mat)/hrs<lr.rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cells_below, sum(CASE WHEN (rev-mat)/hrs<lr.rate THEN jobs ELSE 0 END) jobs_below, sum(jobs) jobs, round(sum(CASE WHEN (rev-mat)/hrs<lr.rate THEN rev ELSE 0 END)) rev_below, round(sum(rev)) rev, round(sum(CASE WHEN (rev-mat)/hrs<lr.rate THEN lr.rate*hrs-(rev-mat) ELSE 0 END)) shortfall
FROM cell JOIN lr USING(yr) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat, max(CASE WHEN pl.material='carbon' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) is_carbon
  FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material <> 'outside processing' GROUP BY po.job_id),
shp AS (SELECT sl.job_id, min(s.shipped_on) first_ship, sum(sl.quantity*l.unit_price) po_val, sum(i.amount) inv
  FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY sl.job_id),
lines AS (SELECT l.line_id, l.unit_price, lag(l.unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY l.part_id ORDER BY o.order_date, l.line_id) prev_price
  FROM erp_so_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id)),
base AS (SELECT substr(first_ship,1,4)::int yr, CASE WHEN coalesce(is_carbon,0)=1 THEN 'carbon' ELSE 'other' END mat_grp,
  CASE WHEN prev_price IS NULL THEN 'first' WHEN abs(unit_price-prev_price)<0.005 THEN 'repeat_same' ELSE 'repeat_changed' END grp,
  po_val, inv, coalesce(mat,0) mat FROM shp JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN lines USING(line_id) LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order'),
bl AS (SELECT mat_grp, sum(mat)/sum(po_val) b FROM base WHERE yr BETWEEN 2016 AND 2020 GROUP BY 1),
ex AS (SELECT yr, mat_grp, grp, b, sum(mat - b*po_val) excess, sum(inv-po_val) uplift, count(*) jobs, sum(po_val) pv, sum(mat) m FROM base JOIN bl USING(mat_grp) GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT yr, round(max(CASE WHEN mat_grp='carbon' THEN b END),4) b_carbon, round(max(CASE WHEN mat_grp='other' THEN b END),4) b_other,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN mat_grp='other' THEN m END)/sum(CASE WHEN mat_grp='other' THEN pv END),4) share_other, sum(CASE WHEN mat_grp='other' THEN jobs END) jobs_other,
 round(sum(excess)) excess_total, round(sum(CASE WHEN mat_grp='carbon' THEN excess END)) excess_carbon,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN mat_grp='carbon' AND grp='repeat_same' THEN excess END)) excess_carbon_rep_same,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN mat_grp='carbon' AND grp='repeat_same' THEN excess END)/sum(excess),4) share_rep_same,
 round(sum(uplift)) uplift, round(sum(uplift)/sum(excess),4) uplift_cover, round(sum(excess)-sum(uplift)) net_unrecovered
FROM ex GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr

WITH b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, year(CAST(i.invoiced_on AS DATE)) yr, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, i.amount+i.freight AS billed, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on < '2025-01-01'),
cy AS (SELECT customer_id, yr, count(*) n, sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0))/sum(billed) w FROM b GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>=30)
SELECT a.yr, count(*) n_cust, round(corr(a.w, c.w),3) corr_next_yr, round(corr(a.w,c.w) FILTER (WHERE a.customer_id NOT IN (6,7)),3) corr_excl67
FROM cy a JOIN cy c ON c.customer_id=a.customer_id AND c.yr=a.yr+1 GROUP BY a.yr ORDER BY a.yr

WITH sc AS (
 SELECT op_id, sum(quantity) spcs, sum(CASE WHEN reason_code IN ('dimension out of tolerance','operator error') THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) s2 FROM shop_scrap_reports GROUP BY 1),
o AS (SELECT o.work_centre, j.quantity, coalesce(sc.spcs,0) spcs, coalesce(sc.s2,0) s2, l.unit_price
 FROM erp_job_operations o JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=j.line_id LEFT JOIN sc USING(op_id) WHERE j.kind='order')
SELECT work_centre, count(*) ops, sum(quantity) pcs_through, sum(s2) dot_oe_pcs, round(sum(s2)/sum(quantity),5) dot_oe_rate, round(sum(s2*unit_price),0) dot_oe_val,
 round(sum(s2*unit_price)/sum(sum(s2*unit_price)) OVER (),4) share_val, sum(spcs) all_pcs
FROM o GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY dot_oe_val DESC

WITH b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, i.amount+i.freight AS billed, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on < '2025-01-01'),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(billed) billed, sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) dd, sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0))/sum(billed) w, count(*) n FROM b GROUP BY 1)
SELECT CASE WHEN w>30 THEN 'a >30' WHEN w>20 THEN 'b 20-30' WHEN w>10 THEN 'c 10-20' ELSE 'd <=10' END band, count(*) n_cust, sum(n) n_inv,
 round(sum(billed)/sum(sum(billed)) OVER (),4) share_billed, round(sum(dd)/sum(sum(dd)) OVER (),4) share_dd
FROM c GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH rev AS (SELECT sl.job_id, sum(i.amount) rev, max(year(i.invoiced_on::DATE)) yr FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material<>'outside processing' GROUP BY 1),
lab AS (SELECT job_id, sum(hours) hrs FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
jj AS (SELECT rev.yr, p.family, CASE WHEN j.quantity<=5 THEN 'a 1-5' WHEN j.quantity<=10 THEN 'b 6-10' WHEN j.quantity<=25 THEN 'c 11-25' WHEN j.quantity<=50 THEN 'd 26-50' WHEN j.quantity<=100 THEN 'e 51-100' ELSE 'f 100+' END qb, rev, coalesce(mat,0) mat, coalesce(hrs,0) hrs FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_customer_parts p USING(part_id) JOIN rev USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN lab USING(job_id))
SELECT family, qb, count(*) jobs, round(sum(rev)) rev, round(sum(mat)/sum(rev),3) mat_share, round((sum(rev)-sum(mat))/sum(hrs),1) va_h, round((SELECT (sum(rev)-sum(mat))/sum(hrs) FROM jj j2 WHERE j2.family=jj.family AND j2.qb=jj.qb AND j2.yr<>2021),1) va_h_other_years
FROM jj WHERE yr=2021 GROUP BY ALL HAVING (sum(rev)-sum(mat))/sum(hrs) < 124.0 ORDER BY family, qb

WITH p AS (SELECT substr(po.ordered_on,1,4) yr, sum(pl.amount)/sum(pl.pounds) ppl, count(*) n FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material='carbon' GROUP BY 1),
l AS (SELECT l.part_id, substr(o.order_date,1,4) yr, o.order_date, l.line_id, l.unit_price FROM erp_so_lines l JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id)),
ref AS (SELECT part_id, arg_max(unit_price, order_date || lpad(line_id::varchar,8,'0')) p2020 FROM l WHERE yr='2020' GROUP BY part_id),
idx AS (SELECT yr, median(unit_price/p2020) med_ratio, avg(unit_price/p2020) avg_ratio, count(*) n_lines, avg(CASE WHEN abs(unit_price-p2020)<0.005 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) share_unchanged FROM l JOIN ref USING(part_id) WHERE yr>='2020' GROUP BY yr),
f AS (SELECT substr(month,1,4) yr, avg(value) v FROM external_fred_monthly WHERE series=(SELECT min(series) FROM external_fred_monthly WHERE lower(label) LIKE '%steel%') GROUP BY 1)
SELECT p.yr, round(p.ppl,4) carbon_ppl, p.n, round(f.v,1) fred_steel, round(idx.med_ratio,4) med_price_vs2020, round(idx.avg_ratio,4) avg_price_vs2020, round(idx.share_unchanged,4) share_unchanged, idx.n_lines
FROM p LEFT JOIN f USING(yr) LEFT JOIN idx USING(yr) ORDER BY p.yr

WITH b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, year(CAST(i.invoiced_on AS DATE)) yr, i.amount+i.freight AS billed, p.amount paid_amt FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on < '2025-01-01')
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_amt < billed-0.01) n_short, round(sum(billed-paid_amt) FILTER (WHERE paid_amt < billed-0.01),2) short_total,
 count(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE paid_amt < billed-0.01) n_cust_short,
 round(sum(billed-paid_amt) FILTER (WHERE paid_amt < billed-0.01 AND customer_id IN (6,7)) / sum(billed-paid_amt) FILTER (WHERE paid_amt < billed-0.01),4) share_short_67,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_amt < billed-0.01 AND customer_id IN (6,7)) n_short_67,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE customer_id IN (6,7)) n_67,
 round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_amt < billed-0.01)*1.0/count(*),4) rate_short_all,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_amt > billed+0.01) n_over
FROM b

WITH rev AS (SELECT sl.job_id, sum(i.amount) rev, max(year(i.invoiced_on::DATE)) yr FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material<>'outside processing' GROUP BY 1),
lab AS (SELECT job_id, sum(hours) hrs FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
lr AS (SELECT g.yr, g.conv/l.h rate FROM (SELECT substr(period,1,4)::INT yr, -sum(amount) conv FROM erp_general_ledger WHERE account IN ('direct labour','indirect labour','benefits and payroll taxes','shop overhead') GROUP BY 1) g JOIN (SELECT year(work_date::DATE) yr, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1) l USING(yr)),
jj AS (SELECT rev.yr, p.family, j.quantity<=5 small, rev, coalesce(mat,0) mat, coalesce(hrs,0) hrs FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_customer_parts p USING(part_id) JOIN rev USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN lab USING(job_id))
SELECT yr, round(rate,1) loaded, count(*) FILTER (WHERE family=6 AND small) f6s_jobs, round(sum(rev) FILTER (WHERE family=6 AND small)) f6s_rev,
 round((sum(rev-mat) FILTER (WHERE family=6 AND small))/(sum(hrs) FILTER (WHERE family=6 AND small)),1) f6s_va_h,
 round((sum(rev-mat) FILTER (WHERE family=6))/(sum(hrs) FILTER (WHERE family=6)),1) f6_va_h,
 round((sum(rev-mat) FILTER (WHERE small))/(sum(hrs) FILTER (WHERE small)),1) small_va_h,
 round(sum(rev-mat)/sum(hrs),1) all_va_h
FROM jj JOIN lr USING(yr) GROUP BY yr, rate ORDER BY yr

WITH le AS (
 SELECT e.employee_id, year(CAST(e.work_date AS DATE)) yr, e.qty_good, e.qty_scrap, l.unit_price
 FROM shop_labour_entries e JOIN erp_jobs j ON j.job_id=e.job_id JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=j.line_id WHERE e.rework=0),
emp AS (SELECT employee_id, sum(qty_good+qty_scrap) pcs, sum(qty_scrap) s, sum(qty_scrap*unit_price) sval, sum((qty_good+qty_scrap)*unit_price) pval FROM le GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sval DESC, employee_id) rs, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY pval DESC, employee_id) rp, count(*) OVER () n FROM emp WHERE pcs>0),
h AS (SELECT employee_id, CASE WHEN yr<=2020 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END hf, sum(qty_good+qty_scrap) p, sum(qty_scrap) s FROM le GROUP BY 1,2),
w AS (SELECT a.employee_id, a.s/a.p r1, b.s/b.p r2 FROM h a JOIN h b ON a.employee_id=b.employee_id AND a.hf=1 AND b.hf=2 WHERE a.p>=5000 AND b.p>=5000)
SELECT max(n) employees, round(sum(CASE WHEN rs<=n*0.1 THEN sval END)/sum(sval),4) top10_share_scrapval,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN rs<=n*0.1 THEN pval END)/sum(pval),4) same_emps_share_prodval,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN rp<=n*0.1 THEN sval END)/sum(sval),4) top10prod_emps_share_scrapval,
 round(min(s/pcs) FILTER (WHERE pcs>=10000),5) min_rate_10k, round(max(s/pcs) FILTER (WHERE pcs>=10000),5) max_rate_10k,
 round(quantile_cont(s/pcs,0.1) FILTER (WHERE pcs>=10000),5) p10, round(quantile_cont(s/pcs,0.9) FILTER (WHERE pcs>=10000),5) p90,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE pcs>=10000) n10k,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM w) both_halves, (SELECT round(corr(r1,r2),4) FROM w) corr_halves
FROM r

WITH b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, month(CAST(i.invoiced_on AS DATE)) mo, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, i.amount+i.freight AS billed, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on < '2025-01-01'),
q AS (SELECT *, ntile(4) OVER (ORDER BY billed, customer_id, due) sz FROM b)
SELECT 'size_q'||sz k, count(*) n, round(min(billed),0) lo, round(max(billed),0) hi, round(avg(greatest(paid-due,0)),2) avg_late, round(avg(greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE customer_id NOT IN (6,7)),2) avg_late_excl67 FROM q GROUP BY sz
UNION ALL
SELECT 'month_'||lpad(mo::VARCHAR,2,'0'), count(*), NULL, NULL, round(avg(greatest(paid-due,0)),2), round(avg(greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE customer_id NOT IN (6,7)),2) FROM b GROUP BY mo
ORDER BY 1

SELECT rework, count(*) n, sum(qty_good) good, sum(qty_scrap) scrap, sum(CASE WHEN qty_scrap>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_scrap, sum(CASE WHEN isnan(hours) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nanh, sum(CASE WHEN qty_scrap IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nullscrap FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT DISTINCT series, label FROM external_fred_monthly WHERE lower(label) LIKE '%steel%' OR lower(label) LIKE '%alumin%' ORDER BY series

WITH mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat, min(po.ordered_on) first_po FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material='carbon' GROUP BY po.job_id),
shp AS (SELECT sl.job_id, sum(sl.quantity*l.unit_price) po_val, sum(i.amount) inv, sum(CASE WHEN i.amount > sl.quantity*l.unit_price*1.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_upl, count(*) n_inv
  FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY sl.job_id)
SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,4)||'Q'||((substr(o.order_date,6,2)::int-1)//3+1) q, count(*) jobs, round(sum(mat)/sum(po_val),4) carbon_share,
 round(sum(mat-0.2572*po_val)) excess, round(sum(inv-po_val)) uplift, sum(n_upl) inv_with_uplift, sum(n_inv) invoices
FROM mat JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN shp USING(job_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id)
WHERE j.kind='order' AND o.order_date >= '2020-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, i.amount+i.freight AS billed, p.amount paid_amt, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on < '2025-01-01'),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0))/sum(billed) w, sum(billed) billed, sum(CASE WHEN paid_amt<billed-0.01 THEN billed-paid_amt ELSE 0 END) short FROM b GROUP BY 1)
SELECT round(sum(short) FILTER (WHERE w>30)/sum(short),4) share_short_late30, round(sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE w>30)/sum(billed),4) share_billed_late30,
 round(corr(w, short/billed),3) corr_late_shortrate, count(*) n_cust FROM c

WITH rev AS (SELECT sl.job_id, min(i.customer_id) cust, sum(i.amount) rev, max(year(i.invoiced_on::DATE)) yr FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material<>'outside processing' GROUP BY 1),
lab AS (SELECT job_id, sum(hours) hrs FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
lr AS (SELECT g.yr, g.conv/l.h rate FROM (SELECT substr(period,1,4)::INT yr, -sum(amount) conv FROM erp_general_ledger WHERE account IN ('direct labour','indirect labour','benefits and payroll taxes','shop overhead') GROUP BY 1) g JOIN (SELECT year(work_date::DATE) yr, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1) l USING(yr)),
cy AS (SELECT cust, yr, sum(rev) rev, sum(coalesce(mat,0)) mat, sum(coalesce(hrs,0)) hrs FROM erp_jobs j JOIN rev USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN lab USING(job_id) GROUP BY ALL),
f AS (SELECT cy.*, (rev-mat)/hrs < rate below, rate*hrs-(rev-mat) gap FROM cy JOIN lr USING(yr) WHERE rev>=100000),
pc AS (SELECT cust, count(*) yrs, sum(below::INT) yrs_below, sum(CASE WHEN below THEN gap END) gap FROM f GROUP BY cust)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM f) cust_years_ge100k, (SELECT sum(below::INT) FROM f) cust_years_below, (SELECT sum(below::INT) FROM f WHERE yr=2021) below_in_2021, (SELECT round(sum(CASE WHEN below THEN rev END)) FROM f) rev_below, (SELECT round(sum(CASE WHEN below THEN gap END)) FROM f) gap_below,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM pc WHERE yrs_below>=2) cust_below_2plus_yrs, (SELECT count(*) FROM pc WHERE yrs_below>=3) cust_below_3plus_yrs, (SELECT max(yrs_below) FROM pc) max_yrs_below

WITH rw AS (SELECT op_id, employee_id, qty_scrap FROM shop_labour_entries WHERE rework=1),
orig AS (SELECT op_id, employee_id, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY op_id) FROM shop_labour_entries WHERE rework=0 GROUP BY op_id, employee_id),
ne AS (SELECT op_id, count(DISTINCT employee_id) n_emp FROM shop_labour_entries WHERE rework=0 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) rework_entries,
 sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orig o WHERE o.op_id=rw.op_id AND o.employee_id=rw.employee_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) same_emp_did_original,
 sum(CASE WHEN ne.n_emp=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) op_has_single_original_emp,
 sum(CASE WHEN ne.op_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_original_entry
FROM rw LEFT JOIN ne USING(op_id)

WITH b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, i.amount+i.freight AS billed, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on < '2025-01-01'),
t AS (SELECT sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) dd, sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE customer_id IN (6,7)) dd67, sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE customer_id IN (6,7)) b67,
 sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE customer_id NOT IN (6,7))/sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE customer_id NOT IN (6,7)) w_rest, (DATE '2025-01-01' - DATE '2016-01-01') ndays FROM b)
SELECT ndays, round(dd/ndays,0) excess_ar_all, round(dd/ndays*0.08,0) carry_all_8pct,
 round(dd67/ndays,0) excess_ar_67, round((dd67 - b67*w_rest)/ndays,0) excess_ar_67_above_rest, round((dd67 - b67*w_rest)/ndays*0.08,0) carry_67_above_rest_8pct, round(w_rest,2) w_rest
FROM t

WITH mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material='carbon' GROUP BY po.job_id),
shp AS (SELECT sl.job_id, min(s.shipped_on) fs, sum(sl.quantity*l.unit_price) po_val FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) GROUP BY sl.job_id),
b AS (SELECT o.customer_id, c.segment, substr(fs,1,4) yr, mat, po_val FROM mat JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN shp USING(job_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE j.kind='order'),
seg AS (SELECT segment, round(sum(CASE WHEN yr BETWEEN '2016' AND '2020' THEN mat END)/sum(CASE WHEN yr BETWEEN '2016' AND '2020' THEN po_val END),4) s1620,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN yr IN ('2021','2022') THEN mat END)/sum(CASE WHEN yr IN ('2021','2022') THEN po_val END),4) s2122,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN yr IN ('2024','2025') THEN mat END)/sum(CASE WHEN yr IN ('2024','2025') THEN po_val END),4) s2425,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN yr IN ('2021','2022') THEN mat-0.2572*po_val END)) ex2122 FROM b GROUP BY 1),
cust AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(mat-0.2572*po_val) ex FROM b WHERE yr IN ('2021','2022') GROUP BY 1),
top AS (SELECT round(sum(ex) FILTER (WHERE rk<=10)/sum(ex),4) top10_share, count(*) n_cust, sum(CASE WHEN ex>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_pos FROM (SELECT ex, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ex DESC, customer_id) rk FROM cust))
SELECT s.*, t.* FROM seg s, top t ORDER BY segment

WITH rev AS (SELECT sl.job_id, sum(i.amount) rev, max(year(i.invoiced_on::DATE)) yr FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material<>'outside processing' GROUP BY 1),
lab AS (SELECT job_id, sum(hours) hrs FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
lr AS (SELECT g.yr, g.conv/l.h rate FROM (SELECT substr(period,1,4)::INT yr, -sum(amount) conv FROM erp_general_ledger WHERE account IN ('direct labour','indirect labour','benefits and payroll taxes','shop overhead') GROUP BY 1) g JOIN (SELECT year(work_date::DATE) yr, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1) l USING(yr)),
jb AS (SELECT j.part_id, rev.yr, rev, coalesce(mat,0) mat, coalesce(hrs,0) hrs, coalesce(hrs,0)*rate conv FROM erp_jobs j JOIN rev USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN lab USING(job_id) JOIN lr USING(yr)),
p AS (SELECT part_id, count(DISTINCT yr) yrs, count(*) jobs, sum(rev) rev, sum(rev-mat-conv) contrib FROM jb GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) parts_3yrs_50k, round(sum(rev)) rev, sum((contrib<0)::INT) parts_loss, round(sum(CASE WHEN contrib<0 THEN rev END)) rev_loss_parts, round(sum(CASE WHEN contrib<0 THEN contrib END)) loss_total, round(sum(CASE WHEN contrib<0 THEN rev END)/sum(rev),4) share_rev_loss,
 (SELECT round(sum(rev-mat-conv)) FROM jb) all_jobs_contrib, (SELECT round(sum(CASE WHEN rev-mat-conv<0 THEN rev-mat-conv END)) FROM jb) job_level_negatives, (SELECT sum((rev-mat-conv<0)::INT) FROM jb) jobs_negative, (SELECT count(*) FROM jb) jobs
FROM p WHERE yrs>=3 AND rev>=50000

WITH b AS (SELECT i.customer_id IN (6,7) g67, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, CAST(i.invoiced_on AS DATE) inv, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on < '2025-01-01')
SELECT g67, count(*) n, quantile_cont(paid-due,0.1) p10_late, median(paid-due) med_late, quantile_cont(paid-due,0.9) p90_late, median(paid-inv) med_days_to_pay,
 round(count(DISTINCT paid)*1.0/count(*),4) distinct_paydates_per_inv, round(avg(CASE WHEN dayofweek(paid) IN (0,6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),4) weekend_share
FROM b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH le AS (
 SELECT e.employee_id, year(CAST(e.work_date AS DATE)) yr, e.qty_good, e.qty_scrap, l.unit_price
 FROM shop_labour_entries e JOIN erp_jobs j ON j.job_id=e.job_id JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=j.line_id),
emp AS (SELECT employee_id, sum(qty_good+qty_scrap) pcs, sum(qty_scrap) s, sum(qty_scrap*unit_price) sval, sum((qty_good+qty_scrap)*unit_price) pval FROM le GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sval DESC, employee_id) rs, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY pval DESC, employee_id) rp, count(*) OVER () n FROM emp WHERE pcs>0),
h AS (SELECT employee_id, CASE WHEN yr<=2020 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END hf, sum(qty_good+qty_scrap) p, sum(qty_scrap) s FROM le GROUP BY 1,2),
w AS (SELECT a.employee_id, a.s/a.p r1, b.s/b.p r2 FROM h a JOIN h b ON a.employee_id=b.employee_id AND a.hf=1 AND b.hf=2 WHERE a.p>=5000 AND b.p>=5000)
SELECT max(n) employees, round(sum(CASE WHEN rs<=n*0.1 THEN sval END)/sum(sval),4) top10_share_scrapval,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN rs<=n*0.1 THEN pval END)/sum(pval),4) same_emps_share_prodval,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN rp<=n*0.1 THEN sval END)/sum(sval),4) top10prod_emps_share_scrapval,
 round(sum(s)/sum(pcs),5) overall_rate,
 round(quantile_cont(s/pcs,0.1) FILTER (WHERE pcs>=10000),5) p10_rate_10k, round(quantile_cont(s/pcs,0.9) FILTER (WHERE pcs>=10000),5) p90_rate_10k,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE pcs>=10000) n10k,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM w) both_halves, (SELECT round(corr(r1,r2),4) FROM w) corr_halves
FROM r

WITH b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, i.amount+i.freight AS billed, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on < '2025-01-01' AND i.customer_id NOT IN (6,7)),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(billed) billed, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE paid-due>30) n30, sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE paid-due>30) dd30 FROM b GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) n_cust, sum(n30) n_inv_over30, round(sum(n30)*1.0/sum(n),4) rate_over30,
 round(corr(n30*1.0/n, billed),3) corr_rate_size, round(stddev_samp(n30*1.0/n) FILTER (WHERE n>=200),4) sd_rate_big, round(avg(n30*1.0/n) FILTER (WHERE n>=200),4) mean_rate_big, count(*) FILTER (WHERE n>=200) n_big,
 round(min(n30*1.0/n) FILTER (WHERE n>=200),4) min_rate_big, round(max(n30*1.0/n) FILTER (WHERE n>=200),4) max_rate_big
FROM c

WITH rev AS (SELECT sl.job_id, sum(i.amount) rev, max(year(i.invoiced_on::DATE)) yr FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material<>'outside processing' GROUP BY 1),
lab AS (SELECT job_id, sum(hours) hrs FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
lr AS (SELECT g.yr, g.conv/l.h rate FROM (SELECT substr(period,1,4)::INT yr, -sum(amount) conv FROM erp_general_ledger WHERE account IN ('direct labour','indirect labour','benefits and payroll taxes','shop overhead') GROUP BY 1) g JOIN (SELECT year(work_date::DATE) yr, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1) l USING(yr)),
jb AS (SELECT j.part_id, j.quantity, rev.yr, rev, coalesce(mat,0) mat, coalesce(hrs,0)*rate conv FROM erp_jobs j JOIN rev USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN lab USING(job_id) JOIN lr USING(yr)),
p AS (SELECT part_id, count(DISTINCT yr) yrs, sum(rev) rev, sum(rev-mat-conv) contrib, sum(CASE WHEN yr<>2021 THEN rev-mat-conv END) contrib_ex2021, median(quantity) mq FROM jb GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT yr)>=3 AND sum(rev)>=50000 AND sum(rev-mat-conv)<0)
SELECT cp.family, count(*) parts, count(DISTINCT cp.customer_id) customers, round(sum(rev)) rev, round(sum(contrib)) contrib, round(sum(contrib_ex2021)) contrib_ex2021, sum((contrib_ex2021<0)::INT) parts_neg_ex2021, round(median(mq),1) med_qty FROM p JOIN erp_customer_parts cp USING(part_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material='carbon' GROUP BY po.job_id),
shp AS (SELECT sl.job_id, min(s.shipped_on) fs, sum(sl.quantity*l.unit_price) po_val, sum(i.amount) inv FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY sl.job_id),
b AS (SELECT substr(fs,1,4)::int yr, mat, po_val, inv FROM mat JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN shp USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order'),
bl AS (SELECT sum(mat)/sum(po_val) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2016 AND 2020) b1620, sum(mat) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2017 AND 2020)/sum(po_val) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2017 AND 2020) b1720 FROM b),
y AS (SELECT yr, sum(mat - b1620*po_val) - sum(inv-po_val) net1620, sum(mat - b1720*po_val) - sum(inv-po_val) net1720, sum(inv-po_val) upl FROM b, bl GROUP BY yr)
SELECT round((SELECT b1620 FROM bl),4) b1620, round((SELECT b1720 FROM bl),4) b1720,
 round(avg(net1620) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023)) net_2123_avg_b1620,
 round(avg(net1720) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023)) net_2123_avg_b1720,
 round(sum(net1620) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023)) net_2123_total,
 round(avg(net1620) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2024 AND 2025)) net_2425_avg_b1620,
 round(avg(net1720) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2024 AND 2025)) net_2425_avg_b1720,
 round(sum(upl) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023)) upl_2123
FROM y

WITH b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, CAST(i.invoiced_on AS DATE) inv, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, i.amount+i.freight AS billed, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on >= '2021-07-01' AND i.invoiced_on < '2023-07-01' AND i.customer_id NOT IN (6,7))
SELECT strftime(inv,'%Y-H')||CASE WHEN month(inv)<=6 THEN '1' ELSE '2' END half, count(*) n, round(sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0))/sum(billed),2) w_late, round(avg(CASE WHEN paid-due>30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),4) rate_over30, count(DISTINCT customer_id) n_cust
FROM b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH le AS (
 SELECT e.employee_id, o.work_centre, CASE WHEN year(CAST(e.work_date AS DATE))<=2020 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END hf, e.qty_good+e.qty_scrap p, e.qty_scrap s
 FROM shop_labour_entries e JOIN erp_job_operations o ON o.op_id=e.op_id),
wc AS (SELECT work_centre, hf, sum(s)/sum(p) wr FROM le GROUP BY 1,2),
eh AS (SELECT le.employee_id, le.hf, sum(le.p) p, sum(le.s) s, sum(le.p*wc.wr) e FROM le JOIN wc USING(work_centre,hf) GROUP BY 1,2),
w AS (SELECT a.employee_id, a.s/a.e oe1, b.s/b.e oe2, a.p+b.p p FROM eh a JOIN eh b ON a.employee_id=b.employee_id AND a.hf=1 AND b.hf=2 WHERE a.p>=5000 AND b.p>=5000),
al AS (SELECT employee_id, sum(p) p, sum(s) s, sum(e) e FROM eh GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(p)>=10000)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM w) n_both, (SELECT round(corr(oe1,oe2),4) FROM w) corr_oe_halves,
 count(*) n10k, round(quantile_cont(s/e,0.1),3) p10_oe, round(quantile_cont(s/e,0.5),3) p50_oe, round(quantile_cont(s/e,0.9),3) p90_oe, round(max(s/e),3) max_oe,
 sum(CASE WHEN s/e>=1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_oe_ge_1_5, sum(CASE WHEN s/e>=1.5 THEN s-e ELSE 0 END) excess_pcs_ge1_5, sum(s) total_scrap
FROM al

WITH r AS (SELECT o.customer_id, sum(sl.quantity*l.unit_price) v FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) WHERE substr(s.shipped_on,1,4) IN ('2021','2022') GROUP BY 1)
SELECT round(sum(v) FILTER (WHERE rk<=10)/sum(v),4) top10_rev_share, count(*) n FROM (SELECT v, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY v DESC, customer_id) rk FROM r)

SELECT round(82954/10.0,1) persistent_part_loss_per_yr, round(82954/182122172.0*100,3) pct_of_rev_in_tested_parts, round(122607/26182750.0*100,3) cell_shortfall_2021_pct_rev, round(3677204/10.0) job_negatives_per_yr

WITH le AS (
 SELECT e.employee_id, o.work_centre, CASE WHEN year(CAST(e.work_date AS DATE))<=2020 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END hf, e.qty_good+e.qty_scrap p, e.qty_scrap s
 FROM shop_labour_entries e JOIN erp_job_operations o ON o.op_id=e.op_id),
wc AS (SELECT work_centre, hf, CASE WHEN sum(p)>0 THEN sum(s)/sum(p) ELSE 0 END wr FROM le GROUP BY 1,2),
eh AS (SELECT le.employee_id, le.hf, sum(le.p) p, sum(le.s) s, sum(le.p*wc.wr) e FROM le JOIN wc USING(work_centre,hf) GROUP BY 1,2),
w AS (SELECT a.employee_id, a.s/a.e oe1, b.s/b.e oe2 FROM eh a JOIN eh b ON a.employee_id=b.employee_id AND a.hf=1 AND b.hf=2 WHERE a.e>=20 AND b.e>=20),
al AS (SELECT employee_id, sum(p) p, sum(s) s, sum(e) e FROM eh GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(e)>=50)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM w) n_both, (SELECT round(corr(oe1,oe2),4) FROM w) corr_oe_halves,
 count(*) n_emp, round(quantile_cont(s/e,0.1),3) p10_oe, round(quantile_cont(s/e,0.5),3) p50_oe, round(quantile_cont(s/e,0.9),3) p90_oe, round(max(s/e),3) max_oe,
 sum(CASE WHEN s/e>=1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_oe_ge_1_5, round(sum(CASE WHEN s/e>=1.5 THEN s-e ELSE 0 END),0) excess_pcs_ge1_5,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN s>e THEN s-e ELSE 0 END),0) excess_all_above1, sum(s) scrap_these, round(sum(e),0) exp_these
FROM al

WITH mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material='carbon' GROUP BY po.job_id),
shp AS (SELECT sl.job_id, min(s.shipped_on) fs, sum(sl.quantity*l.unit_price) po_val, sum(i.amount) inv FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY sl.job_id),
b AS (SELECT substr(fs,1,4)::int yr, mat, po_val, inv FROM mat JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN shp USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order'),
bl AS (SELECT sum(mat) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2016 AND 2020)/sum(po_val) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2016 AND 2020) b1620, sum(mat) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2017 AND 2020)/sum(po_val) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2017 AND 2020) b1720 FROM b),
y AS (SELECT yr, sum(mat - b1620*po_val) ex1620, sum(mat - b1620*po_val) - sum(inv-po_val) net1620, sum(mat - b1720*po_val) - sum(inv-po_val) net1720, sum(inv-po_val) upl FROM b, bl GROUP BY yr)
SELECT round((SELECT b1620 FROM bl),4) b1620, round((SELECT b1720 FROM bl),4) b1720,
 round(sum(ex1620) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023)) ex_2123_total,
 round(sum(upl) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023)) upl_2123,
 round(sum(upl) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023)/sum(ex1620) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023),4) cover_2123,
 round(sum(net1620) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023)) net_2123_total,
 round(avg(net1620) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023)) net_2123_avg_b1620,
 round(avg(net1720) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023)) net_2123_avg_b1720,
 round(avg(net1620) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2024 AND 2025)) net_2425_avg_b1620,
 round(avg(net1720) FILTER (WHERE yr BETWEEN 2024 AND 2025)) net_2425_avg_b1720
FROM y

WITH sc AS (SELECT op_id, sum(quantity) s FROM shop_scrap_reports WHERE reason_code IN ('dimension out of tolerance','operator error') GROUP BY 1),
o AS (SELECT j.part_id, o.work_centre, CASE WHEN year(CAST(j.released_on AS DATE))<=2020 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END hf, j.quantity q, coalesce(sc.s,0) s
 FROM erp_job_operations o JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN sc USING(op_id) WHERE j.kind='order' AND j.released_on IS NOT NULL),
wc AS (SELECT work_centre, hf, sum(s)/sum(q) wr FROM o GROUP BY 1,2),
ph AS (SELECT part_id, hf, sum(s) s, sum(q*wr) e FROM o JOIN wc USING(work_centre,hf) GROUP BY 1,2),
w AS (SELECT a.part_id, a.s/a.e oe1, b.s/b.e oe2, a.s s1, b.s s2, a.e e1, b.e e2 FROM ph a JOIN ph b ON a.part_id=b.part_id AND a.hf=1 AND b.hf=2 WHERE a.e>=5 AND b.e>=5)
SELECT count(*) n_parts, round(corr(oe1,oe2),4) corr_oe, 
 round(sum(CASE WHEN oe1>=2 THEN s2 END)/sum(CASE WHEN oe1>=2 THEN e2 END),3) h2_oe_of_h1_high, count(*) FILTER (WHERE oe1>=2) n_high,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN oe1<0.5 THEN s2 END)/sum(CASE WHEN oe1<0.5 THEN e2 END),3) h2_oe_of_h1_low, count(*) FILTER (WHERE oe1<0.5) n_low,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN oe1>=2 THEN s2-e2 END),0) h2_excess_pcs_high
FROM w

WITH sc AS (SELECT op_id, sum(quantity) s FROM shop_scrap_reports WHERE reason_code IN ('dimension out of tolerance','operator error') GROUP BY 1),
o AS (SELECT p.family, o.work_centre, j.quantity q, coalesce(sc.s,0) s
 FROM erp_job_operations o JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN erp_customer_parts p ON p.part_id=j.part_id LEFT JOIN sc USING(op_id) WHERE j.kind='order'),
wc AS (SELECT work_centre, sum(s)/sum(q) wr FROM o GROUP BY 1)
SELECT family, sum(s) scrap_pcs, round(sum(q*wr),0) expected_pcs, round(sum(s)/sum(q*wr),3) o_e FROM o JOIN wc USING(work_centre) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH le AS (
 SELECT o.work_centre, e.qty_good+e.qty_scrap p, e.qty_scrap s,
  date_diff('day', CAST(h.hired_on AS DATE), CAST(e.work_date AS DATE)) ten
 FROM shop_labour_entries e JOIN erp_job_operations o ON o.op_id=e.op_id JOIN hr_employees h ON h.employee_id=e.employee_id),
wc AS (SELECT work_centre, CASE WHEN sum(p)>0 THEN sum(s)/sum(p) ELSE 0 END wr FROM le GROUP BY 1)
SELECT CASE WHEN ten<90 THEN '1 <90d' WHEN ten<365 THEN '2 90-364d' WHEN ten<1095 THEN '3 1-3y' ELSE '4 3y+' END tenure,
 count(*) entries, sum(p) pcs, sum(s) scrap, round(sum(p*wr),0) expected, round(sum(s)/sum(p*wr),3) o_e
FROM le JOIN wc USING(work_centre) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH le AS (
 SELECT o.work_centre, e.qty_good+e.qty_scrap p, e.qty_scrap s, l.unit_price up, year(CAST(e.work_date AS DATE)) yr,
  date_diff('day', CAST(h.hired_on AS DATE), CAST(e.work_date AS DATE)) < 365 newbie
 FROM shop_labour_entries e JOIN erp_job_operations o ON o.op_id=e.op_id JOIN hr_employees h ON h.employee_id=e.employee_id
 JOIN erp_jobs j ON j.job_id=e.job_id JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=j.line_id),
wc AS (SELECT work_centre, yr, CASE WHEN sum(p)>0 THEN sum(s)/sum(p) ELSE 0 END wr FROM le WHERE NOT newbie GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT yr, sum(CASE WHEN newbie THEN p END) new_pcs, sum(CASE WHEN newbie THEN s END) new_scrap, round(sum(CASE WHEN newbie THEN p*wr END),0) new_exp_at_tenured,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN newbie THEN s END)/sum(CASE WHEN newbie THEN p*wr END),3) new_o_e,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN newbie THEN (s - p*wr)*up END),0) excess_val, round(sum(s*up),0) all_scrap_val, sum(s) all_scrap_pcs
FROM le LEFT JOIN wc USING(work_centre,yr) GROUP BY ROLLUP(yr) ORDER BY yr NULLS LAST

WITH le AS (
 SELECT j.part_id, o.work_centre, e.qty_good+e.qty_scrap p, e.qty_scrap s,
  date_diff('day', CAST(h.hired_on AS DATE), CAST(e.work_date AS DATE)) < 365 newbie
 FROM shop_labour_entries e JOIN erp_job_operations o ON o.op_id=e.op_id JOIN hr_employees h ON h.employee_id=e.employee_id
 JOIN erp_jobs j ON j.job_id=e.job_id),
pw AS (SELECT part_id, work_centre, sum(s)/sum(p) r, sum(p) tp FROM le WHERE NOT newbie GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING sum(p)>=500)
SELECT newbie, count(*) entries, sum(p) pcs, sum(s) scrap, round(sum(p*r),0) expected, round(sum(s)/sum(p*r),3) o_e
FROM le JOIN pw USING(part_id, work_centre) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH le AS (
 SELECT e.employee_id, o.work_centre, e.qty_good+e.qty_scrap p, e.qty_scrap s,
  date_diff('day', CAST(h.hired_on AS DATE), CAST(e.work_date AS DATE)) < 365 newbie
 FROM shop_labour_entries e JOIN erp_job_operations o ON o.op_id=e.op_id JOIN hr_employees h ON h.employee_id=e.employee_id),
wc AS (SELECT work_centre, CASE WHEN sum(p)>0 THEN sum(s)/sum(p) ELSE 0 END wr FROM le WHERE NOT newbie GROUP BY 1),
ne AS (SELECT employee_id, sum(s) s, sum(p*wr) e FROM le JOIN wc USING(work_centre) WHERE newbie GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(p*wr)>=5)
SELECT count(*) new_hires, sum(CASE WHEN s>e THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) above_expected, round(quantile_cont(s/e,0.5),3) median_oe, round(quantile_cont(s/e,0.25),3) p25, round(quantile_cont(s/e,0.75),3) p75,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN rk<=ceil(n*0.1) THEN s-e END)/sum(s-e),4) top10pct_share_of_excess
FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY s-e DESC, employee_id) rk, count(*) OVER () n FROM ne)

WITH sc AS (SELECT op_id, sum(quantity) s FROM shop_scrap_reports WHERE reason_code IN ('dimension out of tolerance','operator error') GROUP BY 1),
o AS (SELECT j.part_id, o.work_centre, sum(j.quantity*l.unit_price) pv, sum(coalesce(sc.s,0)*l.unit_price) sv
 FROM erp_job_operations o JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=j.line_id LEFT JOIN sc USING(op_id)
 WHERE j.kind='order' AND o.work_centre<>'inspect' GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sv DESC, part_id, work_centre) rs, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY pv DESC, part_id, work_centre) rp, count(*) OVER () n FROM o)
SELECT max(n) combos, sum(CASE WHEN sv>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with_scrap,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN rs<=n*0.1 THEN sv END)/sum(sv),4) top10_scrap_share, round(sum(CASE WHEN rs<=n*0.1 THEN pv END)/sum(pv),4) their_throughput_share,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN rp<=n*0.1 THEN sv END)/sum(sv),4) top10_by_throughput_scrap_share, round(sum(CASE WHEN rp<=n*0.1 THEN pv END)/sum(pv),4) top10_throughput_share
FROM r

WITH e AS (SELECT le.*, o.est_setup_hours+o.est_run_hours est_op FROM shop_labour_entries le LEFT JOIN erp_job_operations o USING(op_id))
SELECT CASE WHEN hours<=12 THEN 'a <=12' WHEN hours<=24 THEN 'b 12-24' WHEN hours<=60 THEN 'c 24-60' ELSE 'd >60' END band, count(*) n, round(sum(hours)) hrs, round(sum(est_op)) est_op_h, round(median(hours/nullif(est_op,0)),3) med_ratio_to_op_est, count(DISTINCT job_id) jobs, count(DISTINCT employee_id) emps, round(avg(overtime),3) ot_share

 round(2474799.0/5787974.0,4) gl_memo_to_labour_scrap_val, round(549713.0/10*2474799.0/5787974.0,0) excess_per_yr_material_basis_approx,
 round(4716749.0/10,0) dot_oe_val_per_yr, round(7940.0/36362,4) new_share_scrap_pcs, round(900795.0/(SELECT sum(qty_good+qty_scrap) FROM shop_labour_entries),4) new_share_pcs

WITH t AS (SELECT year(week_of::DATE) yr, sum(regular_hours+overtime_hours) paid_h FROM hr_timecards GROUP BY 1),
l AS (SELECT year(work_date::DATE) yr, sum(hours) clk, sum(CASE WHEN hours>24 THEN hours ELSE 0 END) big FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
g AS (SELECT substr(period,1,4)::INT yr, sum(CASE WHEN account='revenue' THEN amount END) gl_rev, -sum(CASE WHEN account='material' THEN amount END) gl_mat FROM erp_general_ledger GROUP BY 1),
i AS (SELECT year(invoiced_on::DATE) yr, sum(amount) inv, sum(freight) frt FROM erp_invoices GROUP BY 1),
p AS (SELECT year(ordered_on::DATE) yr, sum(CASE WHEN material<>'outside processing' THEN amount END) po_mat FROM erp_purchase_orders JOIN erp_po_lines USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT yr, round(paid_h) paid_h, round(clk) clocked_h, round(big) big_entry_h, round(clk/paid_h,3) clk_over_paid, round(gl_rev) gl_rev, round(inv) inv, round(frt) inv_freight, round(gl_mat) gl_mat, round(po_mat) po_mat, round(po_mat/gl_mat,3) po_over_gl FROM t JOIN l USING(yr) JOIN g USING(yr) JOIN i USING(yr) JOIN p USING(yr) ORDER BY yr

WITH b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, CAST(i.invoiced_on AS DATE) inv, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, CAST(s.shipped_on AS DATE) shp, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid, i.amount+i.freight billed, p.amount pamt, i.freight ifr, s.freight sfr FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on<'2025-01-01')
SELECT CASE WHEN customer_id IN (6,7) THEN customer_id::VARCHAR ELSE 'rest' END g, count(*) n, round(avg(inv-shp),2) avg_inv_minus_ship, min(inv-shp) mn_lag, max(inv-shp) mx_lag, round(avg(CASE WHEN inv<shp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),4) share_inv_before_ship, round(avg(CASE WHEN abs(ifr-sfr)>0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),4) share_freight_mismatch, round(avg(CASE WHEN pamt < billed-0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),4) share_short, round(avg(CASE WHEN pamt > billed+0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),4) share_over
FROM b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH rw AS (
 SELECT e.op_id, max(CASE WHEN date_diff('day', CAST(h.hired_on AS DATE), CAST(e.work_date AS DATE)) < 365 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) any_new
 FROM shop_labour_entries e JOIN hr_employees h USING(employee_id) WHERE e.rework=1 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.reason_code, sum(CASE WHEN any_new=1 THEN s.quantity ELSE 0 END) pcs_new_ops, sum(CASE WHEN any_new=0 THEN s.quantity ELSE 0 END) pcs_tenured_ops,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN any_new=1 THEN s.quantity ELSE 0 END)*1.0/sum(s.quantity),4) new_share
FROM shop_scrap_reports s JOIN rw USING(op_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, CAST(i.invoiced_on AS DATE) inv, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on<'2025-01-01' AND i.customer_id IN (6,7,8))
SELECT customer_id, dayofweek(paid) dow, count(*) n FROM b GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat, sum(pl.pounds) lbs FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material='carbon' GROUP BY po.job_id),
shp AS (SELECT sl.job_id, min(s.shipped_on) fs, sum(sl.quantity) q, sum(sl.quantity*l.unit_price) po_val, sum(i.amount) inv FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY sl.job_id),
b AS (SELECT j.part_id, substr(fs,1,4)::int yr, j.quantity jq, q, mat, lbs, po_val, inv FROM mat JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN shp USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order')
SELECT yr, count(*) jobs, round(sum(po_val)/sum(q),2) price_per_unit_shipped, round(sum(mat)/sum(q),2) mat_per_unit, round(sum(lbs)/sum(jq),3) lbs_per_job_unit, round(sum(lbs)/sum(q),3) lbs_per_shipped_unit, round(sum(mat)/sum(lbs),4) usd_lb, round(sum(q)::double/sum(jq),4) shipped_over_jobqty, round(sum(mat)/sum(po_val),4) share
FROM b GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr

WITH b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, c.terms_days, CAST(i.invoiced_on AS DATE) inv, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN erp_customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on<'2025-01-01')
SELECT CASE WHEN customer_id IN (6,7) THEN 'c'||customer_id ELSE 'terms'||terms_days END g, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT customer_id) ncust, quantile_cont(paid-inv,0.1) p10_dtp, quantile_cont(paid-inv,0.25) p25_dtp, median(paid-inv) med_dtp, quantile_cont(paid-inv,0.75) p75_dtp, quantile_cont(paid-inv,0.9) p90_dtp, median(paid-due) med_late, round(avg(CASE WHEN paid<=due THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),4) share_on_time
FROM b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on<'2025-01-01')
SELECT CASE WHEN customer_id IN (6,7) THEN '67' ELSE 'rest' END g, CASE WHEN paid-due<=0 THEN '00 <=0' WHEN paid-due<=5 THEN '01 1-5' WHEN paid-due<=10 THEN '02 6-10' WHEN paid-due<=15 THEN '03 11-15' WHEN paid-due<=20 THEN '04 16-20' WHEN paid-due<=25 THEN '05 21-25' WHEN paid-due<=30 THEN '06 26-30' WHEN paid-due<=40 THEN '07 31-40' WHEN paid-due<=50 THEN '08 41-50' WHEN paid-due<=60 THEN '09 51-60' WHEN paid-due<=90 THEN '10 61-90' ELSE '11 >90' END bucket, count(*) n, round(count(*)*1.0/sum(count(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN customer_id IN (6,7) THEN '67' ELSE 'rest' END),4) share

WITH mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat, sum(pl.pounds) lbs FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material='carbon' GROUP BY po.job_id),
shp AS (SELECT sl.job_id, min(s.shipped_on) fs, sum(sl.quantity) q, sum(sl.quantity*l.unit_price) po_val, sum(i.amount) inv FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY sl.job_id),
b AS (SELECT j.part_id, substr(fs,1,4)::int yr, q, mat, lbs, po_val, inv FROM mat JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN shp USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order'),
pp AS (SELECT part_id, yr, sum(q) q, sum(mat)/sum(q) mpu, sum(lbs)/sum(q) lpu, sum(po_val)/sum(q) ppu, sum(inv)/sum(q) ipu FROM b GROUP BY 1,2),
base AS (SELECT * FROM pp WHERE yr=2020)
SELECT p.yr, count(*) parts, round(sum(base.q*base.ppu)) rev2020_basis,
 round(sum(base.q*p.ppu)/sum(base.q*base.ppu),4) price_idx,
 round(sum(base.q*p.mpu)/sum(base.q*base.mpu),4) mat_idx,
 round(sum(base.q*p.lpu)/sum(base.q*base.lpu),4) lbs_idx,
 round(sum(base.q*(p.mpu-base.mpu))) d_mat_at2020qty,
 round(sum(base.q*(p.ipu-base.ppu))) d_inv_at2020qty,
 round(sum(base.q*(p.ipu-base.ppu)) - sum(base.q*(p.mpu-base.mpu))) d_margin_over_mat,
 round(sum(base.q*p.mpu)/sum(base.q*p.ppu),4) share_now, round(sum(base.q*base.mpu)/sum(base.q*base.ppu),4) share_2020
FROM pp p JOIN base USING(part_id) WHERE p.yr>=2020 GROUP BY p.yr ORDER BY p.yr

WITH est AS (SELECT job_id, sum(est_setup_hours) es, sum(est_run_hours) er FROM erp_job_operations GROUP BY 1),
lab AS (SELECT job_id, sum(hours) hrs FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
inv AS (SELECT DISTINCT sl.job_id FROM erp_shipment_lines sl)
SELECT CASE WHEN j.quantity<=5 THEN 'a 1-5' WHEN j.quantity<=10 THEN 'b 6-10' WHEN j.quantity<=25 THEN 'c 11-25' WHEN j.quantity<=50 THEN 'd 26-50' WHEN j.quantity<=100 THEN 'e 51-100' ELSE 'f 100+' END qb, count(*) jobs, round(sum(es)) est_setup, round(sum(er)) est_run, round(sum(es)/sum(es+er),3) setup_share, round(sum(hrs)) clocked, round(sum(hrs)/sum(es+er),3) clocked_over_est

WITH sl AS (SELECT sl.shipment_id, sum(sl.quantity*so.unit_price) po_val, max(sl.partial) partial, count(*) nlines FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_so_lines so USING(line_id) GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT i.invoice_id, i.customer_id, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid, i.amount, i.amount+i.freight billed, p.amount pamt, sl.po_val, sl.partial, (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_credit_memos cm WHERE cm.invoice_id=i.invoice_id) ncm FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) LEFT JOIN sl USING(shipment_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on<'2025-01-01' AND i.customer_id NOT IN (6,7))
SELECT CASE WHEN po_val IS NULL THEN 'no_po' WHEN amount > po_val*1.005 THEN 'inv_above_po' WHEN amount < po_val*0.995 THEN 'inv_below_po' ELSE 'match' END pricecat, count(*) n, round(avg(CASE WHEN paid-due>30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),4) rate_over30, round(median(paid-due),1) med_late, round(avg(CASE WHEN pamt<billed-0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),4) short_rate, round(avg(partial),4) partial_rate, sum(ncm) n_cm

SELECT account, round(sum(amount)) total_10y, round(sum(CASE WHEN period LIKE '2021%' THEN amount END)) y2021, count(*) n FROM erp_general_ledger GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH rev AS (SELECT DISTINCT job_id FROM erp_shipment_lines),
mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat, min(ordered_on) first_po FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),

SELECT year(j.created_on::DATE) created_yr, count(*) jobs, sum((j.completed_on IS NOT NULL)::INT) completed, round(sum(coalesce(mat,0))) po_amt, round(sum(coalesce(hrs,0))) hrs
FROM erp_jobs j LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN lab USING(job_id) WHERE j.job_id NOT IN (SELECT job_id FROM rev) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH sl AS (SELECT sl.shipment_id, sum(sl.quantity*so.unit_price) po_val FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_so_lines so USING(line_id) GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT i.customer_id IN (6,7) g67, year(CAST(i.invoiced_on AS DATE)) yr, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid, i.amount+i.freight billed, i.amount > sl.po_val*1.005 above FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN sl USING(shipment_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on<'2025-01-01')
SELECT g67, above, count(*) n, round(sum(billed),0) billed, round(sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0))/sum(billed),2) w_late, round(median(paid-due),1) med_late, round(avg(CASE WHEN paid-due>30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),4) rate_over30, round(sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0))/sum(sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0))) OVER (),4) share_dd_all

SELECT yr, round(avg(CASE WHEN above THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE NOT g67),4) above_rate_rest, round(avg(CASE WHEN above THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE g67),4) above_rate_67,
 round(sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE NOT g67 AND NOT above)/sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE NOT g67 AND NOT above),2) wlate_rest_match,
 round(sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE NOT g67 AND above)/sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE NOT g67 AND above),2) wlate_rest_above,
 round(sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE g67 AND NOT above)/sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE g67 AND NOT above),2) wlate_67_match,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN paid-due>30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE NOT g67 AND NOT above),4) over30_rest_match, count(*) n

WITH mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat, sum(pl.pounds) lbs FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material='carbon' GROUP BY po.job_id),
shp AS (SELECT sl.job_id, min(s.shipped_on) fs, sum(sl.quantity*l.unit_price) po_val, sum(i.amount) inv, sum(i.freight) fr, sum(s.freight) sfr FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY sl.job_id),
