r AS (SELECT mat/lbs p20 FROM y WHERE yr=2020)
SELECT yr, round(mat/lbs,4) usd_lb, round(lbs*(mat/lbs - p20)) steel_price_cost_vs2020, round(mat - 0.2572*pv) q152_style_excess, round(inv-pv) uplift, round(fr) inv_freight, round(sfr) ship_freight
FROM y, r ORDER BY yr

SELECT substr(s.shipped_on,1,4) yr, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN i.amount > sl.quantity*l.unit_price*1.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_up, sum(CASE WHEN i.amount < sl.quantity*l.unit_price*0.995 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_down,
 round(median(CASE WHEN i.amount > sl.quantity*l.unit_price*1.005 THEN i.amount/(sl.quantity*l.unit_price)-1 END),4) med_up_pct,
 sum(CASE WHEN q.surcharge=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) quoted_surcharge, sum(CASE WHEN q.surcharge=1 AND i.amount > sl.quantity*l.unit_price*1.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) surcharge_and_up
FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_sales_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ql.quote_id, ql.part_id, max(ql.surcharge) surcharge FROM erp_quote_lines ql GROUP BY 1,2) q ON q.quote_id=o.quote_id AND q.part_id=l.part_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH rev AS (SELECT sl.job_id, min(i.customer_id) cust, sum(i.amount) rev, max(year(i.invoiced_on::DATE)) yr FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat, sum(CASE WHEN pl.material='outside processing' THEN pl.amount ELSE 0 END) osp FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),
lab AS (SELECT job_id, sum(hours) hrs FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
g AS (SELECT substr(period,1,4)::INT yr, -sum(CASE WHEN account IN ('direct labour','indirect labour','benefits and payroll taxes','shop overhead') THEN amount END) conv, -sum(CASE WHEN account='indirect labour' THEN amount END) ind FROM erp_general_ledger GROUP BY 1),
h AS (SELECT year(work_date::DATE) yr, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
nj AS (SELECT yr, count(*) n FROM rev GROUP BY 1),
lr AS (SELECT yr, conv/h rate, (conv-ind)/h rate_ex_ind, ind/n per_job FROM g JOIN h USING(yr) JOIN nj USING(yr)),
jj AS (SELECT rev.yr, p.family, CASE WHEN j.quantity<=5 THEN 'a 1-5' WHEN j.quantity<=10 THEN 'b 6-10' WHEN j.quantity<=25 THEN 'c 11-25' WHEN j.quantity<=50 THEN 'd 26-50' WHEN j.quantity<=100 THEN 'e 51-100' ELSE 'f 100+' END qb, rev, coalesce(mat,0) mat, coalesce(osp,0) osp, coalesce(hrs,0) hrs, rate, rate_ex_ind, per_job FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_customer_parts p USING(part_id) JOIN rev USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN lab USING(job_id) JOIN lr USING(yr))
SELECT 'qty' dim, qb grp, count(*) jobs, round(sum(rev)) rev, round(sum(rev-(mat-osp)-hrs*rate)) contrib_F4_basis, round(sum(rev-mat-hrs*rate)) contrib_with_osp, round(sum(rev-mat-hrs*rate_ex_ind-per_job)) contrib_ind_per_job, round(sum(rev-mat-hrs*rate_ex_ind-per_job)/sum(rev),4) margin_ind_per_job, round(avg(per_job),1) avg_per_job_charge FROM jj GROUP BY qb
UNION ALL
SELECT 'family', family::VARCHAR, count(*), round(sum(rev)), round(sum(rev-(mat-osp)-hrs*rate)), round(sum(rev-mat-hrs*rate)), round(sum(rev-mat-hrs*rate_ex_ind-per_job)), round(sum(rev-mat-hrs*rate_ex_ind-per_job)/sum(rev),4), round(avg(per_job),1) FROM jj GROUP BY family
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH sl AS (SELECT sl.shipment_id, sum(sl.quantity*so.unit_price) po_val FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_so_lines so USING(line_id) GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid, i.amount, i.freight, i.amount+i.freight billed, p.amount pamt, sl.po_val, i.amount > sl.po_val*1.005 above FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN sl USING(shipment_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on<'2025-01-01')
SELECT above, count(*) n, round(median(amount/po_val),4) med_uplift, round(quantile_cont(amount/po_val,0.9),4) p90_uplift,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN abs(pamt-billed)<=0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),4) paid_exact, round(avg(CASE WHEN abs(pamt-(po_val+freight))<=0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),4) paid_at_po_plus_freight,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN pamt<billed-0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),4) short_rate, round(sum(billed-pamt) FILTER (WHERE pamt<billed-0.005),2) short_dollars, round(median(pamt/billed) FILTER (WHERE pamt<billed-0.005),4) med_short_ratio
FROM b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH sl AS (SELECT sl.shipment_id, sum(sl.quantity*so.unit_price) po_val FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_so_lines so USING(line_id) GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid, i.amount+i.freight billed, p.amount pamt, i.amount > sl.po_val*1.005 above FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN sl USING(shipment_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on<'2025-01-01' AND i.customer_id NOT IN (6,7))
SELECT CASE WHEN pamt<billed-0.005 THEN 'short' WHEN pamt>billed+0.005 THEN 'over' ELSE 'exact' END pay, count(*) n, round(avg(CASE WHEN paid-due>30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),4) rate_over30, round(median(paid-due),1) med_late
FROM b WHERE NOT above GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat, sum(pl.pounds) lbs FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material='carbon' GROUP BY po.job_id),
shp AS (SELECT sl.job_id, min(s.shipped_on) fs, sum(sl.quantity*l.unit_price) po_val, sum(i.amount) inv FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY sl.job_id),
y AS (SELECT substr(fs,1,4)::int yr, sum(mat) mat, sum(lbs) lbs, sum(po_val) pv, sum(inv) inv FROM mat JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN shp USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order' GROUP BY 1),
idx(yr, pidx) AS (VALUES (2021,1.0007),(2022,1.2271),(2023,1.3285),(2024,1.3094),(2025,1.2969)),
c AS (SELECT yr, lbs*(mat/lbs - 0.3123) steel_cost, pv*(1-1/pidx) + (inv-pv) price_gain FROM y JOIN idx USING(yr))
SELECT yr, round(steel_cost) steel_cost_vs2020, round(price_gain) price_gain_est, round(price_gain-steel_cost) net
FROM c UNION ALL
SELECT 9999, round(sum(steel_cost) FILTER (WHERE yr IN (2024,2025))/2), round(sum(price_gain) FILTER (WHERE yr IN (2024,2025))/2), round(sum(price_gain-steel_cost) FILTER (WHERE yr IN (2024,2025))/2) FROM c
UNION ALL SELECT 2122, round(sum(steel_cost) FILTER (WHERE yr IN (2021,2022))), round(sum(price_gain) FILTER (WHERE yr IN (2021,2022))), round(sum(price_gain-steel_cost) FILTER (WHERE yr IN (2021,2022))) FROM c
ORDER BY 1

WITH sl AS (SELECT sl.shipment_id, sum(sl.quantity*so.unit_price) po_val FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_so_lines so USING(line_id) GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid, i.amount+i.freight billed FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN sl USING(shipment_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on<'2025-01-01' AND i.customer_id NOT IN (6,7) AND NOT (i.amount > sl.po_val*1.005)),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, count(*) n, avg(CASE WHEN paid-due>30 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) r30, sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) dd, sum(billed) bl FROM b GROUP BY 1)
SELECT CASE WHEN r30>=0.5 THEN 'a r30>=0.5' WHEN r30>=0.25 THEN 'b 0.25-0.5' WHEN r30>=0.1 THEN 'c 0.1-0.25' ELSE 'd <0.1' END band, count(*) ncust, sum(n) n_inv, round(sum(bl)/sum(sum(bl)) OVER (),4) share_billed, round(sum(dd)/sum(sum(dd)) OVER (),4) share_dd, round(sum(r30*n)/sum(n),4) r30_band
FROM c GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH rev AS (SELECT sl.job_id, min(i.customer_id) cust, sum(i.amount) rev, max(year(i.invoiced_on::DATE)) yr FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),
lab AS (SELECT job_id, sum(hours) hrs FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
g AS (SELECT substr(period,1,4)::INT yr, -sum(CASE WHEN account IN ('direct labour','indirect labour','benefits and payroll taxes','shop overhead') THEN amount END) conv, -sum(CASE WHEN account='indirect labour' THEN amount END) ind FROM erp_general_ledger GROUP BY 1),
h AS (SELECT year(work_date::DATE) yr, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
nj AS (SELECT yr, count(*) n FROM rev GROUP BY 1),
lr AS (SELECT yr, conv/h rate, (conv-ind)/h rate_ex_ind, ind/n per_job, (conv-0.5*ind)/h rate_half, 0.5*ind/n per_job_half FROM g JOIN h USING(yr) JOIN nj USING(yr)),
jj AS (SELECT rev.yr, p.family, j.quantity<=5 small, rev, coalesce(mat,0) mat, coalesce(hrs,0) hrs, rate, rate_ex_ind, per_job, rate_half, per_job_half FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_customer_parts p USING(part_id) JOIN rev USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN lab USING(job_id) JOIN lr USING(yr))
SELECT yr, round(avg(per_job)) ind_per_job,
 round(sum(rev-mat-hrs*rate) FILTER (WHERE family=1)) f1_hour_basis,
 round(sum(rev-mat-hrs*rate_half-per_job_half) FILTER (WHERE family=1)) f1_half_per_job,
 round(sum(rev-mat-hrs*rate_ex_ind-per_job) FILTER (WHERE family=1)) f1_full_per_job,
 round(sum(rev-mat-hrs*rate_ex_ind-per_job) FILTER (WHERE small)) small_full_per_job,
 round(sum(rev-mat-hrs*rate_ex_ind-per_job) FILTER (WHERE family=6 AND small)) f6s_full_per_job,
 round(sum(rev) FILTER (WHERE family=1)) f1_rev, count(*) FILTER (WHERE family=1) f1_jobs
FROM jj GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr

WITH rev AS (SELECT sl.job_id, sum(i.amount) rev FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
lab AS (SELECT job_id, sum(hours) hrs FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1)
SELECT p.family, count(*) jobs, round(median(j.quantity)) med_qty, round(sum(rev)/count(*)) rev_per_job, round(sum(hrs)/count(*),2) hrs_per_job, round(median(rev)) med_rev_per_job
FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_customer_parts p USING(part_id) JOIN rev USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN lab USING(job_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH sl AS (SELECT sl.shipment_id, sum(sl.quantity*so.unit_price) po_val FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_so_lines so USING(line_id) GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN sl USING(shipment_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on<'2025-01-01' AND i.customer_id NOT IN (6,7) AND NOT (i.amount > sl.po_val*1.005))
SELECT customer_id, count(*) n, round(avg(CASE WHEN paid-due>30 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),4) r30, median(paid-due) med_late FROM b GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>=200 ORDER BY r30 DESC, customer_id

WITH w AS (SELECT t.employee_id, substr(t.week_of,1,4) yr, t.regular_hours+t.overtime_hours h,
 (SELECT r.hourly FROM hr_pay_rates r WHERE r.employee_id=t.employee_id AND r.effective_on<=t.week_of ORDER BY r.effective_on DESC LIMIT 1) rate FROM hr_timecards t)
SELECT yr, count(*) cards, round(sum(h*rate)/sum(h),2) hrs_wtd_rate FROM w WHERE rate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr
SELECT kind, result, count(*) n FROM shop_inspections GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT round(24.78/20.10,4) wage_ratio, round(-2180081/2.0) loss_2122_per_yr, round(0.4706/0.3123,4) steel_ratio_25, round(1-0.2458,4) nonmat_share_2020

WITH sl AS (SELECT sl.shipment_id, sum(sl.quantity*so.unit_price) po_val, max(sl.partial) partial, bool_or(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_return_authorisations r WHERE r.job_id=sl.job_id)) has_ra, max(CASE WHEN so.promised_date < s.shipped_on THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) shipped_late FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_so_lines so USING(line_id) JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid, sl.* FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN sl USING(shipment_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on<'2025-01-01' AND NOT (i.amount > sl.po_val*1.005))
SELECT customer_id IN (6,7) g67, 'partial='||partial k, count(*) n, round(avg(CASE WHEN paid-due>30 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),4) r30, median(paid-due) med FROM b GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL SELECT customer_id IN (6,7), 'ra='||has_ra, count(*), round(avg(CASE WHEN paid-due>30 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),4), median(paid-due) FROM b GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL SELECT customer_id IN (6,7), 'shipped_after_promise='||shipped_late, count(*), round(avg(CASE WHEN paid-due>30 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),4), median(paid-due) FROM b GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH rev AS (SELECT sl.job_id, min(i.customer_id) cust, sum(i.amount) rev, max(year(i.invoiced_on::DATE)) yr FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),
lab AS (SELECT job_id, sum(hours) hrs FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
g AS (SELECT substr(period,1,4)::INT yr, -sum(CASE WHEN account IN ('direct labour','indirect labour','benefits and payroll taxes','shop overhead') THEN amount END) conv, -sum(CASE WHEN account='indirect labour' THEN amount END) ind FROM erp_general_ledger GROUP BY 1),
h AS (SELECT year(work_date::DATE) yr, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
nj AS (SELECT yr, count(*) n FROM rev GROUP BY 1),
lr AS (SELECT yr, conv/h rate, (conv-ind)/h rate_ex_ind, ind/n per_job, (conv-0.5*ind)/h rate_half, 0.5*ind/n per_job_half FROM g JOIN h USING(yr) JOIN nj USING(yr)),
jj AS (SELECT CASE WHEN rev<500 THEN 'a <500' WHEN rev<1000 THEN 'b 500-1k' WHEN rev<2500 THEN 'c 1k-2.5k' WHEN rev<5000 THEN 'd 2.5k-5k' WHEN rev<10000 THEN 'e 5k-10k' ELSE 'f 10k+' END vb, family, rev, coalesce(mat,0) mat, coalesce(hrs,0) hrs, rate, rate_ex_ind, per_job, rate_half, per_job_half FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_customer_parts p USING(part_id) JOIN rev USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN lab USING(job_id) JOIN lr USING(yr))
SELECT vb, count(*) jobs, round(count(*)/76219.0,4) job_share, round(sum(rev)) rev, round(sum((family=1)::INT)/count(*),3) f1_share_jobs, round(sum(rev-mat-hrs*rate)) contrib_hour_basis, round(sum(rev-mat-hrs*rate_half-per_job_half)) contrib_half_per_job, round(sum(rev-mat-hrs*rate_ex_ind-per_job)) contrib_full_per_job
FROM jj GROUP BY vb ORDER BY vb

WITH rev AS (SELECT sl.job_id, min(i.customer_id) cust, sum(i.amount) rev, max(year(i.invoiced_on::DATE)) yr FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),
lab AS (SELECT job_id, sum(hours) hrs FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
g AS (SELECT substr(period,1,4)::INT yr, -sum(CASE WHEN account IN ('direct labour','indirect labour','benefits and payroll taxes','shop overhead') THEN amount END) conv, -sum(CASE WHEN account='indirect labour' THEN amount END) ind FROM erp_general_ledger GROUP BY 1),
h AS (SELECT year(work_date::DATE) yr, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
nj AS (SELECT yr, count(*) n FROM rev GROUP BY 1),
lr AS (SELECT yr, conv/h rate, (conv-ind)/h rate_ex_ind, ind/n per_job, (conv-0.5*ind)/h rate_half, 0.5*ind/n per_job_half FROM g JOIN h USING(yr) JOIN nj USING(yr)),
c AS (SELECT cust, count(*) jobs, sum(rev) rev, sum(rev-coalesce(mat,0)-coalesce(hrs,0)*rate) c_hour, sum(rev-coalesce(mat,0)-coalesce(hrs,0)*rate_half-per_job_half) c_half, sum(rev-coalesce(mat,0)-coalesce(hrs,0)*rate_ex_ind-per_job) c_full FROM erp_jobs j JOIN rev USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN lab USING(job_id) JOIN lr USING(yr) GROUP BY cust)
SELECT rev>=500000 big, count(*) customers, round(sum(rev)) rev, sum(jobs) jobs,
 sum((c_hour<0)::INT) neg_hour_basis, round(sum(CASE WHEN c_hour<0 THEN rev END)) rev_neg_hour, round(sum(CASE WHEN c_hour<0 THEN c_hour END)) loss_neg_hour,
 sum((c_half<0)::INT) neg_half, round(sum(CASE WHEN c_half<0 THEN rev END)) rev_neg_half, round(sum(CASE WHEN c_half<0 THEN c_half END)) loss_neg_half,
 sum((c_full<0)::INT) neg_full, round(sum(CASE WHEN c_full<0 THEN rev END)) rev_neg_full, round(sum(CASE WHEN c_full<0 THEN c_full END)) loss_neg_full,
 round(sum(c_hour)/sum(rev),4) m_hour, round(sum(c_full)/sum(rev),4) m_full
FROM c GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH sl AS (SELECT sl.shipment_id, sum(sl.quantity*so.unit_price) po_val FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_so_lines so USING(line_id) GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT i.customer_id IN (6,7) g67, year(CAST(i.invoiced_on AS DATE)) yr, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid, i.amount+i.freight billed, i.amount > sl.po_val*1.005 above FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN sl USING(shipment_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on<'2025-01-01'),
t AS (SELECT sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) dd, sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE above) dd_above, sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE g67 AND NOT above) dd67m, sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE g67 AND NOT above) b67m,
 sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE NOT g67 AND NOT above)/sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE NOT g67 AND NOT above) w_rest_m,
 sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE NOT g67 AND NOT above) dd_rest_m,
 sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE yr=2024) dd24, sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE yr=2024 AND g67) dd24_67,
 3288 nd FROM b)
SELECT round(dd/nd,0) excess_ar_all, round(dd/nd*0.08,0) carry_all, round(dd_above/nd,0) excess_ar_above_po, round(dd_above/dd,4) share_above, round(dd_above/nd*0.08,0) carry_above,
 round(dd67m/nd,0) excess_ar_67_match, round((dd67m-b67m*w_rest_m)/nd,0) excess_67_above_rest_match, round((dd67m-b67m*w_rest_m)/nd*0.08,0) carry_67_gap, round(w_rest_m,2) w_rest_match,
 round(dd_rest_m/nd,0) excess_rest_match, round(dd24/366,0) excess_ar_2024_rate, round(dd24/366*0.08,0) carry_2024, round(dd24_67/dd24,4) share67_2024
FROM t

WITH sl AS (SELECT sl.shipment_id, sum(sl.quantity*so.unit_price) po_val FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_so_lines so USING(line_id) GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT CAST(i.invoiced_on AS DATE) inv, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid, i.amount+i.freight billed, i.amount > sl.po_val*1.005 above FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN sl USING(shipment_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on>='2021-07-01' AND i.invoiced_on<'2023-07-01' AND i.customer_id NOT IN (6,7))
SELECT strftime(inv,'%Y-H')||CASE WHEN month(inv)<=6 THEN '1' ELSE '2' END half, count(*) n, round(avg(CASE WHEN above THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),4) above_share, round(sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0))/sum(billed),2) w_all,
 round(sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE NOT above)/sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE NOT above),2) w_match, round(avg(CASE WHEN paid-due>30 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE NOT above),4) r30_match,
 round(sum(billed*greatest(paid-due,0)) FILTER (WHERE above)/sum(billed) FILTER (WHERE above),2) w_above
FROM b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH t AS (SELECT year(week_of::DATE) yr, sum(regular_hours+overtime_hours) paid_h FROM hr_timecards GROUP BY 1),
l AS (SELECT year(work_date::DATE) yr, sum(hours) clk FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
g AS (SELECT substr(period,1,4)::INT yr, -sum(CASE WHEN account IN ('direct labour','indirect labour','benefits and payroll taxes','shop overhead') THEN amount END) conv FROM erp_general_ledger GROUP BY 1)
SELECT yr, round(conv/clk,1) rate_per_clocked_h, round(conv/paid_h,1) rate_per_paid_h, round(clk/paid_h,3) capture, round(128.1-126.2,1) f6s_2020_gap FROM g JOIN t USING(yr) JOIN l USING(yr) ORDER BY yr

SELECT 26.43-14.81 rise_all, 17.78-9.29 rise_match, round((17.78-9.29)/(26.43-14.81),4) share_rise_within_match, round(320443.0/1413693.0,4) above_share_ar, round(671588.0/1413693.0,4) rest_match_share_ar, round(421661.0/1413693.0,4) c67_match_share_ar, 320443+421661+671588 check_sum, 0.6528-0.1674 r30_gap_rest

WITH r AS (SELECT DISTINCT po_id FROM erp_receipts), inv AS (SELECT DISTINCT job_id FROM erp_shipment_lines)
SELECT cp.family, count(*) po_lines, round(avg((r.po_id IS NULL)::INT),4) share_no_receipt, round(sum(CASE WHEN r.po_id IS NULL THEN pl.amount END)) amt_no_receipt, round(sum(pl.amount)) amt, round(avg(CASE WHEN inv.job_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),4) share_on_uninvoiced_jobs
FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) LEFT JOIN r USING(po_id) JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN erp_customer_parts cp USING(part_id) LEFT JOIN inv ON inv.job_id=po.job_id
GROUP BY ROLLUP(cp.family) ORDER BY cp.family NULLS LAST

WITH rev AS (SELECT sl.job_id, sum(i.amount) rev, max(year(i.invoiced_on::DATE)) yr FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
rc AS (SELECT DISTINCT po_id FROM erp_receipts),
mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(CASE WHEN pl.material<>'outside processing' THEN pl.amount ELSE 0 END) mat, sum(CASE WHEN pl.material<>'outside processing' AND rc.po_id IS NOT NULL THEN pl.amount ELSE 0 END) mat_rcvd, sum(pl.amount) mat_osp FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) LEFT JOIN rc USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),
lab AS (SELECT job_id, sum(hours) hrs FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
lr AS (SELECT g.yr, g.conv/l.h rate FROM (SELECT substr(period,1,4)::INT yr, -sum(amount) conv FROM erp_general_ledger WHERE account IN ('direct labour','indirect labour','benefits and payroll taxes','shop overhead') GROUP BY 1) g JOIN (SELECT year(work_date::DATE) yr, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1) l USING(yr)),
jb AS (SELECT j.part_id, rev.yr, rev, coalesce(mat,0) mat, coalesce(mat_rcvd,0) mat_rcvd, coalesce(mat_osp,0) mat_osp, coalesce(hrs,0)*rate conv FROM erp_jobs j JOIN rev USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN lab USING(job_id) JOIN lr USING(yr)),
p AS (SELECT part_id, sum(rev) rev, sum(rev-mat-conv) c_f4, sum(rev-mat_rcvd-conv) c_rcvd, sum(rev-mat_osp-conv) c_osp FROM jb GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT yr)>=3 AND sum(rev)>=50000)
SELECT count(*) parts, sum((c_f4<0)::INT) neg_f4, round(sum(CASE WHEN c_f4<0 THEN c_f4 END)) loss_f4, sum((c_rcvd<0)::INT) neg_receipts_only, round(sum(CASE WHEN c_rcvd<0 THEN c_rcvd END)) loss_rcvd, sum((c_osp<0)::INT) neg_with_osp, round(sum(CASE WHEN c_osp<0 THEN c_osp END)) loss_osp, round(sum(CASE WHEN c_osp<0 THEN rev END)) rev_neg_osp FROM p

WITH sr AS (SELECT op_id, sum(quantity) q, count(*) n FROM shop_scrap_reports GROUP BY 1),
lr AS (SELECT op_id, sum(qty_scrap) q FROM shop_labour_entries WHERE rework=1 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE sr.op_id IS NOT NULL AND lr.op_id IS NOT NULL) both_ops,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE sr.op_id IS NOT NULL AND lr.op_id IS NULL) sr_only_ops,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE sr.op_id IS NULL AND lr.op_id IS NOT NULL) lr_only_ops,
 sum(sr.q) sr_pcs, sum(lr.q) lr_pcs,
 sum(CASE WHEN sr.op_id IS NOT NULL AND lr.op_id IS NOT NULL AND sr.q=lr.q THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) equal_qty_ops,
 sum(CASE WHEN sr.op_id IS NOT NULL AND lr.op_id IS NULL THEN sr.q ELSE 0 END) sr_only_pcs
FROM sr FULL OUTER JOIN lr USING(op_id)
SELECT o.work_centre, s.reason_code, count(*) n, sum(s.quantity) pcs FROM shop_scrap_reports s LEFT JOIN erp_job_operations o USING(op_id) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH lr AS (SELECT DISTINCT op_id FROM shop_labour_entries WHERE rework=1)
SELECT s.reason_code, count(*) FILTER (WHERE lr.op_id IS NULL) n_no_rework, sum(CASE WHEN lr.op_id IS NULL THEN s.quantity ELSE 0 END) pcs_no_rework,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE lr.op_id IS NOT NULL) n_rework, sum(CASE WHEN lr.op_id IS NOT NULL THEN s.quantity ELSE 0 END) pcs_rework
FROM shop_scrap_reports s LEFT JOIN lr USING(op_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH rev AS (SELECT sl.job_id, sum(i.amount) rev, max(year(i.invoiced_on::DATE)) yr FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material<>'outside processing' GROUP BY 1),
lab AS (SELECT job_id, sum(hours) hrs FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
g AS (SELECT substr(period,1,4)::INT yr, -sum(CASE WHEN account IN ('direct labour','indirect labour','benefits and payroll taxes','shop overhead') THEN amount END) conv, -sum(CASE WHEN account='indirect labour' THEN amount END) ind FROM erp_general_ledger GROUP BY 1),
h AS (SELECT year(work_date::DATE) yr, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
nj AS (SELECT yr, count(*) n FROM rev GROUP BY 1),
lr AS (SELECT yr, conv/h rate, (conv-ind)/h rate_ex_ind, ind/n per_job, (conv-0.5*ind)/h rate_half, 0.5*ind/n per_job_half FROM g JOIN h USING(yr) JOIN nj USING(yr)),
jb AS (SELECT j.part_id, rev.yr, rev, coalesce(mat,0) mat, coalesce(hrs,0) hrs, rate, rate_ex_ind, per_job, rate_half, per_job_half FROM erp_jobs j JOIN rev USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN mat USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN lab USING(job_id) JOIN lr USING(yr)),
p AS (SELECT part_id, sum(rev) rev, sum(rev-mat-hrs*rate) c_h, sum(rev-mat-hrs*rate_half-per_job_half) c_half, sum(rev-mat-hrs*rate_ex_ind-per_job) c_full FROM jb GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT yr)>=3 AND sum(rev)>=50000)
SELECT cp.family, count(*) parts, sum((c_h<0)::INT) neg_hour, sum((c_half<0)::INT) neg_half, round(sum(CASE WHEN c_half<0 THEN c_half END)) loss_half, sum((c_full<0)::INT) neg_full, round(sum(CASE WHEN c_full<0 THEN rev END)) rev_neg_full, round(sum(CASE WHEN c_full<0 THEN c_full END)) loss_full
FROM p JOIN erp_customer_parts cp USING(part_id) GROUP BY ROLLUP(cp.family) ORDER BY cp.family NULLS LAST

SELECT 7484+16263 jobs_lt1k, round((7484+16263)/76219.0,4) share_jobs_lt1k, 2749647+12023782 rev_lt1k, 298420+2301693 contrib_lt1k_hour, -984862-321179 contrib_lt1k_half, -2268144-2944051 contrib_lt1k_full, round(39862/76219.0,4) f1_job_share, round(4207405/92758289.0,4) no_receipt_amt_share, round(99.0/77.6-1,3) paid_rate_growth, round(150.9/102.8-1,3) clocked_rate_growth, round(348604/1128792.0,3) big_entry_hour_share

WITH le AS (
 SELECT e.op_id, o.work_centre, e.qty_good+e.qty_scrap p,
  date_diff('day', CAST(h.hired_on AS DATE), CAST(e.work_date AS DATE)) < 365 nb
 FROM shop_labour_entries e JOIN erp_job_operations o ON o.op_id=e.op_id JOIN hr_employees h ON h.employee_id=e.employee_id),
op AS (SELECT op_id, work_centre, sum(p) p, max(nb::int) anynew, min(nb::int) allnew FROM le GROUP BY 1,2),
cls AS (SELECT op_id, work_centre, p, CASE WHEN allnew=1 THEN 'new_only' WHEN anynew=0 THEN 'tenured_only' ELSE 'mixed' END c FROM op),
sr AS (SELECT op_id, reason_code, sum(quantity) q FROM shop_scrap_reports GROUP BY 1,2),
rc AS (SELECT DISTINCT reason_code FROM shop_scrap_reports),
grid AS (SELECT c, work_centre, sum(p) p FROM cls GROUP BY 1,2),
sc AS (SELECT cls.c, cls.work_centre, sr.reason_code, sum(sr.q) q FROM cls JOIN sr USING(op_id) GROUP BY 1,2,3),
ten AS (SELECT g.work_centre, rc.reason_code, coalesce(s.q,0)*1.0/g.p r FROM grid g CROSS JOIN rc LEFT JOIN sc s ON s.c=g.c AND s.work_centre=g.work_centre AND s.reason_code=rc.reason_code WHERE g.c='tenured_only')
SELECT g.c, rc.reason_code, sum(coalesce(s.q,0)) scrap, round(sum(g.p*t.r),0) exp_at_tenured, round(sum(coalesce(s.q,0))/nullif(sum(g.p*t.r),0),3) o_e, sum(g.p) pcs
FROM grid g CROSS JOIN rc LEFT JOIN sc s ON s.c=g.c AND s.work_centre=g.work_centre AND s.reason_code=rc.reason_code
JOIN ten t ON t.work_centre=g.work_centre AND t.reason_code=rc.reason_code
WHERE g.c<>'tenured_only' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT round(5113.0/69850,4) above_share_inv, 0.3951+0.2273 within5_rest

WITH le AS (
 SELECT e.employee_id, o.work_centre, e.qty_good+e.qty_scrap p, e.qty_scrap s,
  date_diff('day', CAST(h.hired_on AS DATE), CAST(e.work_date AS DATE)) ten,
  CAST(h.hired_on AS DATE) hired, CAST(h.terminated_on AS DATE) term
 FROM shop_labour_entries e JOIN erp_job_operations o ON o.op_id=e.op_id JOIN hr_employees h ON h.employee_id=e.employee_id),
wc AS (SELECT work_centre, sum(s)/sum(p) wr FROM le WHERE ten>=365 GROUP BY 1),
x AS (SELECT le.*, p*wr ex,
  CASE WHEN term IS NOT NULL AND date_diff('day',hired,term)<365 THEN 'a left <1y'
       WHEN date_diff('day',hired,coalesce(term,DATE '2025-12-31'))>=1095 AND hired>=DATE '2016-01-01' THEN 'c stayed 3y+ (hired in window)'
       WHEN hired>=DATE '2016-01-01' THEN 'b stayed 1-3y' ELSE 'd hired pre-2016' END grp,
  CASE WHEN ten<365 THEN 'y1' WHEN ten<1095 THEN 'y2-3' ELSE 'y4+' END tb
 FROM le JOIN wc USING(work_centre))
SELECT grp, tb, count(DISTINCT employee_id) emps, sum(p) pcs, sum(s) scrap, round(sum(ex),0) exp, round(sum(s)/sum(ex),3) o_e
FROM x GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat, sum(pl.pounds) lbs FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material='carbon' GROUP BY po.job_id),
shp AS (SELECT sl.job_id, min(s.shipped_on) fs, sum(sl.quantity*l.unit_price) po_val, sum(i.amount) inv FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY sl.job_id),
y AS (SELECT substr(fs,1,4)::int yr, sum(mat) mat, sum(lbs) lbs, sum(po_val) pv, sum(inv) inv FROM mat JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN shp USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order' GROUP BY 1),
idx(yr, pidx) AS (VALUES (2021,1.0007),(2022,1.2271),(2023,1.3285),(2024,1.3094),(2025,1.2969)),
c AS (SELECT yr, lbs*(mat/lbs - 0.3123) steel_cost, pv*(1-1/pidx) + (inv-pv) price_gain FROM y JOIN idx USING(yr))
SELECT 'all_jobs_2021_2022_shortfall_per_yr' metric, round(sum(steel_cost-price_gain)/2) val FROM c WHERE yr IN (2021,2022)
UNION ALL SELECT 'all_jobs_2021_shortfall', round(sum(steel_cost-price_gain)) FROM c WHERE yr=2021
UNION ALL SELECT 'all_jobs_2022_net_gain', round(sum(price_gain-steel_cost)) FROM c WHERE yr=2022
UNION ALL SELECT 'all_jobs_2024_2025_net_gain_per_yr', round(sum(price_gain-steel_cost)/2) FROM c WHERE yr IN (2024,2025)
ORDER BY 1

WITH le AS (
 SELECT j.part_id, o.work_centre, j.quantity jq, e.qty_good+e.qty_scrap p, e.qty_scrap s,
  date_diff('day', CAST(h.hired_on AS DATE), CAST(e.work_date AS DATE)) < 365 nb
 FROM shop_labour_entries e JOIN erp_job_operations o ON o.op_id=e.op_id JOIN hr_employees h ON h.employee_id=e.employee_id
 JOIN erp_jobs j ON j.job_id=e.job_id),
b AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN jq<10 THEN 1 WHEN jq<25 THEN 2 WHEN jq<50 THEN 3 WHEN jq<100 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END qb FROM le),
pw AS (SELECT part_id, work_centre, qb, sum(s)/sum(p) r FROM b WHERE NOT nb GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING sum(p)>=500)
SELECT 'by_band' k, qb, nb, sum(p) pcs, sum(s) scrap, round(sum(s)*1.0/sum(p),5) rate, NULL o_e FROM b GROUP BY 2,3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'part_wc_band', NULL, nb, sum(p), sum(s), NULL, round(sum(s)/sum(p*r),3) FROM b JOIN pw USING(part_id,work_centre,qb) GROUP BY 3
ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH mat AS (SELECT po.job_id, sum(pl.amount) mat FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE pl.material='carbon' GROUP BY po.job_id),
shp AS (SELECT sl.job_id, min(s.shipped_on) fs, sum(sl.quantity) q, sum(sl.quantity*l.unit_price) po_val, sum(i.amount) inv FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_invoices i USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY sl.job_id),
b AS (SELECT j.part_id, substr(fs,1,4)::int yr, q, mat, po_val, inv FROM mat JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN shp USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order'),
pp AS (SELECT part_id, yr, sum(q) q, sum(mat)/sum(q) mpu, sum(po_val)/sum(q) ppu, sum(inv)/sum(q) ipu FROM b GROUP BY 1,2),
base AS (SELECT * FROM pp WHERE yr=2019)
SELECT p.yr, count(*) parts, round(sum(base.q*p.ppu)/sum(base.q*base.ppu),4) price_idx, round(sum(base.q*p.mpu)/sum(base.q*base.mpu),4) mat_idx,
 round(sum(base.q*(p.ipu-base.ipu)) - sum(base.q*(p.mpu-base.mpu))) d_margin_over_mat_vs2019
FROM pp p JOIN base USING(part_id) WHERE p.yr>=2019 GROUP BY p.yr ORDER BY p.yr

WITH le AS (
 SELECT o.work_centre, strftime(CAST(e.work_date AS DATE),'%Y-%m') ym, e.overtime ot, e.qty_good+e.qty_scrap p, e.qty_scrap s,
  date_diff('day', CAST(h.hired_on AS DATE), CAST(e.work_date AS DATE)) < 365 nb
 FROM shop_labour_entries e JOIN erp_job_operations o ON o.op_id=e.op_id JOIN hr_employees h ON h.employee_id=e.employee_id),
base AS (SELECT work_centre, ym, ot, sum(s)/sum(p) r FROM le WHERE NOT nb GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING sum(p)>0)
SELECT nb, sum(p) pcs, sum(s) scrap, round(sum(p*r),0) exp, round(sum(s)/sum(p*r),3) o_e,
 round(avg(ot),4) ot_share_entries,
 (SELECT round(sum(s) FILTER (WHERE ot=1)*1.0/sum(p) FILTER (WHERE ot=1),5) FROM le WHERE NOT nb) tenured_ot_rate,
 (SELECT round(sum(s) FILTER (WHERE ot=0)*1.0/sum(p) FILTER (WHERE ot=0),5) FROM le WHERE NOT nb) tenured_reg_rate
FROM le JOIN base USING(work_centre,ym,ot) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH sc AS (SELECT op_id, sum(quantity) s, count(*) ev FROM shop_scrap_reports WHERE reason_code IN ('dimension out of tolerance','operator error') GROUP BY 1),
o AS (SELECT j.part_id, j.job_id, o.work_centre, CASE WHEN year(CAST(j.released_on AS DATE))<=2020 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END hf, j.quantity q, coalesce(sc.s,0) s, coalesce(sc.ev,0) ev
 FROM erp_job_operations o JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN sc USING(op_id) WHERE j.kind='order' AND j.released_on IS NOT NULL),
wc AS (SELECT work_centre, sum(s)/sum(q) wr, sum(ev)/sum(q) wev FROM o GROUP BY 1),
x AS (SELECT o.*, q*wr e, q*wev eev, CASE WHEN job_id%2=0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END par FROM o JOIN wc USING(work_centre)),
sp AS (SELECT part_id, par, sum(s) s, sum(e) e, sum(ev) ev, sum(eev) eev FROM x GROUP BY 1,2),
w AS (SELECT a.part_id, a.s/a.e o1, b.s/b.e o2, a.ev/a.eev v1, b.ev/b.eev v2, a.e e1, b.e e2 FROM sp a JOIN sp b ON a.part_id=b.part_id AND a.par=1 AND b.par=2),
ph AS (SELECT part_id, sum(ev) ev, sum(eev) eev FROM x GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(eev)>=10)
SELECT 'oddeven_e>=5' k, count(*) n, round(corr(o1,o2),4) c_pcs, round(corr(v1,v2),4) c_events FROM w WHERE e1>=5 AND e2>=5
UNION ALL SELECT 'oddeven_e>=20', count(*), round(corr(o1,o2),4), round(corr(v1,v2),4) FROM w WHERE e1>=20 AND e2>=20
UNION ALL SELECT 'events_dispersion_chi2_over_df(parts eev>=10)', count(*), round(sum((ev-eev)^2/eev)/(count(*)-1),3), NULL FROM ph
ORDER BY 1

WITH sc AS (SELECT op_id, sum(quantity) s, count(*) ev FROM shop_scrap_reports WHERE reason_code IN ('dimension out of tolerance','operator error') GROUP BY 1),
o AS (SELECT j.part_id, j.job_id, o.work_centre, j.quantity q, coalesce(sc.s,0) s, coalesce(sc.ev,0) ev
 FROM erp_job_operations o JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN sc USING(op_id) WHERE j.kind='order' AND j.released_on IS NOT NULL),
wc AS (SELECT work_centre, sum(s)/sum(q) wr, sum(ev)/sum(q) wev FROM o GROUP BY 1),
x AS (SELECT o.*, q*wr e, q*wev eev, CASE WHEN job_id%2=0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END par FROM o JOIN wc USING(work_centre)),
sp AS (SELECT part_id, par, sum(s) s, sum(e) e, sum(ev) ev, sum(eev) eev FROM x GROUP BY 1,2),
w AS (SELECT a.part_id, a.ev/a.eev v1, b.ev b_ev, b.eev b_eev, b.s b_s, b.e b_e FROM sp a JOIN sp b ON a.part_id=b.part_id AND a.par=1 AND b.par=2 WHERE a.eev>=5 AND b.eev>=5),
r AS (SELECT *, ntile(5) OVER (ORDER BY v1, part_id) qn FROM w)
SELECT qn, count(*) parts, round(avg(v1),3) mean_oe_events_even, round(sum(b_ev)/sum(b_eev),3) odd_oe_events, round(sum(b_s)/sum(b_e),3) odd_oe_pcs, round(sum(b_ev-b_eev),0) odd_excess_events FROM r GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) uninvoiced_completed_2016_2024, round(sum(pl.amount)) po_amt FROM erp_jobs j LEFT JOIN (SELECT po.job_id, sum(amount) amount FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1) pl USING(job_id) WHERE j.job_id NOT IN (SELECT job_id FROM erp_shipment_lines) AND year(j.created_on::DATE)<=2024 AND j.completed_on IS NOT NULL

WITH sl AS (SELECT sl.shipment_id, sum(sl.quantity*so.unit_price) po_val FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_so_lines so USING(line_id) GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT i.customer_id, CAST(i.due_on AS DATE) due, CAST(p.paid_on AS DATE) paid, i.amount > sl.po_val*1.005 above FROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p USING(invoice_id) JOIN sl USING(shipment_id) WHERE i.invoiced_on<'2025-01-01' AND i.customer_id NOT IN (6,7)),
c AS (SELECT customer_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE above) na, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT above) nm,
 avg(CASE WHEN paid-due>30 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE above) ra, avg(CASE WHEN paid-due>30 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE NOT above) rm,
 median(paid-due) FILTER (WHERE above) mda, median(paid-due) FILTER (WHERE NOT above) mdm FROM b GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) ncust, sum(na) n_above, sum(nm) n_match, round(sum(ra*na)/sum(na),4) r30_above_within, round(sum(rm*na)/sum(na),4) r30_match_reweighted, round(avg(CASE WHEN ra>rm THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),4) share_cust_above_worse, round(median(mda-mdm),1) med_within_gap_days
FROM c WHERE na>=5 AND nm>=5

WITH sc AS (SELECT op_id, sum(quantity) FILTER (WHERE reason_code IN ('dimension out of tolerance','operator error')) s, sum(quantity) sall FROM shop_scrap_reports GROUP BY 1),
jb AS (SELECT j.job_id, j.part_id, j.quantity, CAST(p.created_on AS DATE) pc, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY j.part_id ORDER BY j.released_on, j.job_id) runno
 FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_customer_parts p USING(part_id) WHERE j.kind='order' AND j.released_on IS NOT NULL),
o AS (SELECT jb.*, o.work_centre, coalesce(sc.s,0) s, coalesce(sc.sall,0) sall FROM jb JOIN erp_job_operations o USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN sc USING(op_id)),
wc AS (SELECT work_centre, sum(s)/sum(quantity) wr, sum(sall)/sum(quantity) wra FROM o GROUP BY 1)
SELECT CASE WHEN pc>=DATE '2017-01-01' THEN 'part created 2017+' ELSE 'part created pre-2017' END cohort,
 CASE WHEN runno=1 THEN '1 first' WHEN runno<=3 THEN '2 run2-3' ELSE '3 run4+' END run,
 count(DISTINCT job_id) jobs, sum(s) dot_oe, round(sum(s)/sum(quantity*wr),3) oe_dotoe, sum(sall) all_reasons, round(sum(sall)/sum(quantity*wra),3) oe_all
FROM o JOIN wc USING(work_centre) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH srv AS (SELECT sum(s.quantity*l.unit_price) v, sum(s.quantity) q FROM shop_scrap_reports s JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=j.line_id),
gl AS (SELECT account, sum(amount) a, min(period) p0, max(period) p1 FROM erp_general_ledger WHERE account ILIKE '%memo%' OR account ILIKE '%rework%' OR account ILIKE '%scrap%' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT gl.account, round(gl.a,0) total, gl.p0, gl.p1, round(srv.v,0) all_scrap_reports_val_sp, srv.q all_scrap_pcs, round(gl.a/srv.v,4) ratio_to_all_scrap_val FROM gl, srv ORDER BY 1

WITH le AS (
 SELECT e.rework, e.hours, e.qty_scrap, date_diff('day', CAST(h.hired_on AS DATE), CAST(e.work_date AS DATE)) < 365 nb, year(CAST(e.work_date AS DATE)) yr
 FROM shop_labour_entries e JOIN hr_employees h USING(employee_id))
SELECT nb, round(sum(hours) FILTER (WHERE rework=1),0) rework_hours, round(sum(hours),0) all_hours, sum(qty_scrap) scrap_pcs, min(yr)||'-'||max(yr) yrs,
 round(sum(hours) FILTER (WHERE rework=1)/sum(qty_scrap),4) rework_hrs_per_scrap_pc
FROM le GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT round(54971.0*2474799.0/7568632.0,0) excess_yr_material_basis_corrected,
 round(2474799.0/7568632.0,4) ratio_corrected, round(2474799.0/5787974.0,4) ratio_used,
 7940-4402 excess_pcs_10y, round((7940-4402)*0.1935,0) excess_rework_hours_10y,
 round(108569.0/(6371+1536),2) rework_memo_per_rework_hour,
 round((7940-4402)*0.1935*108569.0/(6371+1536)/10,0) excess_rework_labour_per_yr,
 round(54971.0*2474799.0/7568632.0 + (7940-4402)*0.1935*108569.0/(6371+1536)/10,0) excess_cost_per_yr,
 round(2474799.0/10,0) gl_scrap_memo_per_yr,
 round(1356.0+4704,0) newonly_dotoe, round(2663.0+792,0) newonly_dotoe_exp, round((1356.0+4704)/(2663+792),3) newonly_dotoe_oe

WITH r AS (SELECT po_id, count(*) n, sum(pounds) lb FROM erp_receipts GROUP BY po_id)
SELECT v.vendor_id, v.kind, l.material, count(*) pos, sum(CASE WHEN r.po_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unrec,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN r.po_id IS NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),4) share, round(sum(CASE WHEN r.po_id IS NULL THEN l.amount END),0) unrec_amt
FROM erp_purchase_orders p JOIN erp_po_lines l USING(po_id) JOIN erp_vendors v USING(vendor_id) LEFT JOIN r USING(po_id)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY v.vendor_id, l.material

WITH lr AS (SELECT DISTINCT op_id FROM shop_labour_entries WHERE rework=1),
sro AS (SELECT op_id, sum(quantity) q FROM shop_scrap_reports GROUP BY 1),
le AS (SELECT e.op_id, e.qty_good+e.qty_scrap p, date_diff('day', CAST(h.hired_on AS DATE), CAST(e.work_date AS DATE)) < 365 nb FROM shop_labour_entries e JOIN hr_employees h USING(employee_id) WHERE e.rework=0)
SELECT CASE WHEN sro.op_id IS NULL THEN 'no scrap report' WHEN lr.op_id IS NULL THEN 'scrap report, no rework entry' ELSE 'scrap report + rework' END grp,

WITH ql AS (SELECT quote_id, sum(unit_price*quantity) price, sum(est_hours) hrs, sum(est_material) mat, sum(est_outside) outs, max(lead_weeks) lead, max(surcharge) sur FROM erp_quote_lines GROUP BY 1),
q AS (SELECT q.quote_id, estimator_id e, q.customer_id c, substr(sent_on,1,4) y, (status='won')::int w,
  ln(price/nullif(hrs*1.0,0)) lpph, ln(price/nullif(mat+outs+hrs*60,0)) lmarkup, lead, sur,
  date_diff('day', r.received_on::date, sent_on::date) tat
  FROM erp_quotes q JOIN ql USING(quote_id) JOIN erp_rfqs r USING(rfq_id) WHERE kind='new' AND status IS NOT NULL AND status<>''),
cy AS (SELECT c,y, count(*) n, sum(lpph) s1, sum(lmarkup) s2, sum(lead) s3, sum(tat) s4 FROM q GROUP BY 1,2),
ce AS (SELECT c,y,e, count(*) n, sum(lpph) s1, sum(lmarkup) s2, sum(lead) s3, sum(tat) s4 FROM q GROUP BY 1,2,3),
d AS (SELECT q.e, q.lpph-(cy.s1-ce.s1)/(cy.n-ce.n) d1, q.lmarkup-(cy.s2-ce.s2)/(cy.n-ce.n) d2, q.lead-(cy.s3-ce.s3)/(cy.n-ce.n) d3, q.tat-(cy.s4-ce.s4)/(cy.n-ce.n) d4
  FROM q JOIN cy USING(c,y) JOIN ce USING(c,y,e) WHERE cy.n>ce.n)
SELECT e, count(*) n, round(avg(d1),3) rel_log_price_per_hr, round(avg(d2),3) rel_log_markup, round(avg(d3),2) rel_lead_wk, round(avg(d4),2) rel_turnaround_days FROM d GROUP BY e ORDER BY e

 round(sum(ops.est_job)/sum(h.setup_hours+h.run_hours*l.jq),3) route_over_quote,

 sum(CASE WHEN status='won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN status='won' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),4) hit,

 round(regr_slope(w, x1),4) slope_raw_lnhm, round(regr_slope(wd, xd),4) slope_within_cust_yr_lnhm,
 round(regr_slope(w, labshare),4) slope_raw_labshare, round(regr_slope(wd, ld),4) slope_within_labshare,

SELECT yr, count(*) jobs, sum(late) late, round(avg(late),4) late_rate, sum(late_rcpt) lr_jobs,
 round(avg(late) FILTER (WHERE late_rcpt=1),4) rate_lr, round(avg(late) FILTER (WHERE late_rcpt=0),4) rate_nolr,
 sum(late) FILTER (WHERE late_rcpt=1) late_from_lr, round(sum(late) FILTER (WHERE late_rcpt=1)*1.0/sum(late),4) share_late_from_lr

WITH r AS (SELECT DISTINCT po_id FROM erp_receipts),
m AS (SELECT p.po_id, p.job_id, p.ordered_on::date od, l.pounds, l.amount, r.po_id IS NOT NULL rec,

rc AS (SELECT po.job_id, max(CASE WHEN r.received_on::DATE > po.due_on::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late_rcpt

  FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN sh USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN rc USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order' AND l.promised_date >= '2016-01-01'),

SELECT count(*) n_months, round(corr(late_rate, lr_share),3) r_late_vs_lrshare, round(corr(late_rate, clocked_h),3) r_late_vs_clocked,
 round(corr(late_rate, ot_h),3) r_late_vs_ot, round(corr(late_rate_nolr, clocked_h),3) r_nolr_late_vs_clocked, min(ym) first_m, max(ym) last_m
FROM t

WITH q AS (SELECT q.estimator_id e, substr(sent_on,1,7) ym, (status='won')::int w, date_diff('day', r.received_on::date, sent_on::date) tat FROM erp_quotes q JOIN erp_rfqs r USING(rfq_id) WHERE kind='new' AND status IS NOT NULL AND status<>''),
m AS (SELECT ym, count(*) n, sum((e=115)::int) n115, avg(tat) tat, sum(w) FILTER (WHERE e<>115) w_oth FROM q GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN n115=0 THEN '0 none' WHEN n115<=3 THEN '1 1-3' WHEN n115<=8 THEN '2 4-8' ELSE '3 9+' END band FROM m)
SELECT band, count(*) n_months, sum(n) quotes, sum(n115) q115, round(sum(w_oth)/sum(n-n115),3) hit_others, round(sum(tat*n)/sum(n),2) avg_tat, round(avg(n),1) quotes_per_month FROM b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT ym, count(*) n, sum((e=115)::int) n115, round(avg(w) FILTER (WHERE e=115),3) hit115, round(avg(w) FILTER (WHERE e<>115),3) hit_oth, round(avg(tat),2) tat_all, round(avg(tat) FILTER (WHERE e=115),2) tat115 FROM q GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum((e=115)::int)>=9 ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (
  SELECT q.quote_id, ql.quote_line_id, j.job_id, j.quantity jq
  FROM erp_sales_orders so JOIN erp_quotes q ON q.quote_id=so.quote_id
  JOIN erp_so_lines sl ON sl.order_id=so.order_id
  JOIN erp_quote_lines ql ON ql.quote_id=q.quote_id AND ql.part_id=sl.part_id
  JOIN erp_jobs j ON j.line_id=sl.line_id AND j.kind='order'
  WHERE j.completed_on IS NOT NULL),
ops AS (
  SELECT o.job_id, o.work_centre, sum(coalesce(la.h,0)) act, sum(coalesce(la.hr,0)) act_norw

  GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT ops.work_centre, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT l.job_id) jobs, count(DISTINCT l.quote_line_id) qlines,
 round(sum(act)/sum(h.setup_hours+h.run_hours*jq),3) act_q,
 round(sum(act_norw)/sum(h.setup_hours+h.run_hours*jq),3) act_q_norework,
 round(sum(act_norw),0) act_norw_h, round(sum(h.setup_hours+h.run_hours*jq),0) quote_h,
 sum(CASE WHEN act=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero_actual

WITH sh AS (SELECT sl.job_id, max(s.shipped_on::DATE) last_ship FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),

base AS (SELECT year(l.promised_date::DATE) yr, CASE WHEN sh.last_ship > l.promised_date::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END late, coalesce(rc.late_rcpt,0) late_rcpt,

  FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_sales_orders so USING(order_id) JOIN sh USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN rc USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order' AND l.promised_date>='2016-01-01'),
y AS (SELECT yr, count(*) jobs, round(avg(late),4) late_rate, round(avg(promise_days),1) avg_promise_cal_days, round(avg(shop_days) FILTER (WHERE late_rcpt=0),1) shop_days_nolr, round(avg(comp_to_ship),2) comp_to_ship FROM base GROUP BY 1),

SELECT ops.work_centre, count(*) n_ops, sum(CASE WHEN h.quote_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_quote_row,

WITH nq AS (SELECT q.quote_id, q.status, ql.part_id FROM erp_quotes q JOIN erp_quote_lines ql USING(quote_id) WHERE q.kind='new'),
pj AS (SELECT part_id, count(*) jobs FROM erp_jobs WHERE kind='order' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT status, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT part_id) parts, sum(CASE WHEN pj.part_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lines_part_has_jobs
FROM nq LEFT JOIN pj USING(part_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH sh AS (SELECT sl.job_id, max(s.shipped_on::DATE) last_ship FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
rc AS (SELECT po.job_id, max(CASE WHEN r.received_on::DATE > po.due_on::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late_rcpt FROM erp_purchase_orders po LEFT JOIN erp_receipts r USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),
base AS (SELECT strftime(l.promised_date::DATE,'%Y-%m') ym, CASE WHEN sh.last_ship > l.promised_date::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END late, coalesce(rc.late_rcpt,0) late_rcpt
  FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN sh USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN rc USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order' AND year(l.promised_date::DATE) IN (2016,2021)),
lab AS (SELECT strftime(work_date::DATE,'%Y-%m') ym, round(sum(hours)) clocked_h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1)
SELECT ym, count(*) jobs, sum(late) late, round(avg(late),3) late_rate, sum(late_rcpt) lr_jobs, round(avg(late) FILTER (WHERE late_rcpt=0),3) late_rate_nolr, clocked_h
FROM base JOIN lab USING(ym) GROUP BY ym, clocked_h ORDER BY ym

SELECT count(DISTINCT family) fams, count(DISTINCT material) mats, min(quantity) qmin, median(quantity) qmed, max(quantity) qmax
FROM erp_customer_parts p JOIN erp_quote_lines ql USING(part_id)

WITH m AS (SELECT p.job_id, l.material, l.price_per_lb, l.amount, l.pounds, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY p.job_id ORDER BY p.ordered_on, p.po_id) rn,
 first_value(l.price_per_lb) OVER (PARTITION BY p.job_id ORDER BY p.ordered_on, p.po_id) first_ppl
 FROM erp_purchase_orders p JOIN erp_po_lines l USING(po_id) WHERE l.material <> 'outside processing')
SELECT count(*) followups, round(median(price_per_lb/first_ppl),4) med_price_ratio, round(quantile_cont(price_per_lb/first_ppl,0.1),4) p10, round(quantile_cont(price_per_lb/first_ppl,0.9),4) p90,
 round(sum(amount),0) fu_amt, round(sum(pounds*first_ppl),0) at_first_price, 2358681+7549 replacement_incl_2016_carryin, round((2358681+7549)/10.0,0) per_yr, round((2358681+7549)/91040283.0,4) share_gl_mat, 30670+132 replacement_pos
FROM m WHERE rn>1

WITH sh AS (SELECT sl.job_id, max(s.shipped_on::DATE) last_ship FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
rc AS (SELECT po.job_id, max(r.received_on::DATE - po.due_on::DATE) d, max(r.received_on::DATE) last_rcpt FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_receipts r USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),
base AS (SELECT CASE WHEN rc.d<=0 THEN '0 on time' WHEN rc.d<=3 THEN '1: 1-3d' WHEN rc.d<=7 THEN '2: 4-7d' WHEN rc.d<=14 THEN '3: 8-14d' ELSE '4: >14d' END bucket,
  CASE WHEN sh.last_ship > l.promised_date::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END late, greatest(sh.last_ship - l.promised_date::DATE,0) days_late, l.promised_date::DATE - rc.last_rcpt slack_after_rcpt
  FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN sh USING(job_id) JOIN rc USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order')
SELECT bucket, count(*) jobs, round(avg(late),4) late_rate, round(avg(days_late) FILTER (WHERE late=1),1) avg_cal_days_late_if_late, round(median(slack_after_rcpt),1) med_cal_days_rcpt_to_promise
FROM base GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH ql AS (SELECT quote_id, sum(unit_price*quantity) price FROM erp_quote_lines GROUP BY 1),
q AS (SELECT quote_id, estimator_id e, customer_id c, substr(sent_on,1,4) y, substr(sent_on,1,7) ym, sent_on::date sd, (status='won')::int w, price FROM erp_quotes JOIN ql USING(quote_id) WHERE kind='new' AND status IS NOT NULL AND status<>''),
k AS (SELECT 'cust_year' spec, c::varchar||'|'||y key, * FROM q UNION ALL SELECT 'year_month', ym, * FROM q),
cell AS (SELECT spec,key,e,count(*) n,sum(w) w FROM k GROUP BY 1,2,3),
tot AS (SELECT spec,key,sum(n) n,sum(w) w FROM cell GROUP BY 1,2),
p AS (SELECT k.spec, k.c, k.w, k.price, (tot.w-cell.w)/(tot.n-cell.n) pexp FROM k JOIN cell USING(spec,key,e) JOIN tot USING(spec,key) WHERE tot.n>cell.n AND k.e=115),
cl AS (SELECT spec, c, sum(w-pexp) r FROM p GROUP BY 1,2),
span AS (SELECT date_diff('day', min(sd), max(sd))/365.25 yrs FROM q WHERE e=115)
SELECT p.spec, count(*) n, round(avg(w-pexp),3) diff, round(sqrt((SELECT sum(r*r) FROM cl WHERE cl.spec=p.spec))/count(*),3) se_cluster_customer, (SELECT count(*) FROM cl WHERE cl.spec=p.spec) n_customers,
 round(sum(pexp-w),1) missing_wins, round(sum((pexp-w)*price),0) shortfall_value, round(sum((pexp-w)*price)/(SELECT yrs FROM span),0) per_year, round((SELECT yrs FROM span),2) yrs
FROM p GROUP BY p.spec ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (
  SELECT q.quote_id, ql.quote_line_id, q.status, p.family, p.material, substr(q.sent_on,1,4) yr,
   ntile(10) OVER (ORDER BY ql.quantity, ql.quote_line_id) qd,
   ln(ql.est_hours) lh, ln(ql.unit_price*ql.quantity) lp, ln(ql.est_material) lm
  FROM erp_quotes q JOIN erp_quote_lines ql USING(quote_id) JOIN erp_customer_parts p USING(part_id)
  WHERE q.kind='new' AND q.status IN ('won','lost','expired','no award') AND ql.est_hours>0 AND ql.unit_price>0 AND ql.est_material>0),
r AS (SELECT *, lh - avg(lh) OVER (PARTITION BY family, material, qd, yr) rh,
   lp - avg(lp) OVER (PARTITION BY family, material, qd, yr) rp FROM x),
b AS (SELECT *, ntile(5) OVER (ORDER BY rh, quote_line_id) qh, ntile(5) OVER (ORDER BY rp, quote_line_id) qp FROM r)
SELECT 'rel_hours' dim, qh bucket, count(*) n, round(avg(rh),3) mean_resid, round(avg(CASE WHEN status='won' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),4) hit,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN status='lost' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),4) lost_rate FROM b GROUP BY qh
UNION ALL
SELECT 'rel_price', qp, count(*), round(avg(rp),3), round(avg(CASE WHEN status='won' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),4),
 round(avg(CASE WHEN status='lost' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),4) FROM b GROUP BY qp
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH o AS (SELECT p.po_id, p.job_id, p.vendor_id, p.ordered_on::date od, l.amount FROM erp_purchase_orders p JOIN erp_po_lines l USING(po_id) WHERE l.material='outside processing'),
j AS (SELECT job_id, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT vendor_id) nv, count(DISTINCT round(amount,2)) na FROM o GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) osp_pos, (SELECT count(*) FROM j) jobs_with_osp, (SELECT count(*) FROM j WHERE n>1) jobs_multi_osp,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM j WHERE n>1 AND na<n) jobs_repeat_amount, round(sum(amount),0) osp_amt, min(od) first_od, max(od) last_od
FROM o

WITH q AS (SELECT estimator_id e, substr(sent_on,1,4) y, substr(sent_on,1,7) ym, (status='won')::int w FROM erp_quotes WHERE kind='new' AND status IS NOT NULL AND status<>''),
cell AS (SELECT ym,e,count(*) n,sum(w) w FROM q GROUP BY 1,2),
tot AS (SELECT ym,sum(n) n,sum(w) w FROM cell GROUP BY 1),
j AS (SELECT cell.*, substr(cell.ym,1,4) y, tot.n-cell.n on_, tot.w-cell.w ow FROM cell JOIN tot USING(ym) WHERE tot.n>cell.n AND e=115)
SELECT y, sum(n) n, sum(w) w, round(sum(w)/sum(n),3) obs, round(sum(n*ow/on_)/sum(n),3) expct, round((sum(w)-sum(n*ow/on_))/sum(n),3) diff FROM j GROUP BY y ORDER BY y

WITH jn AS (
  SELECT job_id, part_id, quantity, created_on, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY part_id ORDER BY created_on, job_id) k,
   count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY part_id) njobs
  FROM erp_jobs WHERE kind='order' AND completed_on IS NOT NULL),
ops AS (
  SELECT o.job_id, o.work_centre, o.est_setup_hours s, o.est_run_hours r, coalesce(la.h,0) act
  FROM erp_job_operations o LEFT JOIN (SELECT op_id, sum(CASE WHEN rework=1 THEN 0 ELSE hours END) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY op_id) la USING(op_id)),
f AS (SELECT part_id, work_centre, s s1, r/quantity rpp1 FROM ops JOIN jn USING(job_id) WHERE k=1)
SELECT work_centre, CASE WHEN k=1 THEN '01' WHEN k<=3 THEN '02-03' WHEN k<=10 THEN '04-10' ELSE '11+' END nth,
 count(*) n, count(DISTINCT jn.part_id) parts, round(avg(quantity),1) avg_qty,
 round(sum(act)/sum(s+r),3) act_est, round(avg(s/nullif(s1,0)),3) setup_vs_first, round(avg((r/quantity)/nullif(rpp1,0)),3) runpp_vs_first
FROM ops JOIN jn USING(job_id) JOIN f ON f.part_id=jn.part_id AND f.work_centre=ops.work_centre
WHERE njobs>=11 AND ops.work_centre IN ('laser','brake','weld','paint','inspect')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH jn AS (

   count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY part_id) njobs

WITH sh AS (SELECT sl.job_id, max(s.shipped_on::DATE) last_ship FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
rc AS (SELECT po.job_id, max(CASE WHEN r.received_on::DATE > po.due_on::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late_rcpt FROM erp_purchase_orders po LEFT JOIN erp_receipts r USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),
base AS (SELECT year(l.promised_date::DATE) yr, CASE WHEN sh.last_ship > l.promised_date::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END late, coalesce(rc.late_rcpt,0) late_rcpt
  FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN sh USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN rc USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order' AND l.promised_date>='2016-01-01'),
y AS (SELECT yr, sum(late) late, sum(late) FILTER (WHERE late_rcpt=1) late_lr, count(*) FILTER (WHERE late_rcpt=1) n_lr, avg(late) FILTER (WHERE late_rcpt=0) r0 FROM base GROUP BY 1)
SELECT sum(late) total_late, sum(late_lr) late_from_lr, round(sum(late_lr)*1.0/sum(late),4) share, round(sum(late_lr - n_lr*r0)) excess_late_from_lr_10y, round(sum(late_lr - n_lr*r0)/10,1) excess_per_yr,
 sum(late) FILTER (WHERE yr IN (2016,2021)) late_spike_yrs, round(sum(late_lr - n_lr*r0) FILTER (WHERE yr IN (2016,2021))) excess_lr_spike_yrs,
 round(avg(late) FILTER (WHERE yr NOT IN (2016,2021)),1) avg_late_normal_yr, sum(n_lr) n_lr_jobs, count(*) n_years
FROM y

WITH jn AS (
  SELECT j.job_id, j.part_id, substr(j.created_on,1,4) yr, p.created_on pc, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY j.part_id ORDER BY j.created_on, j.job_id) k
  FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_customer_parts p USING(part_id) WHERE j.kind='order' AND j.completed_on IS NOT NULL),
ops AS (
  SELECT o.job_id, o.work_centre wc, o.est_setup_hours+o.est_run_hours est, coalesce(la.h,0) act
  FROM erp_job_operations o LEFT JOIN (SELECT op_id, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY op_id) la USING(op_id))
SELECT CASE WHEN pc < '2017' THEN 'part_pre2017' ELSE 'part_2017on' END cohort,
 CASE WHEN k=1 THEN '01' WHEN k<=3 THEN '02-03' WHEN k<=10 THEN '04-10' ELSE '11+' END nth,
 count(*) n,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN wc='laser' THEN act END)/sum(CASE WHEN wc='laser' THEN est END),3) laser,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN wc='brake' THEN act END)/sum(CASE WHEN wc='brake' THEN est END),3) brake,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN wc='weld' THEN act END)/sum(CASE WHEN wc='weld' THEN est END),3) weld,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN wc='inspect' THEN act END)/sum(CASE WHEN wc='inspect' THEN est END),3) inspect
FROM ops JOIN jn USING(job_id) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH sh AS (SELECT sl.job_id, max(s.shipped_on::DATE) last_ship FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
rc AS (SELECT po.job_id, max(CASE WHEN r.received_on::DATE > po.due_on::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late_rcpt FROM erp_purchase_orders po LEFT JOIN erp_receipts r USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),
base AS (SELECT year(l.promised_date::DATE) yr, c.segment, CASE WHEN sh.last_ship > l.promised_date::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END late
  FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_sales_orders so USING(order_id) JOIN erp_customers c ON c.customer_id=so.customer_id JOIN sh USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN rc USING(job_id)
  WHERE j.kind='order' AND l.promised_date>='2016-01-01' AND coalesce(rc.late_rcpt,0)=0)
SELECT segment, count(*) FILTER (WHERE yr=2016) n16, round(avg(late) FILTER (WHERE yr=2016),4) r16, count(*) FILTER (WHERE yr=2021) n21, round(avg(late) FILTER (WHERE yr=2021),4) r21,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE yr NOT IN (2016,2021)) n_other, round(avg(late) FILTER (WHERE yr NOT IN (2016,2021)),4) r_other
FROM base GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH jn AS (
  SELECT j.job_id, substr(j.created_on,1,4) yr, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY j.part_id ORDER BY j.created_on, j.job_id) k
  FROM erp_jobs j WHERE j.kind='order' AND j.completed_on IS NOT NULL),
ops AS (
  SELECT o.job_id, o.work_centre wc, o.est_setup_hours+o.est_run_hours est, coalesce(la.h,0) act
  FROM erp_job_operations o LEFT JOIN (SELECT op_id, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY op_id) la USING(op_id)
  WHERE o.work_centre='laser')
SELECT yr,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN k=1 THEN act END)/sum(CASE WHEN k=1 THEN est END),3) k1,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN k BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN act END)/sum(CASE WHEN k BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN est END),3) k2_3,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN k BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN act END)/sum(CASE WHEN k BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN est END),3) k4_10,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN k>=11 THEN act END)/sum(CASE WHEN k>=11 THEN est END),3) k11,
 sum(CASE WHEN k=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_k1, sum(CASE WHEN k>=11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_k11
FROM ops JOIN jn USING(job_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH le AS (SELECT le.*, year(le.work_date::DATE) yr, CASE WHEN le.work_date::DATE - e.hired_on::DATE < 365 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END newbie FROM shop_labour_entries le JOIN hr_employees e USING(employee_id)),
est AS (SELECT year(completed_on::DATE) yr, sum(est_setup_hours+est_run_hours) est_h, sum(a.h) act_h FROM erp_job_operations o JOIN (SELECT op_id, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1) a USING(op_id) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT le.yr, round(sum(hours)) clocked_h, round(sum(hours) FILTER (WHERE newbie=1)*1.0/sum(hours),4) share_h_by_lt1yr_tenure, round(avg(rework)::DOUBLE,4) rework_entry_share,
 round(any_value(est.act_h)/any_value(est.est_h),4) act_over_est
FROM le JOIN est USING(yr) GROUP BY le.yr ORDER BY le.yr

WITH l AS (
  SELECT q.estimator_id, ql.quote_line_id, j.job_id, j.quantity jq, substr(q.sent_on,1,4) yr
  FROM erp_sales_orders so JOIN erp_quotes q ON q.quote_id=so.quote_id
