  JOIN erp_jobs j ON j.line_id=sl.line_id AND j.kind='order'
  WHERE j.completed_on IS NOT NULL),
eco AS (SELECT DISTINCT job_id FROM eng_ecos WHERE job_id IS NOT NULL),
ops AS (SELECT o.job_id, o.work_centre wc, sum(coalesce(la.h,0)) act FROM erp_job_operations o LEFT JOIN (SELECT op_id, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY op_id) la USING(op_id) GROUP BY 1,2),
d AS (SELECT l.*, ops.wc, act, h.setup_hours+h.run_hours*jq qh, CASE WHEN eco.job_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END has_eco
  FROM l JOIN ops USING(job_id) JOIN erp_quote_line_hours h ON h.quote_line_id=l.quote_line_id AND h.work_centre=ops.wc LEFT JOIN eco USING(job_id))
SELECT 'eco' grp, has_eco::varchar g, count(*) FILTER (WHERE wc='weld') n_weld,
 round(sum(act) FILTER (WHERE wc='weld')/sum(qh) FILTER (WHERE wc='weld'),3) weld,
 round(sum(act) FILTER (WHERE wc<>'weld')/sum(qh) FILTER (WHERE wc<>'weld'),3) nonweld
FROM d GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'estimator', estimator_id::varchar, count(*) FILTER (WHERE wc='weld'),
 round(sum(act) FILTER (WHERE wc='weld')/sum(qh) FILTER (WHERE wc='weld'),3),
 round(sum(act) FILTER (WHERE wc<>'weld')/sum(qh) FILTER (WHERE wc<>'weld'),3)
FROM d GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH jn AS (
  SELECT job_id, substr(created_on,1,4) yr, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY part_id ORDER BY created_on, job_id) k
  FROM erp_jobs WHERE kind='order' AND completed_on IS NOT NULL),
ops AS (SELECT o.job_id, o.est_setup_hours+o.est_run_hours est, coalesce(la.h,0) act
  FROM erp_job_operations o LEFT JOIN (SELECT op_id, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY op_id) la USING(op_id) WHERE o.work_centre='weld')
SELECT yr, sum(CASE WHEN k>=4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_rep,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN k>=4 THEN act END)/sum(CASE WHEN k>=4 THEN est END),3) weld_rep_4plus,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN k=1 THEN act END)/sum(CASE WHEN k=1 THEN est END),3) weld_k1
FROM ops JOIN jn USING(job_id) WHERE yr>='2016' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (
  SELECT q.estimator_id, substr(q.sent_on,1,4) yr, ql.quote_line_id, j.job_id, j.quantity jq
  FROM erp_sales_orders so JOIN erp_quotes q ON q.quote_id=so.quote_id
  JOIN erp_so_lines sl ON sl.order_id=so.order_id
  JOIN erp_quote_lines ql ON ql.quote_id=q.quote_id AND ql.part_id=sl.part_id
  JOIN erp_jobs j ON j.line_id=sl.line_id AND j.kind='order' WHERE j.completed_on IS NOT NULL),
ops AS (SELECT o.job_id, sum(coalesce(la.h,0)) act FROM erp_job_operations o LEFT JOIN (SELECT op_id, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY op_id) la USING(op_id) WHERE o.work_centre='weld' GROUP BY 1),
d AS (SELECT l.*, act, h.setup_hours+h.run_hours*jq qh FROM l JOIN ops USING(job_id) JOIN erp_quote_line_hours h ON h.quote_line_id=l.quote_line_id AND h.work_centre='weld')
SELECT yr, count(*) n, round(sum(act)/sum(qh),3) all_est,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE estimator_id=108) n108, round(sum(act) FILTER (WHERE estimator_id=108)/sum(qh) FILTER (WHERE estimator_id=108),3) est108,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN act>qh THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),3) share_over, round(quantile_cont(act/qh,0.25),3) p25, round(quantile_cont(act/qh,0.75),3) p75
FROM d GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (
  SELECT q.estimator_id, substr(q.sent_on,1,4) yr, ql.quote_line_id, j.job_id, j.quantity jq
  FROM erp_sales_orders so JOIN erp_quotes q ON q.quote_id=so.quote_id
  JOIN erp_so_lines sl ON sl.order_id=so.order_id
  JOIN erp_quote_lines ql ON ql.quote_id=q.quote_id AND ql.part_id=sl.part_id
  JOIN erp_jobs j ON j.line_id=sl.line_id AND j.kind='order' WHERE j.completed_on IS NOT NULL),
ops AS (SELECT o.job_id, sum(coalesce(la.h,0)) act FROM erp_job_operations o LEFT JOIN (SELECT op_id, sum(hours) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY op_id) la USING(op_id) WHERE o.work_centre='weld' GROUP BY 1),
d AS (SELECT l.*, act, h.setup_hours+h.run_hours*jq qh FROM l JOIN ops USING(job_id) JOIN erp_quote_line_hours h ON h.quote_line_id=l.quote_line_id AND h.work_centre='weld')
SELECT CASE WHEN yr<='2020' THEN '2016-2020' ELSE '2021-2025' END per, estimator_id IN (108,109) old_estimators,
 count(*) n, round(sum(act)/sum(qh),3) weld_act_q
FROM d GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH qt AS (
  SELECT q.quote_id, q.status, sum(ql.est_hours) h, sum(ql.est_material) m
  FROM erp_quotes q JOIN erp_quote_lines ql USING(quote_id)
  WHERE q.kind='new' AND q.status IN ('won','lost','expired','no award') GROUP BY 1,2),
b AS (SELECT *, ntile(5) OVER (ORDER BY h/nullif(m,0), quote_id) qn FROM qt)
SELECT qn, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN status='expired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) expired,
 sum(CASE WHEN status IN ('won','lost') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won_or_lost,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN status='won' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END)/sum(CASE WHEN status IN ('won','lost') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),4) win_vs_lost
FROM b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT (46295-36250)/10.0 incl_rework_h_yr, (45915-36250)/10.0 excl_rework_h_yr, round((45915-36250)/45915.0,4) excess_share_of_actual

WITH q AS (SELECT estimator_id e, substr(sent_on,1,7) ym, (status='won')::int w FROM erp_quotes WHERE kind='new' AND status IS NOT NULL AND status<>''),
cell AS (SELECT ym,e,count(*) n,sum(w) w FROM q GROUP BY 1,2),
tot AS (SELECT ym,sum(n) n,sum(w) w FROM cell GROUP BY 1),
j AS (SELECT cell.*, tot.n-cell.n on_, tot.w-cell.w ow FROM cell JOIN tot USING(ym) WHERE tot.n>cell.n)
SELECT e, sum(n) n, round((sum(w)-sum(n*ow/on_))/sum(n),3) diff FROM j WHERE e IN (108,109,115,254,327) GROUP BY e ORDER BY e

SELECT 'po_due' f, min(due_on) mn, max(due_on) mx, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE try_cast(due_on AS DATE) IS NULL) bad FROM erp_purchase_orders
UNION ALL SELECT 'rcpt', min(received_on), max(received_on), count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE try_cast(received_on AS DATE) IS NULL) FROM erp_receipts
UNION ALL SELECT 'ship', min(shipped_on), max(shipped_on), count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE try_cast(shipped_on AS DATE) IS NULL) FROM erp_shipments
UNION ALL SELECT 'promised', min(promised_date), max(promised_date), count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE try_cast(promised_date AS DATE) IS NULL) FROM erp_so_lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'job_rel', min(released_on), max(released_on), count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE try_cast(released_on AS DATE) IS NULL) FROM erp_jobs
UNION ALL SELECT 'job_comp', min(completed_on), max(completed_on), count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE try_cast(completed_on AS DATE) IS NULL) FROM erp_jobs
ORDER BY f

WITH sh AS (SELECT sl.job_id, max(s.shipped_on::DATE) last_ship FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
r1 AS (SELECT po_id, min(received_on::DATE) first_r, max(received_on::DATE) last_r FROM erp_receipts GROUP BY 1),
rc AS (SELECT po.job_id, count(*) n_po, count(r1.po_id) n_recv, max(CASE WHEN r1.last_r > po.due_on::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late_rcpt
  FROM erp_purchase_orders po LEFT JOIN r1 USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),
base AS (SELECT year(l.promised_date::DATE) yr, CASE WHEN sh.last_ship > l.promised_date::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END late,
  CASE WHEN rc.job_id IS NULL THEN 'a_no_po' WHEN rc.late_rcpt=1 THEN 'd_late_rcpt' WHEN rc.n_recv<rc.n_po THEN 'c_unreceived_po' ELSE 'b_all_on_time' END grp
  FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN sh USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN rc USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order')
SELECT grp, count(*) jobs, round(avg(late),4) late_rate,
 round(avg(late) FILTER (WHERE yr=2016),4) r16, round(avg(late) FILTER (WHERE yr=2021),4) r21, round(avg(late) FILTER (WHERE yr NOT IN (2016,2021)),4) r_oth,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE yr=2016) n16, count(*) FILTER (WHERE yr=2021) n21
FROM base GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH r AS (SELECT DISTINCT po_id FROM erp_receipts)
SELECT year(po.due_on::DATE) yr, count(*) pos, count(r.po_id) recv, round(1-count(r.po_id)*1.0/count(*),4) unrecv_share,
 round(avg(po.due_on::DATE - po.ordered_on::DATE),1) avg_lead_cal
FROM erp_purchase_orders po LEFT JOIN r USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH r AS (SELECT po_id, max(received_on::DATE) last_r FROM erp_receipts GROUP BY 1)
SELECT v.vendor_id, v.kind, count(*) pos, round(1-count(r.po_id)*1.0/count(*),4) unrecv_share,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN r.last_r > po.due_on::DATE THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE r.po_id IS NOT NULL),4) late_share_of_recv,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN r.last_r > po.due_on::DATE THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE r.po_id IS NOT NULL AND year(po.due_on::DATE)=2021),4) late21
FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_vendors v USING(vendor_id) LEFT JOIN r USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

WITH sh AS (SELECT sl.job_id, max(s.shipped_on::DATE) last_ship FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
r1 AS (SELECT po_id, max(received_on::DATE) last_r FROM erp_receipts GROUP BY 1),
rc AS (SELECT po.job_id, max(CASE WHEN r1.last_r > po.due_on::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late_rcpt,
  max(CASE WHEN v.kind='outside' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) has_outside,
  max(CASE WHEN v.kind<>'outside' AND r1.po_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mat_unrecv
  FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_vendors v USING(vendor_id) LEFT JOIN r1 USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),
base AS (SELECT year(l.promised_date::DATE) yr, CASE WHEN sh.last_ship > l.promised_date::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END late, rc.*
  FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN sh USING(job_id) JOIN rc USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order' AND rc.late_rcpt=0)
SELECT has_outside, mat_unrecv, count(*) jobs, round(avg(late),4) late_rate, round(avg(late) FILTER (WHERE yr IN (2016,2021)),4) r_spike, round(avg(late) FILTER (WHERE yr NOT IN (2016,2021)),4) r_oth
FROM base GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH tc AS (SELECT CAST(substr(week_of,1,4) AS INT) yr, employee_id, SUM(regular_hours+overtime_hours) paid FROM hr_timecards GROUP BY 1,2),
lb AS (SELECT CAST(substr(work_date,1,4) AS INT) yr, employee_id, SUM(hours) clk FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT COALESCE(tc.yr,lb.yr) yr, COUNT(tc.employee_id) emp_tc, COUNT(lb.employee_id) emp_lb, SUM(CASE WHEN tc.employee_id IS NOT NULL AND lb.employee_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tc_no_lb, SUM(CASE WHEN tc.employee_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lb_no_tc,
ROUND(SUM(paid),1) paid, ROUND(SUM(clk),1) clk, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tc.employee_id IS NOT NULL THEN clk END),1) clk_matched, ROUND(SUM(paid)-SUM(clk),1) unclk, ROUND((SUM(paid)-SUM(clk))/SUM(paid),3) share
FROM tc FULL JOIN lb ON tc.yr=lb.yr AND tc.employee_id=lb.employee_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH sh AS (SELECT sl.job_id, max(s.shipped_on::DATE) last_ship FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
oj AS (SELECT DISTINCT po.job_id FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_vendors v USING(vendor_id) WHERE v.kind='outside'),
base AS (SELECT year(l.promised_date::DATE) yr, CASE WHEN sh.last_ship > l.promised_date::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END late, (oj.job_id IS NOT NULL)::INT outside
  FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN sh USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN oj USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order')
SELECT yr, count(*) FILTER (WHERE outside=1) n_out, sum(late) FILTER (WHERE outside=1) late_out, round(avg(late) FILTER (WHERE outside=1),4) r_out,
 sum(late) total_late, round(sum(late) FILTER (WHERE outside=1)*1.0/sum(late),4) share_late_out
FROM base GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH tc AS (SELECT CAST(substr(week_of,1,4) AS INT) yr, employee_id, SUM(regular_hours+overtime_hours) paid FROM hr_timecards GROUP BY 1,2),
lb AS (SELECT CAST(substr(work_date,1,4) AS INT) yr, employee_id, SUM(hours) clk FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT e.role, tc.yr, COUNT(*) n_emp, ROUND(SUM(paid),0) paid, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(clk,0)),0) clk, ROUND(1-SUM(COALESCE(clk,0))/SUM(paid),3) share
FROM tc LEFT JOIN lb USING(yr,employee_id) JOIN hr_employees e USING(employee_id) WHERE tc.yr BETWEEN 2016 AND 2025 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT o.work_centre, CAST(substr(o.completed_on,1,4) AS INT) yr, COUNT(*) n_ops, ROUND(SUM(o.est_setup_hours+o.est_run_hours),0) est_h
FROM erp_job_operations o WHERE o.completed_on IS NOT NULL AND substr(o.completed_on,1,4) BETWEEN '2016' AND '2025' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH sh AS (SELECT sl.job_id, max(s.shipped_on::DATE) last_ship, count(*) n_ship FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
base AS (SELECT year(l.promised_date::DATE) yr, CASE WHEN sh.last_ship > l.promised_date::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END late,
  j.created_on::DATE - so.order_date::DATE ord_to_create, try_cast(j.released_on AS DATE) - j.created_on::DATE create_to_rel,
  try_cast(j.completed_on AS DATE) - try_cast(j.released_on AS DATE) rel_to_comp, sh.last_ship - try_cast(j.completed_on AS DATE) comp_to_ship,
  l.promised_date::DATE - try_cast(j.released_on AS DATE) slack_at_release,
  CASE WHEN try_cast(j.completed_on AS DATE) > l.promised_date::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END comp_after_promise, sh.n_ship
  FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN erp_sales_orders so USING(order_id) JOIN sh USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order')
SELECT yr, count(*) jobs, round(avg(late),4) late_rate, round(avg(ord_to_create),1) o2c, round(avg(create_to_rel),1) c2r, round(avg(rel_to_comp),1) r2c,
 round(median(rel_to_comp),1) med_r2c, round(quantile_cont(rel_to_comp,0.9),1) p90_r2c, round(avg(comp_to_ship),2) c2s, round(avg(slack_at_release),1) slack_rel,
 round(sum(comp_after_promise)*1.0/sum(late),4) late_share_comp_after_promise, round(avg(n_ship),3) ships_per_job
FROM base GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT o.work_centre, e.role, CAST(substr(l.work_date,1,4) AS INT) yr, ROUND(SUM(l.hours),0) h
FROM shop_labour_entries l JOIN erp_job_operations o USING(op_id) JOIN hr_employees e USING(employee_id)
WHERE substr(l.work_date,1,4) IN ('2016','2020','2025') GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING SUM(l.hours)>200 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH l AS (
  SELECT q.estimator_id, substr(q.sent_on,1,4) yr, ql.quote_line_id, j.job_id, j.quantity jq
  FROM erp_sales_orders so JOIN erp_quotes q ON q.quote_id=so.quote_id
  JOIN erp_so_lines sl ON sl.order_id=so.order_id
  JOIN erp_quote_lines ql ON ql.quote_id=q.quote_id AND ql.part_id=sl.part_id
  JOIN erp_jobs j ON j.line_id=sl.line_id AND j.kind='order' WHERE j.completed_on IS NOT NULL),
ops AS (SELECT o.job_id, sum(coalesce(la.h,0)) act FROM erp_job_operations o LEFT JOIN (SELECT op_id, sum(CASE WHEN rework=1 THEN 0 ELSE hours END) h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY op_id) la USING(op_id) WHERE o.work_centre='weld' GROUP BY 1),
d AS (SELECT CASE WHEN yr<='2020' THEN 'p1' ELSE 'p2' END per, estimator_id IN (108,109) old, act, h.setup_hours+h.run_hours*jq qh
  FROM l JOIN ops USING(job_id) JOIN erp_quote_line_hours h ON h.quote_line_id=l.quote_line_id AND h.work_centre='weld'),
g AS (SELECT per, old, sum(act) a, sum(qh) q FROM d GROUP BY 1,2),
t AS (SELECT per, sum(a)/sum(q) overall FROM g GROUP BY 1),
w1 AS (SELECT old, q/sum(q) OVER () w FROM g WHERE per='p1'),
cf AS (SELECT sum(w1.w * g.a/g.q) p2_at_p1_mix FROM g JOIN w1 USING(old) WHERE g.per='p2')
SELECT round((SELECT overall FROM t WHERE per='p1'),3) p1_overall,
 round((SELECT overall FROM t WHERE per='p2'),3) p2_overall,
 round((SELECT p2_at_p1_mix FROM cf),3) p2_at_p1_mix,
 round((SELECT p2_at_p1_mix FROM cf)-(SELECT overall FROM t WHERE per='p1'),3) within_change,
 round((SELECT overall FROM t WHERE per='p2')-(SELECT p2_at_p1_mix FROM cf),3) mix_change

WITH a AS (SELECT op_id, SUM(hours) act FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1)
SELECT o.work_centre, CAST(substr(o.completed_on,1,4) AS INT) yr, COUNT(*) n_ops, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(a.act,0))/SUM(o.est_setup_hours+o.est_run_hours),3) act_over_est
FROM erp_job_operations o LEFT JOIN a USING(op_id) WHERE o.completed_on IS NOT NULL AND substr(o.completed_on,1,4) BETWEEN '2016' AND '2025' AND o.work_centre IN ('laser','brake','paint','mill','lathe','weld','assembly')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH sh AS (SELECT sl.job_id, max(s.shipped_on::DATE) last_ship FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
r1 AS (SELECT po_id, max(received_on::DATE) last_r FROM erp_receipts GROUP BY 1),
rc AS (SELECT po.job_id, max(CASE WHEN r1.last_r > po.due_on::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late_rcpt, max(r1.last_r) last_rcpt, max(po.due_on::DATE) last_due, min(po.ordered_on::DATE) first_ord
  FROM erp_purchase_orders po LEFT JOIN r1 USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),
base AS (SELECT strftime(l.promised_date::DATE,'%Y-%m') ym, CASE WHEN sh.last_ship > l.promised_date::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END late,
  try_cast(j.released_on AS DATE) - j.created_on::DATE c2r, try_cast(j.completed_on AS DATE) - try_cast(j.released_on AS DATE) r2c,
  rc.last_due - j.created_on::DATE due_after_create, rc.last_rcpt - try_cast(j.released_on AS DATE) rcpt_minus_rel
  FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN sh USING(job_id) JOIN rc USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order' AND rc.late_rcpt=0)
SELECT ym, count(*) n, round(avg(late),3) late_rate, round(avg(c2r),1) c2r, round(avg(r2c),1) r2c, round(avg(due_after_create),1) due_after_create, round(avg(rcpt_minus_rel),1) rcpt_minus_rel
FROM base WHERE ym BETWEEN '2016-01' AND '2017-06' OR ym BETWEEN '2020-07' AND '2022-03' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH tc AS (SELECT CAST(substr(week_of,1,4) AS INT) yr, employee_id, SUM(regular_hours) reg, SUM(overtime_hours) ot, COUNT(*) wks FROM hr_timecards GROUP BY 1,2),
lb AS (SELECT CAST(substr(work_date,1,4) AS INT) yr, employee_id, SUM(hours) clk FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT e.role, tc.yr, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(reg),0) reg, ROUND(SUM(ot),0) ot, ROUND(SUM(reg+ot)/SUM(wks),1) paid_per_wk,
ROUND(quantile_cont(1-COALESCE(clk,0)/(reg+ot),0.1),3) p10, ROUND(median(1-COALESCE(clk,0)/(reg+ot)),3) p50, ROUND(quantile_cont(1-COALESCE(clk,0)/(reg+ot),0.9),3) p90
FROM tc LEFT JOIN lb USING(yr,employee_id) JOIN hr_employees e USING(employee_id)
WHERE tc.yr IN (2016,2019,2022,2025) AND e.role NOT IN ('welder','inspector') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT reason_code, '|' ORDER BY reason_code) FROM shop_scrap_reports) sc, (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT reason, '|' ORDER BY reason) FROM erp_return_authorisations) ra, (SELECT min(released_on)||' / '||min(received_on)||' / '||min(revision) FROM eng_drawing_revisions) dr, (SELECT min(released_on)||' / '||min(revision_issued) FROM erp_jobs) j
rows: dimension out of tolerance|first article|material|operator error|other|paint or finish|weld defect|wrong revision

sql:
WITH tc AS (SELECT CAST(substr(week_of,1,4) AS INT) yr, employee_id, SUM(regular_hours+overtime_hours) paid FROM hr_timecards GROUP BY 1,2),
lb AS (SELECT CAST(substr(work_date,1,4) AS INT) yr, employee_id, SUM(hours) clk FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT e.role, tc.yr, SUM(paid) paid, SUM(COALESCE(clk,0)) clk FROM tc LEFT JOIN lb USING(yr,employee_id) JOIN hr_employees e USING(employee_id) WHERE tc.yr IN (2016,2025) GROUP BY 1,2),
d AS (SELECT role, SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2025 THEN paid-clk ELSE -(paid-clk) END) d_unclk, SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2025 THEN paid ELSE -paid END) d_paid, SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2025 THEN clk ELSE -clk END) d_clk FROM r GROUP BY 1)
SELECT role, ROUND(d_unclk,0) d_unclk, ROUND(d_paid,0) d_paid, ROUND(d_clk,0) d_clk, ROUND(d_unclk/SUM(d_unclk) OVER (),3) share_of_growth, ROUND(SUM(d_unclk) OVER (),0) total_growth FROM d ORDER BY d_unclk DESC

WITH r1 AS (SELECT po_id, max(received_on::DATE) last_r FROM erp_receipts GROUP BY 1),
rc AS (SELECT po.job_id, max(CASE WHEN r1.last_r > po.due_on::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late_rcpt, max(r1.last_r) last_rcpt, count(r1.po_id) n_recv, count(*) n_po
  FROM erp_purchase_orders po LEFT JOIN r1 USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT late_rcpt, (n_recv<n_po) has_unrecv, count(*) jobs, count(last_rcpt) jobs_with_rcpt,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN try_cast(j.released_on AS DATE)=last_rcpt THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE last_rcpt IS NOT NULL),4) share_release_eq_last_rcpt,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN try_cast(j.released_on AS DATE)<last_rcpt THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE last_rcpt IS NOT NULL),4) share_release_before_rcpt
FROM erp_jobs j JOIN rc USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH j AS (
 SELECT j.job_id, j.part_id, j.kind, j.released_on, j.revision_issued,
  coalesce((SELECT max(revision) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on<=j.released_on),'A') rec_rev,
  coalesce((SELECT max(revision) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.released_on<=j.released_on),'A') rel_rev
 FROM erp_jobs j WHERE j.released_on IS NOT NULL)
SELECT kind,
 CASE WHEN revision_issued=rec_rev THEN 'a_current' WHEN revision_issued=rel_rev THEN 'b_lag_window' WHEN revision_issued<rel_rev THEN 'c_older_than_released' ELSE 'd_newer' END cls,
 count(*) jobs, max(length(revision_issued)) maxlen
FROM j GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY kind, cls

WITH tc AS (SELECT CAST(substr(week_of,1,4) AS INT) yr, employee_id, SUM(regular_hours+overtime_hours) paid FROM hr_timecards GROUP BY 1,2),
lb AS (SELECT CAST(substr(work_date,1,4) AS INT) yr, employee_id, SUM(hours) clk FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT CASE WHEN tc.yr - CAST(substr(e.hired_on,1,4) AS INT) <= 0 THEN 'hired this year' ELSE 'tenured' END grp,
 tc.yr, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(paid),0) paid, ROUND(1-SUM(COALESCE(clk,0))/SUM(paid),3) share
FROM tc LEFT JOIN lb USING(yr,employee_id) JOIN hr_employees e USING(employee_id) WHERE tc.yr BETWEEN 2016 AND 2025 AND e.role<>'welder' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH j AS (
 SELECT j.job_id, j.part_id, j.released_on, j.revision_issued,
  coalesce((SELECT max(revision) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on<=j.released_on),'A') rec_rev,
  coalesce((SELECT max(revision) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.released_on<=j.released_on),'A') rel_rev,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id)>0 has_revs
 FROM erp_jobs j WHERE j.released_on IS NOT NULL),
c AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN revision_issued=rec_rev THEN 'a_current' WHEN revision_issued=rel_rev THEN 'b_lag_window' ELSE 'c_older_than_released' END cls FROM j),
s AS (SELECT job_id, count(*) n, sum(quantity) q FROM shop_scrap_reports WHERE reason_code='wrong revision' GROUP BY 1),
ra AS (SELECT job_id, count(*) n FROM erp_return_authorisations WHERE reason IN ('does not fit','wrong dimensions','nonconforming') GROUP BY 1),
ra_all AS (SELECT job_id, count(*) n FROM erp_return_authorisations GROUP BY 1)
SELECT cls, has_revs, count(*) jobs, count(s.job_id) jobs_wr_scrap, coalesce(sum(s.n),0) wr_reports, coalesce(sum(s.q),0) wr_pieces,
 round(100.0*count(s.job_id)/count(*),3) pct_jobs_wr, coalesce(sum(ra.n),0) fit_dim_nc_returns, coalesce(sum(ra_all.n),0) all_returns
FROM c LEFT JOIN s USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN ra USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN ra_all USING(job_id)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY cls, has_revs

WITH sh AS (SELECT sl.job_id, max(s.shipped_on::DATE) last_ship FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
r1 AS (SELECT po_id, max(received_on::DATE) last_r FROM erp_receipts GROUP BY 1),
rc AS (SELECT po.job_id, max(CASE WHEN r1.last_r > po.due_on::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late_rcpt, avg(po.due_on::DATE - po.ordered_on::DATE) po_lead
  FROM erp_purchase_orders po LEFT JOIN r1 USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),
base AS (SELECT strftime(l.promised_date::DATE,'%Y-%m') ym, CASE WHEN sh.last_ship > l.promised_date::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END late,
  try_cast(j.released_on AS DATE) - j.created_on::DATE c2r, try_cast(j.completed_on AS DATE) - try_cast(j.released_on AS DATE) r2c, rc.po_lead
  FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN sh USING(job_id) JOIN rc USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order' AND rc.late_rcpt=0 AND l.promised_date>='2016-01-01'),
m AS (SELECT ym, avg(late) lr, avg(c2r) c2r, avg(r2c) r2c, avg(po_lead) po_lead, count(*) n FROM base GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) n_months, sum(n) jobs, round(corr(lr,c2r),3) r_c2r, round(corr(lr,r2c),3) r_r2c, round(corr(lr,po_lead),3) r_polead, round(corr(c2r,po_lead),3) r_c2r_polead, round(corr(c2r,r2c),3) r_c2r_r2c,
 round(corr(lr, c2r+r2c),3) r_total
FROM m

WITH sh AS (SELECT sl.job_id, max(s.shipped_on::DATE) last_ship FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
r1 AS (SELECT po_id, max(received_on::DATE) last_r FROM erp_receipts GROUP BY 1),
rc AS (SELECT po.job_id, max(CASE WHEN r1.last_r > po.due_on::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late_rcpt, avg(po.due_on::DATE - po.ordered_on::DATE) po_lead
  FROM erp_purchase_orders po LEFT JOIN r1 USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT year(po.due_on::DATE) yr, v.kind, count(*) pos, round(avg(po.due_on::DATE - po.ordered_on::DATE),1) lead_cal, round(avg(po.ordered_on::DATE - j.created_on::DATE),1) ord_after_create
FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_vendors v USING(vendor_id) JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id)
WHERE v.kind<>'outside' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

WITH tc AS (SELECT CAST(substr(week_of,1,4) AS INT) yr, employee_id, SUM(regular_hours+overtime_hours) paid FROM hr_timecards GROUP BY 1,2),
lb AS (SELECT CAST(substr(work_date,1,4) AS INT) yr, employee_id, SUM(hours) clk FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT e.role, tc.yr, SUM(paid-COALESCE(clk,0)) unclk FROM tc LEFT JOIN lb USING(yr,employee_id) JOIN hr_employees e USING(employee_id) WHERE tc.yr IN (2016,2025) GROUP BY 1,2),
d AS (SELECT role, SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2025 THEN unclk ELSE -unclk END) d_unclk FROM r GROUP BY 1),
rate AS (SELECT employee_id, arg_max(hourly, effective_on) hourly FROM hr_pay_rates WHERE effective_on <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1),
rr AS (SELECT e.role, median(rate.hourly) med_rate FROM rate JOIN hr_employees e USING(employee_id) WHERE employee_id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM tc WHERE yr=2025) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT role, ROUND(d_unclk,0) d_unclk, ROUND(med_rate,2) med_rate_2025, ROUND(d_unclk*med_rate,0) usd,
 ROUND(SUM(d_unclk*med_rate) OVER (),0) total_usd,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d_unclk>0 THEN d_unclk*med_rate END) OVER (),0) total_usd_pos_roles,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN role IN ('machinist mill','machinist lathe') THEN d_unclk*med_rate END) OVER (),0) usd_machining,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN role IN ('laser operator','painter') THEN d_unclk*med_rate END) OVER (),0) usd_laser_paint
FROM d JOIN rr USING(role) ORDER BY usd DESC

WITH j AS (
 SELECT j.job_id, j.part_id, j.released_on, j.completed_on, j.revision_issued,
  coalesce((SELECT max(revision) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on<=j.released_on),'A') rec_rev,
  coalesce((SELECT max(revision) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.released_on<=j.released_on),'A') rel_rev,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on>j.released_on AND r.received_on<=coalesce(j.completed_on,'9999')) mid_job_revs,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_ecos e WHERE e.job_id=j.job_id) ecos
 FROM erp_jobs j WHERE j.released_on IS NOT NULL
   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id)),
c AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN revision_issued=rec_rev THEN 'a_current' ELSE 'bc_superseded' END cls,
   CASE WHEN mid_job_revs>0 THEN 'rev_mid_job' ELSE 'no_mid' END mid, CASE WHEN ecos>0 THEN 'eco' ELSE 'no_eco' END eco FROM j),
s AS (SELECT job_id, count(*) n, sum(quantity) q FROM shop_scrap_reports WHERE reason_code='wrong revision' GROUP BY 1),
ra AS (SELECT job_id, count(*) n FROM erp_return_authorisations WHERE reason IN ('does not fit','wrong dimensions','nonconforming') GROUP BY 1)
SELECT cls, mid, eco, count(*) jobs, count(s.job_id) jobs_wr, coalesce(sum(s.q),0) wr_pieces, round(100.0*count(s.job_id)/count(*),3) pct, coalesce(sum(ra.n),0) fit_returns
FROM c LEFT JOIN s USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN ra USING(job_id) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH sh AS (SELECT sl.job_id, max(s.shipped_on::DATE) last_ship FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
r1 AS (SELECT po_id, max(received_on::DATE) last_r FROM erp_receipts GROUP BY 1),
rc AS (SELECT po.job_id, max(CASE WHEN r1.last_r > po.due_on::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late_rcpt FROM erp_purchase_orders po LEFT JOIN r1 USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),
base AS (SELECT CASE WHEN year(l.promised_date::DATE)=2016 THEN '2016' WHEN year(l.promised_date::DATE)=2021 THEN '2021' ELSE 'other' END grp,
  CASE WHEN sh.last_ship > l.promised_date::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END late, l.promised_date::DATE - try_cast(j.released_on AS DATE) slack
  FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN sh USING(job_id) JOIN rc USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order' AND rc.late_rcpt=0 AND try_cast(j.released_on AS DATE) IS NOT NULL),
b AS (SELECT grp, late, CASE WHEN slack<=14 THEN 'a <=14' WHEN slack<=21 THEN 'b 15-21' WHEN slack<=28 THEN 'c 22-28' WHEN slack<=35 THEN 'd 29-35' ELSE 'e >35' END sb FROM base)
SELECT sb, count(*) FILTER (WHERE grp='2016') n16, round(avg(late) FILTER (WHERE grp='2016'),4) r16, count(*) FILTER (WHERE grp='2021') n21, round(avg(late) FILTER (WHERE grp='2021'),4) r21,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE grp='other') n_oth, round(avg(late) FILTER (WHERE grp='other'),4) r_oth
FROM b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH j AS (
 SELECT j.job_id, j.part_id, j.line_id, j.released_on, j.revision_issued, j.kind,
  coalesce((SELECT max(revision) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on<=j.released_on),'A') rec_rev,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on>j.released_on AND r.received_on<=coalesce(j.completed_on,'9999')) mid_job_revs,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_ecos e WHERE e.job_id=j.job_id) ecos
 FROM erp_jobs j WHERE j.released_on IS NOT NULL),
c AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN revision_issued<>rec_rev THEN 'superseded_at_release' WHEN mid_job_revs>0 AND ecos=0 THEN 'rev_mid_job_no_eco' ELSE 'other' END cls FROM j),
s AS (SELECT sr.job_id, sum(sr.quantity) q, sum(sr.quantity*l.unit_price) val FROM shop_scrap_reports sr JOIN erp_jobs jj USING(job_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=jj.line_id WHERE reason_code='wrong revision' GROUP BY 1),
cr AS (SELECT ra.job_id, ra.reason, sum(cm.amount) amt, count(DISTINCT cm.credit_id) n FROM erp_return_authorisations ra
   JOIN erp_shipment_lines sl ON sl.job_id=ra.job_id JOIN erp_invoices i ON i.shipment_id=sl.shipment_id JOIN erp_credit_memos cm ON cm.invoice_id=i.invoice_id
   GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT cls, count(*) jobs, coalesce(sum(s.q),0) wr_pieces, round(coalesce(sum(s.val),0),0) wr_scrap_value,
 round(coalesce(sum(cr.amt) FILTER (WHERE cr.reason IN ('does not fit','wrong dimensions','nonconforming')),0),0) fit_credit,
 coalesce(sum(cr.n) FILTER (WHERE cr.reason IN ('does not fit','wrong dimensions','nonconforming')),0) fit_credits_n,
 round(coalesce(sum(cr.amt),0),0) all_credit, coalesce(sum(cr.n),0) all_credits_n
FROM c LEFT JOIN s USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN cr USING(job_id) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY cls

WITH sh AS (SELECT sl.job_id, max(s.shipped_on::DATE) last_ship FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
r1 AS (SELECT po_id, max(received_on::DATE) last_r FROM erp_receipts GROUP BY 1),
rc AS (SELECT po.job_id, max(CASE WHEN r1.last_r > po.due_on::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late_rcpt FROM erp_purchase_orders po LEFT JOIN r1 USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),
base AS (SELECT CASE WHEN year(l.promised_date::DATE)=2016 THEN '2016' WHEN year(l.promised_date::DATE)=2021 THEN '2021' ELSE 'other' END grp,
  CASE WHEN sh.last_ship > l.promised_date::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END late, l.promised_date::DATE - try_cast(j.released_on AS DATE) slack
  FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN sh USING(job_id) JOIN rc USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order' AND rc.late_rcpt=0 AND try_cast(j.released_on AS DATE) IS NOT NULL),
b AS (SELECT grp, late, CASE WHEN slack<=14 THEN 'a' WHEN slack<=21 THEN 'b' WHEN slack<=28 THEN 'c' WHEN slack<=35 THEN 'd' ELSE 'e' END sb FROM base),
c AS (SELECT grp, sb, count(*) n, avg(late) r FROM b GROUP BY 1,2),
t AS (SELECT grp, sum(n) tot FROM c GROUP BY 1),
x AS (SELECT c.grp, c.sb, c.n, c.r, c.n*1.0/t.tot sh, o.r r_oth, o.n*1.0/ot.tot sh_oth
  FROM c JOIN t USING(grp) JOIN c o ON o.sb=c.sb AND o.grp='other' JOIN t ot ON ot.grp='other')
SELECT grp, sum(n) jobs, round(sum(n*r)) actual_late, round(sum(n*r)/sum(n),4) actual_rate,
 round(sum(sh*r_oth),4) rate_if_own_mix_other_rates, round(sum(sh_oth*r),4) rate_if_other_mix_own_rates, round(sum(sh_oth*r_oth),4) other_rate,
 round(sum(sh) FILTER (WHERE sb='a'),4) share_slack_le14
FROM x WHERE grp IN ('2016','2021','other') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH j AS (
 SELECT j.job_id, j.part_id, j.line_id, j.released_on, j.revision_issued, p.customer_id,
  coalesce((SELECT max(revision) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on<=j.released_on),'A') rec_rev,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on>j.released_on AND r.received_on<=coalesce(j.completed_on,'9999')) mid_job_revs,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_ecos e WHERE e.job_id=j.job_id) ecos
 FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_customer_parts p USING(part_id) WHERE j.released_on IS NOT NULL),
c AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN revision_issued<>rec_rev THEN 'superseded' WHEN mid_job_revs>0 AND ecos=0 THEN 'mid_no_eco' WHEN mid_job_revs>0 THEN 'mid_eco' ELSE 'other' END cls FROM j),
s AS (SELECT job_id, sum(quantity) q FROM shop_scrap_reports WHERE reason_code='wrong revision' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT substr(released_on,1,4) yr, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cls='superseded') sup_jobs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cls='mid_no_eco') mid_no_eco_jobs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cls='mid_eco') mid_eco_jobs,
 round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE cls='mid_eco')/nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE cls IN ('mid_eco','mid_no_eco')),0),1) pct_mid_with_eco,
 count(s.job_id) jobs_wr, coalesce(sum(s.q),0) wr_pieces, count(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE cls IN ('superseded','mid_no_eco')) cust_at_risk
FROM c LEFT JOIN s USING(job_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH sh AS (SELECT sl.job_id, max(s.shipped_on::DATE) last_ship FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
r1 AS (SELECT po_id, max(received_on::DATE) last_r FROM erp_receipts GROUP BY 1),
rc AS (SELECT po.job_id, max(CASE WHEN r1.last_r > po.due_on::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late_rcpt, max(po.due_on::DATE) last_due FROM erp_purchase_orders po LEFT JOIN r1 USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),
base AS (SELECT year(l.promised_date::DATE) yr, CASE WHEN sh.last_ship > l.promised_date::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END late, rc.late_rcpt, l.promised_date::DATE - rc.last_due planned_slack
  FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN sh USING(job_id) JOIN rc USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order'),
b AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN planned_slack<=14 THEN 'a <=14' WHEN planned_slack<=21 THEN 'b 15-21' WHEN planned_slack<=28 THEN 'c 22-28' ELSE 'd >28' END pb FROM base WHERE yr NOT IN (2016,2021))
SELECT pb, count(*) FILTER (WHERE late_rcpt=1) n_lr, round(avg(late) FILTER (WHERE late_rcpt=1),4) r_lr, count(*) FILTER (WHERE late_rcpt=0) n_ot, round(avg(late) FILTER (WHERE late_rcpt=0),4) r_ot
FROM b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH j AS (
 SELECT j.job_id, j.line_id, j.released_on, j.revision_issued, p.customer_id,
  coalesce((SELECT max(revision) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on<=j.released_on),'A') rec_rev,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on>j.released_on AND r.received_on<=coalesce(j.completed_on,'9999')) mid_job_revs,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_ecos e WHERE e.job_id=j.job_id) ecos
 FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_customer_parts p USING(part_id) WHERE j.released_on IS NOT NULL),
risk AS (SELECT * FROM j WHERE revision_issued<>rec_rev OR (mid_job_revs>0 AND ecos=0)),
s AS (SELECT sr.job_id, sum(sr.quantity*l.unit_price) val FROM shop_scrap_reports sr JOIN erp_jobs jj USING(job_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=jj.line_id WHERE reason_code='wrong revision' GROUP BY 1),
cr AS (SELECT ra.job_id, sum(cm.amount) amt FROM erp_return_authorisations ra JOIN erp_shipment_lines sl ON sl.job_id=ra.job_id JOIN erp_invoices i ON i.shipment_id=sl.shipment_id JOIN erp_credit_memos cm ON cm.invoice_id=i.invoice_id
   WHERE ra.reason IN ('does not fit','wrong dimensions','nonconforming') GROUP BY 1),
tot AS (SELECT count(*) jobs, sum(coalesce(s.val,0)) scrap_val, sum(coalesce(cr.amt,0)) credit_val FROM risk LEFT JOIN s USING(job_id) LEFT JOIN cr USING(job_id)),
cust AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(coalesce(s.val,0)) v FROM risk LEFT JOIN s USING(job_id) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT jobs, round(scrap_val,0) scrap_val, round(credit_val,0) credit_val, round((scrap_val+credit_val)/10,0) per_year_10y,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM cust WHERE v>0) cust_with_wr,
 (SELECT round(100*sum(v)/(SELECT sum(v) FROM cust),1) FROM (SELECT v FROM cust ORDER BY v DESC, customer_id LIMIT 5)) top5_share_pct
FROM tot

WITH sh AS (SELECT sl.job_id, max(s.shipped_on::DATE) last_ship FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
r1 AS (SELECT po_id, max(received_on::DATE) last_r FROM erp_receipts GROUP BY 1),
rc AS (SELECT po.job_id, max(CASE WHEN r1.last_r > po.due_on::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late_rcpt, max(po.due_on::DATE) last_due FROM erp_purchase_orders po LEFT JOIN r1 USING(po_id) GROUP BY 1),
base AS (SELECT year(l.promised_date::DATE) yr, CASE WHEN sh.last_ship > l.promised_date::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END late, rc.late_rcpt,
  least(greatest(l.promised_date::DATE - rc.last_due,0)//7, 6) pb
  FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN sh USING(job_id) JOIN rc USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order'),
c AS (SELECT yr, pb, count(*) FILTER (WHERE late_rcpt=1) n1, sum(late) FILTER (WHERE late_rcpt=1) l1, avg(late) FILTER (WHERE late_rcpt=0) r0, count(*) FILTER (WHERE late_rcpt=0) n0 FROM base GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT sum(n1) lr_jobs, sum(n1) FILTER (WHERE n0>0) matched, round(sum(l1) FILTER (WHERE n0>0)*1.0/sum(n1) FILTER (WHERE n0>0),4) r_lr, round(sum(n1*r0) FILTER (WHERE n0>0)/sum(n1) FILTER (WHERE n0>0),4) r_ot_same_cell,
 round(sum(l1) FILTER (WHERE n0>0)*1.0/sum(n1*r0) FILTER (WHERE n0>0),2) ratio, round(sum(l1 - n1*r0) FILTER (WHERE n0>0)) excess_10y, round(sum(l1 - n1*r0) FILTER (WHERE n0>0)/10,1) excess_per_yr,
 round((SELECT avg(CASE WHEN pb<=1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FROM base WHERE late_rcpt=1),4) lr_share_slack_lt14, round((SELECT avg(CASE WHEN pb<=1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FROM base WHERE late_rcpt=0),4) ot_share_slack_lt14
FROM c

WITH sh AS (SELECT sl.job_id, max(s.shipped_on::DATE) last_ship FROM erp_shipment_lines sl JOIN erp_shipments s USING(shipment_id) GROUP BY 1),
base AS (SELECT year(l.promised_date::DATE) yr, month(l.promised_date::DATE) mo, CASE WHEN sh.last_ship > l.promised_date::DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END late
  FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_so_lines l USING(line_id) JOIN sh USING(job_id) WHERE j.kind='order')
SELECT mo, count(*) FILTER (WHERE yr NOT IN (2016,2021)) n_other, round(avg(late) FILTER (WHERE yr NOT IN (2016,2021)),4) r_other, round(max(yr_rate) ,4) max_other_yr_rate
FROM base JOIN (SELECT yr, mo, avg(late) yr_rate FROM base WHERE yr NOT IN (2016,2021) GROUP BY 1,2) USING(yr,mo) GROUP BY mo ORDER BY mo
SELECT 50726+396 no_mid_jobs, 57+23 credits_on_risk, 57+23+1 credits_total, 103+34 wr_reports_total, 18+39 fit_returns_on_risk, 40+7+11 fit_returns_total

SELECT CAST(substr(work_date,1,4) AS INT) yr, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(hours),1) h, SUM(CASE WHEN hours>40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_gt40, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN hours>40 THEN hours END),1) h_gt40, ROUND(MAX(hours),1) mx, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rework=1 THEN hours END),1) rework_h, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN overtime=1 THEN hours END),1) ot_h FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH a AS (SELECT op_id, SUM(hours) act, MIN(work_date) first_d, MAX(work_date) last_d FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1)
SELECT CAST(substr(o.completed_on,1,4) AS INT) yr, COUNT(*) n_ops, SUM(CASE WHEN a.op_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_lab, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN a.op_id IS NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),3) share_no_lab, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN a.op_id IS NULL THEN o.est_setup_hours+o.est_run_hours END),0) est_h_no_lab, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(a.last_d,1,4)<>substr(o.completed_on,1,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lab_other_yr
FROM erp_job_operations o LEFT JOIN a USING(op_id) WHERE o.completed_on IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CAST(substr(l.work_date,1,4) AS INT) yr, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN l.work_date=o.completed_on THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),3) share_on_completion_date, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN o.completed_on IS NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),4) share_open_op, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.completed_on IS NULL THEN l.hours END),1) h_open_op
FROM shop_labour_entries l LEFT JOIN erp_job_operations o USING(op_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT o.work_centre, COUNT(*) n_open, ROUND(SUM(o.est_setup_hours+o.est_run_hours),0) est_h_open, MIN(j.released_on) min_rel, MAX(j.released_on) max_rel FROM erp_job_operations o JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) WHERE o.completed_on IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH a AS (SELECT op_id, SUM(hours) act FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1)
SELECT o.work_centre, substr(o.completed_on,1,7) ym, COUNT(*) n_ops, ROUND(SUM(a.act)/SUM(o.est_setup_hours+o.est_run_hours),3) act_over_est
FROM erp_job_operations o JOIN a USING(op_id) WHERE substr(o.completed_on,1,7) IN ('2016-01','2016-02','2016-03','2016-06','2016-09','2016-12','2017-06') AND o.work_centre IN ('laser','paint','brake','mill')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT CAST(substr(week_of,1,4) AS INT) yr, COUNT(DISTINCT week_of) n_weeks, MIN(week_of) first_wk, MAX(week_of) last_wk, COUNT(*) rows_, ROUND(SUM(regular_hours),0) reg, ROUND(SUM(overtime_hours),0) ot FROM hr_timecards GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT released_on, ',' ORDER BY released_on) FROM (SELECT released_on FROM erp_jobs WHERE released_on IS NOT NULL ORDER BY released_on LIMIT 3)) j_rel_sample,
(SELECT min(length(released_on))||'-'||max(length(released_on)) FROM erp_jobs) j_len,
(SELECT min(length(received_on))||'-'||max(length(received_on)) FROM eng_drawing_revisions) r_len,
(SELECT min(length(completed_on))||'-'||max(length(completed_on)) FROM erp_jobs) c_len,
(SELECT min(received_on)||' / '||max(received_on) FROM eng_drawing_revisions) r_range,
(SELECT count(*) FROM eng_drawing_revisions WHERE released_on IS NULL) revs_unreleased,
(SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT revision, ',' ORDER BY revision) FROM eng_drawing_revisions) revs,
(SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT revision_issued, ',' ORDER BY revision_issued) FROM erp_jobs) issued
SELECT reason_code, count(*) n, sum(quantity) q FROM shop_scrap_reports GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC, reason_code

WITH s AS (SELECT sr.scrap_id, sr.job_id, sr.reported_on, sr.quantity, j.part_id, j.released_on, j.completed_on, j.revision_issued
 FROM shop_scrap_reports sr JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) WHERE sr.reason_code='wrong revision'),
x AS (SELECT s.*,
 (SELECT min(r.received_on) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=s.part_id AND r.received_on>s.released_on AND r.received_on<=coalesce(s.completed_on,'9999')) first_mid_rev,
 (SELECT min(r.released_on) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=s.part_id AND r.received_on>s.released_on AND r.received_on<=coalesce(s.completed_on,'9999')) first_mid_rev_rel,
 (SELECT min(e.logged_on) FROM eng_ecos e WHERE e.job_id=s.job_id) eco_on,
 (SELECT max(r.revision) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=s.part_id AND r.received_on<=s.reported_on) rev_at_scrap
 FROM s)
SELECT CASE WHEN first_mid_rev IS NULL THEN 'no_mid_rev' WHEN reported_on>=first_mid_rev THEN 'scrap_after_mid_rev_received' ELSE 'scrap_before_mid_rev' END timing,
 CASE WHEN eco_on IS NULL THEN 'no_eco' WHEN eco_on<=reported_on THEN 'eco_before_scrap' ELSE 'eco_after_scrap' END eco_t,
 (rev_at_scrap>revision_issued) newer_rev_existed_at_scrap,
 count(*) n, sum(quantity) q, min(reported_on) mn, max(reported_on) mx
FROM x GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH tc AS (SELECT CAST(substr(week_of,1,4) AS INT) yr, employee_id, SUM(regular_hours+overtime_hours) paid, COUNT(*) wks FROM hr_timecards GROUP BY 1,2),
lb AS (SELECT CAST(substr(work_date,1,4) AS INT) yr, employee_id, SUM(hours) clk FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT e.role, tc.yr, SUM(paid) paid, SUM(COALESCE(clk,0)) clk, SUM(wks) wks FROM tc LEFT JOIN lb USING(yr,employee_id) JOIN hr_employees e USING(employee_id) WHERE tc.yr BETWEEN 2016 AND 2025 GROUP BY 1,2),
rate AS (SELECT employee_id, arg_max(hourly, effective_on) hourly FROM hr_pay_rates WHERE effective_on <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1),
rr AS (SELECT e.role, median(rate.hourly) med_rate FROM rate JOIN hr_employees e USING(employee_id) WHERE employee_id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM tc WHERE yr=2025) GROUP BY 1),
x AS (SELECT role,
 SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2025 THEN paid-clk END)-SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2016 THEN paid-clk END) d16,
 SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2025 THEN paid-clk END)-SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2017 THEN paid-clk END) d17,
 (SUM(CASE WHEN yr BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025 THEN paid-clk END)-SUM(CASE WHEN yr BETWEEN 2017 AND 2019 THEN paid-clk END))/3.0 d3avg,
 SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2017 THEN wks END) wks17, SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2025 THEN wks END) wks25,
 SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2016 THEN wks END) wks16
 FROM r GROUP BY 1)
SELECT role, ROUND(d16,0) d16, ROUND(d17,0) d17, ROUND(d3avg,0) d3avg, wks16, wks17, wks25, ROUND(med_rate,2) rate,
 ROUND(d17*med_rate,0) usd17, ROUND(d3avg*med_rate,0) usd3avg,
 ROUND(SUM(d16) OVER(),0) t16, ROUND(SUM(d17) OVER(),0) t17, ROUND(SUM(d3avg) OVER(),0) t3,
 ROUND(SUM(d17*med_rate) OVER(),0) tusd17, ROUND(SUM(d3avg*med_rate) OVER(),0) tusd3
FROM x JOIN rr USING(role) ORDER BY role

WITH j AS (
 SELECT j.job_id, j.part_id, j.released_on, j.completed_on, j.revision_issued,
  coalesce((SELECT max(revision) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on<=j.released_on),'A') rec_rev,
  (SELECT min(r.received_on) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on>j.released_on AND r.received_on<=coalesce(j.completed_on,'9999')) mid_rec,
  (SELECT min(r.released_on) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on>j.released_on AND r.received_on<=coalesce(j.completed_on,'9999')) mid_rel,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_ecos e WHERE e.job_id=j.job_id) ecos
 FROM erp_jobs j WHERE j.released_on IS NOT NULL),
c AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN mid_rel<=coalesce(completed_on,'9999') THEN 'rev_released_before_done' ELSE 'rev_released_after_done' END relt,
   CASE WHEN ecos>0 THEN 'eco' ELSE 'no_eco' END eco FROM j WHERE revision_issued=rec_rev AND mid_rec IS NOT NULL),
s AS (SELECT job_id, count(*) n FROM shop_scrap_reports WHERE reason_code='wrong revision' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT eco, relt, count(*) jobs, count(s.job_id) jobs_wr, round(100.0*count(s.job_id)/count(*),1) pct,
 round(median(date_diff('day', released_on::date, completed_on::date)),0) med_job_days,
 round(median(date_diff('day', mid_rec::date, completed_on::date)),0) med_days_rev_to_done,
 round(median(date_diff('day', mid_rec::date, mid_rel::date)),0) med_rev_rec_to_rel
FROM c LEFT JOIN s USING(job_id) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH j AS (
 SELECT j.job_id, j.part_id, j.released_on, j.completed_on, j.revision_issued,
  coalesce((SELECT max(revision) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on<=j.released_on),'A') rec_rev,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_ecos e WHERE e.job_id=j.job_id) ecos,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_ecos e JOIN eng_drawing_revisions r USING(rev_id) WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on>j.released_on AND r.received_on<=coalesce(j.completed_on,'9999')) ecos_for_mid_rev,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_ecos e JOIN eng_drawing_revisions r USING(rev_id) WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on>j.released_on AND r.received_on<=coalesce(j.completed_on,'9999') AND e.job_id IS NULL) unlinked_ecos_for_mid_rev,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on>j.released_on AND r.received_on<=coalesce(j.completed_on,'9999')) mid
 FROM erp_jobs j WHERE j.released_on IS NOT NULL),
s AS (SELECT job_id, count(*) n FROM shop_scrap_reports WHERE reason_code='wrong revision' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT (ecos>0) job_has_eco, (ecos_for_mid_rev>0) rev_has_any_eco, (unlinked_ecos_for_mid_rev>0) rev_has_unlinked_eco, count(*) jobs, count(s.job_id) jobs_wr,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_ecos WHERE job_id IS NULL) total_unlinked_ecos, (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_ecos) total_ecos
FROM j LEFT JOIN s USING(job_id) WHERE revision_issued=rec_rev AND mid>0 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT e.role, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.work_centre = CASE e.role WHEN 'assembler' THEN 'assembly' WHEN 'inspector' THEN 'inspect' WHEN 'laser operator' THEN 'laser' WHEN 'machinist lathe' THEN 'lathe' WHEN 'machinist mill' THEN 'mill' WHEN 'painter' THEN 'paint' WHEN 'press brake operator' THEN 'brake' WHEN 'welder' THEN 'weld' END THEN l.hours ELSE 0 END)/SUM(l.hours),4) own_wc_share, ROUND(SUM(l.hours),0) h, string_agg(DISTINCT o.work_centre, ',' ORDER BY o.work_centre) wcs
FROM shop_labour_entries l JOIN erp_job_operations o USING(op_id) JOIN hr_employees e USING(employee_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH a AS (SELECT op_id, SUM(hours) act FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
y AS (SELECT CAST(substr(o.completed_on,1,4) AS INT) yr, SUM(o.est_setup_hours+o.est_run_hours) est, SUM(a.act) act FROM erp_job_operations o JOIN a USING(op_id) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT yr, ROUND(est,0) est, ROUND(act,0) act, ROUND(act/est,3) ratio,
 ROUND((est - FIRST_VALUE(est) OVER (ORDER BY yr)) * FIRST_VALUE(act/est) OVER (ORDER BY yr),0) clk_change_from_load_vs2016,
 ROUND(est*(act/est - FIRST_VALUE(act/est) OVER (ORDER BY yr)),0) clk_change_from_ratio_vs2016
FROM y ORDER BY yr

WITH ra_per_job AS (SELECT job_id, count(*) n FROM erp_return_authorisations GROUP BY 1),
cm_job AS (SELECT cm.credit_id, cm.amount, cm.reason cm_reason, sl.job_id FROM erp_credit_memos cm JOIN erp_invoices i USING(invoice_id) JOIN erp_shipment_lines sl ON sl.shipment_id=i.shipment_id)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_credit_memos) cms, (SELECT round(sum(amount),0) FROM erp_credit_memos) cm_total,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM ra_per_job WHERE n>1) jobs_multi_ra,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM cm_job) cm_job_rows, (SELECT count(DISTINCT credit_id) FROM cm_job) cm_distinct,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM cm_job WHERE job_id NOT IN (SELECT job_id FROM erp_return_authorisations)) cm_on_job_without_ra,
 (SELECT string_agg(r || ':' || n, '; ' ORDER BY r) FROM (SELECT cm_reason r, count(*) n FROM cm_job GROUP BY 1)) cm_reasons,
 (SELECT string_agg(r || ':' || n, '; ' ORDER BY r) FROM (SELECT reason r, count(*) n FROM erp_return_authorisations GROUP BY 1)) ra_reasons,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT job_id FROM erp_shipment_lines GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) jobs_multi_ship

sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT op_id, SUM(hours) act FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
y AS (SELECT o.work_centre wc, CAST(substr(o.completed_on,1,4) AS INT) yr, SUM(o.est_setup_hours+o.est_run_hours) est, SUM(a.act) act FROM erp_job_operations o JOIN a USING(op_id) WHERE substr(o.completed_on,1,4) IN ('2016','2017','2025') GROUP BY 1,2),
p AS (SELECT wc, MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2016 THEN est END) e16, MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2016 THEN act END) a16, MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2017 THEN est END) e17, MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2017 THEN act END) a17, MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2025 THEN est END) e25, MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2025 THEN act END) a25 FROM y GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COALESCE(wc,'ALL') wc, ROUND(SUM(a25)-SUM(a16),0) dclk16, ROUND((SUM(e25)-SUM(e16))*SUM(a16)/SUM(e16),0) load16, ROUND(SUM(e25)*(SUM(a25)/SUM(e25)-SUM(a16)/SUM(e16)),0) ratio16,
 ROUND(SUM(a25)-SUM(a17),0) dclk17, ROUND((SUM(e25)-SUM(e17))*SUM(a17)/SUM(e17),0) load17, ROUND(SUM(e25)*(SUM(a25)/SUM(e25)-SUM(a17)/SUM(e17)),0) ratio17
FROM p GROUP BY ROLLUP(wc) ORDER BY wc NULLS LAST

SELECT role, reason, COUNT(*) n, MIN(opened_on) first_open, MAX(opened_on) last_open FROM hr_requisitions WHERE role IN ('laser operator','painter','machinist mill','machinist lathe') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH j AS (
 SELECT j.job_id, j.part_id, j.line_id, j.quantity jq, j.released_on, j.completed_on, j.revision_issued,
  coalesce((SELECT max(revision) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on<=j.released_on),'A') rec_rev,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on>j.released_on AND r.received_on<=coalesce(j.completed_on,'9999')) mid,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_ecos e WHERE e.job_id=j.job_id) ecos
 FROM erp_jobs j WHERE j.released_on IS NOT NULL),
risk AS (SELECT * FROM j WHERE revision_issued<>rec_rev OR (mid>0 AND ecos=0)),
s AS (SELECT sr.job_id, sum(sr.quantity) q FROM shop_scrap_reports sr WHERE reason_code='wrong revision' GROUP BY 1),
v AS (SELECT r.job_id, s.q, r.jq, l.quantity lq, l.unit_price, s.q*l.unit_price val,
   (SELECT sum(pl.amount) FROM erp_purchase_orders po JOIN erp_po_lines pl USING(po_id) WHERE po.job_id=r.job_id) mat,
   (SELECT sum(hours) FROM shop_labour_entries le WHERE le.job_id=r.job_id AND rework=0) lab_h
  FROM risk r JOIN s USING(job_id) JOIN erp_so_lines l ON l.line_id=r.line_id),
rk AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY val DESC, job_id) rn FROM v)
SELECT count(*) jobs_with_wr, round(sum(val),0) scrap_val_price, round(median(val),0) med_job_val,
 round(100*sum(val) FILTER (WHERE rn<=10)/sum(val),1) top10_jobs_share,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE q>jq) scrap_gt_jobqty,
 round(sum(q*mat/jq),0) scrap_material_cost,
 round(sum(q*lab_h/jq),0) scrap_labour_hours,
 round(sum(unit_price*jq),0) job_revenue_these_jobs, round(sum(mat),0) mat_these_jobs, round(sum(lab_h),0) labh_these_jobs
FROM rk

WITH s AS (SELECT job_id, sum(quantity) q FROM shop_scrap_reports WHERE reason_code='wrong revision' GROUP BY 1),
sj AS (SELECT j.job_id, j.line_id, j.quantity, s.q FROM erp_jobs j JOIN s USING(job_id)),
ra AS (SELECT job_id, reason FROM erp_return_authorisations)
SELECT count(*) wr_jobs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE q=quantity) full_job_scrapped,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE job_id IN (SELECT job_id FROM ra)) wr_jobs_with_ra,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE job_id IN (SELECT job_id FROM ra WHERE reason IN ('does not fit','wrong dimensions','nonconforming'))) wr_jobs_with_fit_ra,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE line_id IN (SELECT line_id FROM erp_jobs WHERE kind='remake')) wr_jobs_with_remake_on_line,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE job_id IN (SELECT job_id FROM erp_shipment_lines)) wr_jobs_shipped,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM ra WHERE job_id NOT IN (SELECT job_id FROM s)) ra_on_jobs_without_wr,
 (SELECT round(avg(hourly),2) FROM hr_pay_rates) avg_hourly_all_rows,
 (SELECT round(sum(quantity),0) FROM shop_scrap_reports WHERE reason_code='wrong revision') wr_pieces
FROM sj

WITH a AS (SELECT op_id, SUM(hours) act FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT j.part_id, o.work_centre wc, CASE WHEN o.completed_on < '2016-07-01' THEN 'H1_2016' WHEN substr(o.completed_on,1,4)='2018' THEN 'Y2018' END per,
 (o.est_setup_hours+o.est_run_hours)/j.quantity est_pc, a.act/j.quantity act_pc
 FROM erp_job_operations o JOIN erp_jobs j USING(job_id) JOIN a USING(op_id) WHERE j.quantity>0 AND o.work_centre IN ('laser','paint','brake','weld')),
g AS (SELECT part_id, wc, per, AVG(est_pc) e, AVG(act_pc) ac FROM b WHERE per IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3),
m AS (SELECT x.wc, x.part_id, x.e e16, x.ac a16, y.e e18, y.ac a18 FROM g x JOIN g y ON x.part_id=y.part_id AND x.wc=y.wc AND x.per='H1_2016' AND y.per='Y2018')
SELECT wc, COUNT(*) n_parts, ROUND(median(e18/e16),3) med_est_ratio, ROUND(median(a18/a16),3) med_act_ratio FROM m GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH tc AS (SELECT CAST(substr(week_of,1,4) AS INT) yr, employee_id, SUM(regular_hours+overtime_hours) paid FROM hr_timecards GROUP BY 1,2),
lb AS (SELECT CAST(substr(work_date,1,4) AS INT) yr, employee_id, SUM(hours) clk FROM shop_labour_entries GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT e.role, tc.yr, SUM(paid) paid, SUM(COALESCE(clk,0)) clk, COUNT(*) n FROM tc LEFT JOIN lb USING(yr,employee_id) JOIN hr_employees e USING(employee_id) WHERE tc.yr IN (2017,2025) GROUP BY 1,2),
x AS (SELECT role, SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2025 THEN paid-clk ELSE -(paid-clk) END) d17, SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2025 THEN paid ELSE -paid END) dpaid17, SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2025 THEN clk ELSE -clk END) dclk17, MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2025 THEN paid/n END) paid_per_head25 FROM r GROUP BY 1)
SELECT role, ROUND(d17,0) d17, ROUND(dpaid17,0) dpaid17, ROUND(dclk17,0) dclk17, ROUND(paid_per_head25,0) paid_per_head25, ROUND(d17/paid_per_head25,2) fte_equiv, ROUND(SUM(d17/paid_per_head25) OVER (),2) fte_total FROM x ORDER BY d17 DESC

WITH j AS (
 SELECT j.job_id, j.part_id, j.released_on, j.created_on, j.completed_on, j.revision_issued, p.revision part_rev,
  coalesce((SELECT max(revision) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on<=j.released_on),'A') rec_rev,
  coalesce((SELECT max(revision) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on<=j.created_on),'A') rec_rev_created,
  coalesce((SELECT max(revision) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.logged_on<=j.released_on),'A') log_rev,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_drawing_revisions r WHERE r.part_id=j.part_id AND r.received_on>j.released_on AND r.received_on<=coalesce(j.completed_on,'9999')) mid,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM eng_ecos e WHERE e.job_id=j.job_id) ecos
 FROM erp_jobs j JOIN erp_customer_parts p USING(part_id) WHERE j.released_on IS NOT NULL)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE revision_issued<>rec_rev) sup_at_release,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE revision_issued<>rec_rev_created) sup_vs_created,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE revision_issued<>log_rev) sup_vs_logged,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE revision_issued<>coalesce(part_rev,'A')) diff_from_part_master,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE revision_issued<rec_rev OR mid>0) older_or_mid,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE completed_on IS NULL AND (revision_issued<>rec_rev OR (mid>0 AND ecos=0))) at_risk_open,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE completed_on IS NULL) open_jobs,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM erp_jobs WHERE released_on IS NULL) unreleased_jobs
FROM j

 381885-(10283+260898+110705) credit_reconcile_diff

WITH j AS (

 (SUM(CASE WHEN yr BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025 THEN paid-clk END)-SUM(CASE WHEN yr BETWEEN 2017 AND 2019 THEN paid-clk END))/3.0 d3avg,
